I could go to the park, ride my bike and have picnics with my friends. Sunny weather makes me feel happy and full of energy. I think sunny days are the best days.
explanation: 用I hope/would/could表达梦想中的天气。用temperature/light wind补充细节，用could play/go/ride/have说明活动，用because说明原因。

prompt: 假设你是一名导游，请写一段话向游客介绍你们城市的位置、周边设施以及如何从火车站到达市中心。
sampleAnswer: Welcome to our city! Our city is in the east of China. There are many shops, restaurants and hotels in the city centre. From the train station, you can take the No. 5 bus and get off at City Hall. Then walk along Main Street and turn right at the bank. The city centre is about ten minutes on foot. Enjoy your stay here!
explanation: 导游介绍要写清楚位置、设施和路线。用in the east of/take the No. 5 bus/get off at/walk along/turn right等表达，结尾用Enjoy your stay!收尾。

prompt: 你的英国朋友Tom要来你的城市旅游。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你家附近有哪些设施（如超市、公园、银行等），以及它们的位置。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I am happy to hear that you will visit my city. Let me tell you about the places near my home. There is a big supermarket on Green Street. It is next to a bank. Across from the supermarket is a park. You can walk there in five minutes. There is also a hospital behind my house. Everything is convenient here. I hope you will enjoy your stay.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按设施逐一介绍位置，用on Green Street/next to/across from/behind。用Everything is convenient here.总结，结尾表达欢迎。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你的社区。内容包括：社区的位置、有哪些设施、你最喜欢哪个设施以及原因。
sampleAnswer: I live in a quiet community in the south of the city. There is a small park, a supermarket, a library and a sports centre in my community. My favourite place is the library because it is quiet and I can read many books there. There is also a playground next to the library. I like my community because it is clean and convenient.
explanation: 按“位置—设施—最喜欢的地方—原因”介绍社区。用in the south of/there is/next to说明位置，用because说明原因。

prompt: 假设你是Li Ming，你的朋友想知道从你家到最近的地铁站怎么走。请给他写一封邮件，描述路线。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
Let me tell you how to get to the subway station from my home. Go out of my house and turn left. Walk along Garden Street for about five minutes. You will see a bank on your right. Turn right at the bank and go straight. The subway station is on your left, next to a bookstore. It is easy to find. See you soon!
Yours,
Li Ming
explanation: 路线描述用turn left/walk along/on your right/turn right/go straight/on your left。按出发—经过—到达顺序写，用easy to find收尾。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你们学校附近的一条街道。内容包括：街道的位置、两边有哪些建筑或设施以及这条街给你的感受。
sampleAnswer: There is a busy street near our school. It is called Culture Street. On the left side, there is a bookstore, a bank and a restaurant. On the right side, there is a post office and a small park. Many students like to go to the bookstore after school. The street is always lively. I like walking there because it is full of life.
explanation: 街道描写用On the left side/On the right side说明两边设施。用busy/lively/full of life描写氛围，结尾用because说明感受。

prompt: 你的学校正在开展“最美社区”评选活动。请写一篇短文推荐你的社区，说明社区的位置、设施、环境和居民。
sampleAnswer: I want to recommend my community. It is in the north of the city. There is a big park in the centre of the community. Around the park, there are a supermarket, a library and a sports centre. The streets are clean and there are many trees and flowers. The people here are friendly. We often help each other. I think my community is the most beautiful one. Please vote for it!
explanation: 推荐类短文要写清楚位置、设施、环境和居民。用in the centre of/around the park说明布局，用friendly/help each other说明人文环境，用Please vote for it!号召。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述你理想中的社区。内容包括：它在哪里、有哪些设施、环境如何以及你为什么想要这样的社区。
sampleAnswer: I hope to live in a community near a river. There would be a big park, a swimming pool and a library. The streets would be clean and quiet. There would be many trees and flowers. I want this community because I like nature and I want a peaceful place to live. I hope my family and friends can live there too.
explanation: 用I hope/would表达理想社区。用There would be...描写设施，用clean and quiet/many trees描写环境，用because说明原因。

prompt: 假设你是一名社区志愿者，请写一则英文通知，告诉居民本周末社区将举办一次清洁活动，包括时间、集合地点、活动内容和注意事项。
sampleAnswer:
Notice
Dear neighbours,
We will have a community clean-up this Saturday. We will meet at the community centre at 8:30 a.m. We will clean the park and pick up rubbish in the streets. Please wear comfortable clothes and bring gloves. We will finish at 11:00 a.m. Let's work together to make our community cleaner and more beautiful. Thank you.
The Community Volunteer Team
explanation: 通知要有标题、称呼、时间地点、内容和注意事项。用will meet/will clean/will finish表达安排，用Please wear/bring提出要求。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你曾经住过的一个地方，说明它在哪里、周围有什么设施、你当时喜欢做什么。
sampleAnswer: I lived in a small town when I was a child. It is in the south of China. There was a river near my house. Across from my house was a small market. There was also a primary school on the next street. I liked to play by the river with my friends. We caught fish and watched boats. I miss that place very much.
explanation: 用一般过去时描述曾经住过的地方（lived/was/liked/caught/watched/missed）。用near/across from/on the next street说明位置，结尾用I miss...表达感情。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢去的一个社区场所（如图书馆、公园、运动中心等），说明它在哪里、有什么设施、你常在那里做什么。
sampleAnswer: My favourite place in my community is the sports centre. It is next to the park, not far from my home. There is a basketball court, a swimming pool and a gym in it. I often go there with my friends on weekends. We play basketball for an hour and then swim. It is a great place to exercise and relax. I love going there.
explanation: 按“地点—设施—活动—感受”介绍社区场所。用next to/not far from说明位置，用There is...描写设施，用often go there...说明活动。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你上学日的作息时间。内容包括：起床、吃早饭、上学、放学和睡觉的时间。
sampleAnswer: On school days, I usually get up at 6:40. I have breakfast at 7:00. Then I go to school at 7:20. Classes begin at 8:00. School is over at 4:30 in the afternoon. I get home at 5:00 and do my homework. I have dinner at 6:30. I go to bed at 9:30. I have a busy but healthy day.
explanation: 按时间顺序介绍作息，用usually/at.../then/after school等衔接词。每个时间点写一个主要活动，最后用busy but healthy概括感受。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国初中生的一天。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你上午和下午的时间安排，并说明你最喜欢哪一段时间及原因。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
Let me tell you about my school day. I get to school at 7:30. In the morning, we have four classes from 8:00 to 11:50. I have lunch at 12:00. In the afternoon, we have two classes. After class, I play basketball for half an hour. My favourite time is the afternoon because I can exercise and relax with my friends.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按上午、中午、下午组织。用from...to...表达时间段，用My favourite time is...because...突出最喜欢的时间并说明原因。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你周末的作息安排。说明你通常几点起床、上午和下午做什么、晚上几点睡觉。
sampleAnswer: On weekends, I usually get up at 8:00. In the morning, I do my homework and read books. At noon, I have lunch with my family. In the afternoon, I often play football with my friends. Sometimes I go to the park with my parents. In the evening, I watch TV or listen to music. I go to bed at 10:00. I have a happy weekend.
explanation: 周末作息按时间顺序写，用usually/often/sometimes表达频率。活动要多样，避免只写学习。结尾用happy weekend概括感受。

prompt: 假设你是Li Ming，你的朋友总是很晚才睡觉，第二天上课没有精神。请给他写一封邮件，建议他养成健康的作息习惯。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I am worried about you. You go to bed too late, so you feel tired in class. I think you should change your habits. Please finish your homework before 8:30. Then you can read or listen to music for a while. You should go to bed before 10:00. A good sleep can help you study better. I hope you can try my advice.
Yours,
Li Ming
explanation: 建议信先表达关心，再指出问题，用should/please提出具体建议，用can help you...说明好处。语气友好，不指责对方。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你一天中最忙碌的一段时间，并说明你是如何安排时间的。
sampleAnswer: The busiest time of my day is the morning. I get up at 6:20. I wash my face and get dressed quickly. I have breakfast at 6:40. Then I ride my bike to school. I get to school at 7:10. I have four classes from 8:00 to 11:50. I am busy, but I feel good because I use my time well.
explanation: 聚焦最忙碌的一段时间，用quickly/from...to...描写节奏。结尾用but I feel good because...体现积极的时间管理态度。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你理想中的一天作息。说明你希望几点起床、做什么活动以及为什么喜欢这样的安排。
sampleAnswer: My ideal day starts at 8:00. I hope to get up at 8:00, not 6:30. After breakfast, I will go to the park and ride a bike. In the afternoon, I will read a book and listen to music. In the evening, I will watch a film with my family. I like this plan because I can relax and do what I enjoy.
explanation: 用I hope to/will表达理想作息。与日常作息形成对比（8:00, not 6:30），突出“理想”。结尾用because说明原因。

prompt: 你的班级正在开展“健康作息之星”评选活动。请写一篇短文，介绍你的健康作息习惯，并说明这些习惯对你的好处。
sampleAnswer: I have healthy daily habits. I get up at 6:30 and go to bed at 9:30. I eat breakfast every morning. After school, I exercise for 30 minutes. I usually play basketball or run. I also drink a lot of water. These habits make me strong and energetic. I can study better and feel happier. I think a good routine is very important.
explanation: 围绕健康列举作息、饮食、运动和饮水习惯，用make me strong and energetic说明好处。结尾点明good routine很重要。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你的朋友Wang Fang的作息安排，并说明你认为她/他的作息是否健康及原因。
sampleAnswer: My friend Wang Fang has a good daily routine. She gets up at 6:30 and reads English for 20 minutes. She goes to school at 7:15. After school, she does her homework first, then helps her mother cook dinner. She goes to bed at 9:30. I think her routine is healthy because she sleeps well and uses her time wisely.
explanation: 介绍他人作息用第三人称单数（gets/reads/goes/does/helps/sleeps）。用I think...because...评价作息是否健康。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述你上学日晚上通常做的事情，包括作业、家务、放松和睡觉的时间安排。
sampleAnswer: On school nights, I usually get home at 5:30. I do my homework from 6:00 to 7:30. Then I have dinner with my family at 7:30. After dinner, I help wash the dishes. From 8:30 to 9:00, I read or listen to music. I go to bed at 9:30. I try to keep a good balance between study and rest.
explanation: 按晚上时间顺序写，用from...to...说明时间段。用help wash the dishes补充家务，结尾用keep a good balance between...说明时间安排合理。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学上学日作息时间的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、起床和睡觉时间以及你的发现。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about daily routines in our class. There are 40 students. Most students get up at 6:30. Ten students get up at 6:00. Most students go to bed at 9:30, but eight students go to bed after 10:30. I find that most students have healthy habits. However, some students need more sleep. I think we should go to bed earlier.
explanation: 调查报道写清楚人数、数据和发现。用Most students/Ten students/Eight students列出结果，用I find that...总结，用should提出建议。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你去年暑假的一次旅行。内容包括：你去了哪里、和谁一起、做了什么以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last summer, I went to Sanya with my parents. We went there by plane. The weather was sunny and hot. On the first day, we went to the beach. I swam in the sea and built a sandcastle. On the second day, we visited a famous park and took many photos. We also ate delicious seafood. I felt very happy and relaxed. It was a wonderful trip, and I hope to go there again.
explanation: 围绕假期旅行展开，使用一般过去时描述经历。按“地点—同行者—活动—感受”组织内容，注意动词过去式和不规则变化，如went/swam/ate/felt。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解你最近一次假期旅行。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你去哪里、怎么去、做了什么以及天气情况。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I am glad to tell you about my last holiday. I went to Xi'an with my family. We took the train there. The weather was cool and sunny. We visited the Terracotta Warriors and the City Wall. We also tried local food like noodles and dumplings. I bought a small gift for my friend. We had a great time. I hope you can visit China one day.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件需包含称呼和署名。正文用一般过去时介绍旅行地点、交通、天气和活动。结尾表达希望对方来中国，使邮件完整自然。

prompt: 请用日记形式记录你在旅行地度过的一天。内容包括：上午去了哪里、下午做了什么、晚上有什么活动以及你的感受。
note: 不少于80词，日记开头已给出，不计入总词数。Saturday, August 10th
sampleAnswer:
Saturday, August 10th
Today was a great day. In the morning, I went to the zoo with my parents. We saw pandas and monkeys. The monkeys were very funny. In the afternoon, we visited a science museum. I learned a lot about space. In the evening, we walked along the river and took photos. The night view was beautiful. I felt tired but very happy. I will never forget this day.
explanation: 日记要有日期，用一般过去时叙述一天的活动。按上午、下午、晚上顺序组织，加入细节和感受，避免流水账。

prompt: 学校英语报正在举办“My Best Holiday”征文活动。请写一篇短文，介绍你最好的一次假期，并说明为什么它令你难忘。
sampleAnswer: My best holiday was a trip to the countryside last summer. I went there with my grandparents. We lived in a small village for a week. Every morning, I helped feed the chickens. In the afternoon, I went fishing with my grandfather. At night, we sat under the stars and talked. It was simple but peaceful. I will never forget it because I enjoyed nature and spent wonderful time with my grandparents.
explanation: 先点明最好的一次假期，再描述具体活动和感受，最后用because说明难忘原因。注意乡村活动词汇和过去式表达。

prompt: 假设你是导游，请写一段英文解说词，向游客介绍一个旅游景点。内容包括：景点位置、特色、可以进行的活动以及游览建议。
sampleAnswer: Welcome to Green Lake Park. It is in the east of our city. The park is famous for its clean lake and beautiful flowers. You can walk around the lake, take a boat or have a picnic on the grass. In spring, you can see many colourful flowers. I suggest you wear comfortable shoes and bring some water. Please do not litter. I hope you enjoy your visit here.
explanation: 导游解说词要有欢迎语和结束语。介绍位置、特色、活动和建议，使用can/suggest/should等表达，语气友好、信息清楚。

prompt: 你的朋友Linda想来你的城市旅游。请给她写一封邮件，推荐一个你认为最值得去的地方，并说明推荐理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Linda,
I am happy to hear that you will visit my city. I want to recommend the City Museum. It is in the city centre and easy to find. You can see old paintings, ancient coins and beautiful art works there. It is a quiet place and you can learn a lot about our history. I suggest you go there on Friday afternoon because it is not crowded. I am sure you will like it.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 推荐信要写清楚推荐地点、位置、特色和理由。用I want to recommend...开头，用I suggest...because...给出建议和原因。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学假期活动的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要假期活动以及你的发现。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about holiday activities in our class. There are 45 students. Twenty students travelled with their families. Fifteen students stayed at home and read books. Ten students took part in sports or clubs. The other students visited their grandparents. I find that most students had a meaningful holiday. However, only a few students did volunteer work. I think we should try to help others during holidays.
explanation: 调查报道要写清调查主题、人数、数据和发现。用Twenty/Fifteen/Ten students列出结果，用I find that...总结，用However提出改进建议。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较你去年和今年的假期生活。内容包括：两次假期你分别做了什么、有什么不同以及你更喜欢哪一次。
sampleAnswer: Last year, I spent my summer holiday at home. I did my homework, read books and watched TV. I felt a little bored. This year, I went to Hainan with my family. We swam in the sea and visited a fruit farm. I also made new friends there. This holiday was more exciting than last year's. I prefer this year's holiday because I experienced new things and enjoyed nature.
explanation: 比较两个假期时使用一般过去时，并用more exciting than等比较结构。先分别描述，再表达偏好和原因，使比较清晰。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次不太顺利但依然有趣的旅行经历。内容包括：遇到了什么问题、你们如何解决以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last summer, my family went to a mountain village. On the way, our car broke down. We had to wait for help for two hours. It was hot and we were tired. But we didn't give up. We found a small river nearby and played in the water. Later, a kind driver helped us fix the car. We finally arrived at the village. Although the trip was not smooth, it was still interesting and unforgettable.
explanation: 围绕“不顺利但有趣”展开，先写问题，再写解决办法和感受。使用although/but等连接词，体现转折和积极态度。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，推荐一个适合家庭旅行的目的地。内容包括：目的地名称、位置、适合家庭的活动以及推荐理由。
sampleAnswer: I want to recommend Beihai Park for a family trip. It is in the north of Beijing. There is a big lake, a beautiful garden and a small hill in the park. Families can take a boat on the lake, have a picnic and climb the hill together. Children can also fly kites on the grass. I recommend it because it is quiet, beautiful and suitable for people of all ages. Everyone can have fun there.
explanation: 推荐目的地要写清名称、位置、适合家庭的活动和理由。用can...列举活动，用because说明推荐原因，注意suitable for people of all ages等表达。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你的日常锻炼习惯。内容包括：你通常做什么运动、多久做一次、每次多长时间以及运动对你的好处。
sampleAnswer: I like sports very much. Every morning, I run for about twenty minutes before breakfast. After school, I often play basketball with my classmates twice a week. On weekends, I sometimes go swimming with my father. I exercise for about one hour every day. Exercise makes me strong and energetic. It also helps me relax and sleep well. I think everyone should exercise often.
explanation: 围绕锻炼习惯，使用频率副词和短语，如every morning/often/twice a week/sometimes。写清楚运动项目、频率、时长和好处，结尾表达观点。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国学生的课余活动。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你通常多久做一次以下活动：读书、运动、上网和做家务。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I am glad to tell you about my after-school activities. I read books every day. I usually read for half an hour before bed. I play basketball twice a week. I use the Internet three times a week, but I never play computer games for a long time. I help my mother do housework once a week. These activities make my life colourful. What do you usually do after school?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按活动逐项介绍频率，使用every day/twice a week/three times a week/once a week/never。注意频率表达的位置和动词形式。

prompt: 学校正在开展“健康生活”主题活动。请写一篇短文，介绍你的健康生活习惯，包括饮食、运动和睡眠三个方面。
sampleAnswer: I have many healthy habits. First, I eat healthy food. I eat fruit and vegetables every day, and I hardly ever eat junk food. Second, I exercise often. I run every morning and play ping-pong twice a week. Third, I get enough sleep. I go to bed before 10:00 and sleep for about nine hours. These habits make me healthy and happy. I will keep them.
explanation: 按饮食、运动、睡眠三方面组织，使用First/Second/Third。用every day/hardly ever/often/twice a week等频率表达，最后总结好处。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学课余活动的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要活动及频率以及你的建议。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about after-school activities in our class. There are 40 students. Most students do homework every day. Twenty students exercise three times a week. Fifteen students read books every day. Only five students help with housework once a week. I find that students are busy with study. I suggest everyone exercise more and help parents at home. A balanced life is important.
explanation: 调查报道要写清人数、活动和频率。用Most/Twenty/Fifteen/Only five students列出数据，用I suggest...提出建议，结尾点明balanced life的重要性。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你的一位朋友的生活习惯，并评价他/她的习惯是否健康及原因。
sampleAnswer: My friend Wang Fang has good living habits. She gets up early every day and runs for twenty minutes. She eats fruit and vegetables every day and hardly ever eats junk food. She goes to bed before 10:00. However, she seldom plays sports with others because she likes to study alone. I think her habits are healthy, but she should exercise with friends more often. Friends can make exercise more fun.
explanation: 介绍他人习惯用第三人称单数。用every day/hardly ever/seldom等频率词。评价时先肯定健康之处，再提出改进建议，使评价客观。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter经常熬夜、吃垃圾食品，也不爱运动。请给他写一封邮件，建议他养成健康的生活习惯，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I am worried about your health. You often stay up late and eat junk food. You hardly ever exercise. I think you should change your habits. First, please go to bed before 10:30 and sleep for eight hours. Second, eat more fruit and vegetables. Third, exercise at least three times a week. These habits can help you feel better and study better. I hope you can try them.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议信先表达关心，再指出问题，用should/please提出具体建议，用can help you...说明理由。语气友好，避免指责。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较你和你的好朋友在运动习惯方面的不同。内容包括：你们各自多久运动一次、喜欢什么运动以及你更欣赏谁的习惯。
sampleAnswer: My friend Mike and I have different exercise habits. I exercise every day. I run in the morning and play basketball twice a week. Mike hardly ever exercises. He likes watching sports on TV, but he seldom plays sports. I think my habit is healthier because exercise keeps me strong. However, Mike is good at swimming, so I hope he can swim more often. We can exercise together and become healthier.
explanation: 比较两人习惯时用every day/hardly ever/seldom/twice a week。用I think...because...表达观点，结尾提出共同运动的希望。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你如何安排周末时间。内容包括：你通常多久做一次作业、运动、读书和放松，以及你为什么这样安排。
sampleAnswer: On weekends, I try to keep a balanced schedule. I do my homework every Saturday morning. I exercise twice a week, usually on Saturday afternoon and Sunday morning. I read books every day for about half an hour. In the evening, I relax by listening to music or watching TV. I hardly ever play computer games for more than an hour. I arrange my time this way because I want to study well and stay healthy.
explanation: 按活动介绍频率，用every Saturday morning/twice a week/every day/hardly ever。结尾用because说明安排理由，体现时间管理意识。

prompt: 假设你是学校健康俱乐部的成员，请写一则英文倡议书，号召同学们多运动、少玩手机、健康饮食。
sampleAnswer:
Dear students,
Health is important to everyone. I hope you can join our health club. Please exercise at least three times a week. You can run, swim or play ball games. Try to use your phone less. Don't play computer games for a long time. Eat more fruit and vegetables and hardly ever eat junk food. If we keep healthy habits, we can study better and live happier. Let's take action now!
The Health Club
explanation: 倡议书要有称呼、发布者和号召。用Please/Try to/Don't提出建议，用If...can...说明结果，用Let's take action now!增强号召力。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“健康习惯”的看法。内容包括：你认为最重要的健康习惯是什么、你如何坚持它以及它给你带来的变化。
sampleAnswer: I think the most important healthy habit is exercising regularly. I exercise every day. In the morning, I run for twenty minutes. After school, I play basketball with my friends twice a week. I keep this habit by making a plan and exercising with friends. It is easier to keep going when we exercise together. Since I started exercising, I have become stronger and more energetic. I seldom catch a cold now. Good habits really change our lives.
explanation: 观点类短文先表明最重要的习惯，再写如何坚持和带来的变化。用by making a plan/with friends说明坚持方法，用Since...说明变化。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较你和你的好朋友。内容包括：你们在外貌、性格和爱好方面的异同，以及你们为什么能成为好朋友。
sampleAnswer: My best friend is Li Ming. We are in the same class. He is taller and stronger than me, but I am more outgoing than him. He is quiet and likes reading, while I like playing basketball. We have different hobbies, but we both like English. We often help each other with our studies. I think we are good friends because we understand and accept each other's differences. A true friend doesn't have to be the same as you.
explanation: 比较人物时使用比较级，如taller/stronger/more outgoing。用while/but连接不同点，用both说明共同点。结尾表达对友谊的理解。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解你和你的家人。请给他写一封邮件，比较你和你的哥哥或姐姐（或弟弟妹妹），说明你们在外貌和性格上的不同。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I have a sister. Her name is Li Fang. She is two years older than me. She is taller and thinner than me. I have short hair, but she has long hair. She is quieter and more careful than me. I am more outgoing and I like making friends. She likes reading at home, but I like playing sports outside. Although we are different, we get on well with each other. What about you and your brother or sister?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件比较兄弟姐妹时用taller/thinner/quieter/more careful/more outgoing等比较级。用but/although形成对比，结尾提问以保持交流。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你的一位好朋友，并说明他/她和你有什么相同点和不同点。
sampleAnswer: My good friend is Wang Fang. We have a lot in common. We are both 14 years old and we both like music. We are in the same music club. But we are also different. She is more patient and careful than me. I am funnier and more active. She likes quiet activities like reading, but I like exciting activities like rock climbing. I think our differences make our friendship more interesting.
explanation: 先用both说明相同点，再用but/also different引出不同点。用more patient/more careful/more active等比较级，结尾点明差异让友谊更有趣。

prompt: 学校正在开展“我眼中的好朋友”征文活动。请写一篇短文，介绍你最好的朋友，说明他/她的性格特点，以及你们之间发生过的一件令你感动的事。
sampleAnswer: My best friend is Chen Jie. She is kind and helpful. She is more patient than me, and she always listens to others carefully. Once, I failed an English test and felt very sad. She didn't laugh at me. Instead, she helped me study after school for a week. With her help, I did better in the next test. I was deeply moved. I think a true friend is someone who stays with you when you are down.
explanation: 先用形容词介绍性格，再用一件具体的事说明。用Once/Instead/With her help组织叙事，结尾用I think...总结对真正朋友的理解。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较你们班两位同学。说明他们的外貌、性格和爱好有什么不同，以及你更愿意和谁交朋友。
sampleAnswer: Li Lei and Zhang Hua are my classmates. Li Lei is tall and strong. He is very outgoing and likes sports. He plays basketball every day. Zhang Hua is shorter and thinner. He is quiet and shy. He likes reading and drawing. Li Lei is more active, while Zhang Hua is more careful. I would like to make friends with both of them because they have different good qualities. Li Lei can make me laugh, and Zhang Hua can help me calm down.
explanation: 比较两位同学时按外貌、性格、爱好逐项对比，用while连接。用I would like to make friends with...表达选择，并说明两人的优点。

prompt: 假设你是Li Ming，你的朋友Peter总是觉得自己不如别人，很不自信。请给他写一封邮件，鼓励他发现自己的优点，并说明你眼中的他。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I am sorry to hear that you feel unhappy. Please don't compare yourself with others too much. Everyone has his own strengths. In my eyes, you are a kind and funny friend. You are more patient than many people. You always help others when they are in trouble. You are also good at drawing. You may not be the tallest or the most outgoing, but you are special. Please believe in yourself. I am sure you can do well.
Yours,
Li Ming
explanation: 鼓励信先表达理解，再帮助对方发现优点。用In my eyes.../You are more patient than.../You are also good at...具体说明，语气真诚。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你和你的网友。内容包括：你们如何认识、你们有什么相同点和不同点以及你们如何保持联系。
sampleAnswer: I have an online friend. His name is Tony and he lives in Australia. We met on an English learning website two years ago. We are both interested in music and movies. But we are different in some ways. He is more outgoing and likes making videos, while I am quieter and like writing. We keep in touch by email and video calls. We talk about our school life and share interesting things. I hope to meet him one day.
explanation: 按“如何认识—相同点—不同点—如何联系”组织。用both/but/while说明异同，用by email and video calls说明联系方式。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较城市生活和乡村生活。内容包括：环境、交通、生活节奏等方面的不同，以及你更喜欢哪种生活及原因。
sampleAnswer: City life and country life are quite different. The city is busier and more crowded than the country. There are more shops, hospitals and schools. The traffic is heavy, but it is convenient. The country is quieter and cleaner. There are more trees and fresh air, but there are fewer shops. I prefer country life because I like nature and a peaceful life. However, I also enjoy the convenience of the city. Maybe the best life is to enjoy both.
explanation: 比较城乡生活时使用busier/more crowded/quieter/cleaner/fewer等比较级。用but连接优缺点，用prefer...because...表达偏好。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“好朋友应该相似还是不同”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about friendship in our class. There are 40 students. Twenty-five students think good friends should be similar. They say similar friends can understand each other easily. Fifteen students think good friends can be different. They think differences can make life more interesting. In my opinion, both are fine. Similar friends share common interests, but different friends can teach us new things. The most important thing is mutual respect.
explanation: 调查报道要写清人数、结果和看法。用Twenty-five/Fifteen students列出观点，用In my opinion...表达自己的看法，结尾点明关键。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你心目中理想的朋友。内容包括：他/她应该具备哪些品质、为什么这些品质重要以及你会如何对待这样的朋友。
sampleAnswer: In my opinion, an ideal friend should be honest, kind and helpful. Honesty is important because a good friend should always tell the truth. Kindness makes us feel warm, and helpful friends can support us when we are in trouble. An ideal friend should also be a good listener. I would treat such a friend with respect and trust. I would help him or her when needed and share both happy and sad moments. True friendship is built on trust and care.
explanation: 先列举理想朋友的品质，用because说明重要性，再写自己会如何对待朋友。用should be/should also be等表达期望，结尾总结友谊基础。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢的一家电影院。内容包括：它的名称、位置、设施、服务和它为什么是最好的电影院。
sampleAnswer: My favourite movie theater is Sun Cinema. It is in the city centre, not far from my home. It has the biggest screens and the most comfortable seats. It also has the best sound system. The tickets are a little expensive, but the service is the best in town. The workers are friendly and the popcorn is delicious. I think Sun Cinema is the best movie theater because it gives us the best movie experience.
explanation: 介绍电影院时使用最高级，如the biggest screens/the most comfortable seats/the best sound system。按名称、位置、设施、服务、原因组织，结尾点明“最好”。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解你们城市最好的电影院。请给他写一封邮件，比较两三家电影院，并推荐最好的一家。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
There are several movie theaters in my city. Moon Cinema has the cheapest tickets, but the seats are not very comfortable. Star Cinema is close to my home, but it is often crowded. I recommend Sun Cinema. It has the biggest screens and the best sound. The seats are the most comfortable. It is a little far, but it is worth it. I think Sun Cinema is the best choice. What about the movie theaters in your city?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件比较电影院时使用cheapest/biggest/best/most comfortable等最高级。先比较，再推荐，用but/it is worth it说明取舍。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你们班同学最喜欢的一家餐厅。内容包括：餐厅名称、特色菜、价格、服务以及大家喜欢它的原因。
sampleAnswer: Our class's favourite restaurant is Happy Kitchen. It is on Green Street. It is famous for its noodles and dumplings. The food is fresh and delicious. The prices are the most reasonable in our neighbourhood. A bowl of beef noodles is only 15 yuan. The waiters are friendly and the service is fast. We like it because it has the most delicious food and the best service. We often go there after school.
explanation: 介绍餐厅时使用最高级，如the most reasonable/the most delicious/the best service。按名称、位置、特色、价格、服务、原因组织。

prompt: 学校正在开展“我身边最好的地方”征文活动。请写一篇短文，介绍你认为你们社区最好的一个地方（如公园、书店、运动中心等），并说明理由。
sampleAnswer: I think the best place in my community is the sports centre. It is next to the park. It has the largest gym and the most modern equipment. You can play basketball, swim and do yoga there. The coaches are patient and helpful. The price is not the cheapest, but it is reasonable. I think it is the best place because it helps people keep healthy and makes our community more lively. I go there twice a week.
explanation: 按地点、设施、活动、服务、价格、理由组织。用the largest/the most modern等最高级，用because说明推荐理由。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较你们城市的两家书店。内容包括：它们的位置、环境、书籍种类和价格，以及你更喜欢哪一家及原因。
sampleAnswer: There are two bookstores in my city: Book City and Sunshine Books. Book City is bigger and has more books. It is in the city centre. Sunshine Books is smaller but quieter. It is near my home. The books in Sunshine Books are a little more expensive, but the environment is more comfortable. I prefer Sunshine Books because it is quiet and I can read there for hours. Sometimes the best place is not the biggest one, but the one that fits you.
explanation: 比较书店时使用bigger/more books/smaller/quieter/more expensive/more comfortable。用prefer...because...表达偏好，结尾点明“适合自己的才是最好的”。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最好的周末活动”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about the best weekend activity in our class. There are 40 students. Twenty students think going to the movies is the best. Ten students choose playing sports. Five students like reading in the library best. The other students prefer visiting friends. I think the best activity is doing sports because it is healthy and fun. However, different people have different ideas. The best activity is the one that makes you happy and relaxed.
explanation: 调查报道要写清人数、结果和看法。用Twenty/Ten/Five students列出数据，用I think...because...表达看法，结尾点明“最好的活动因人而异”。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你心中最好的老师。内容包括：他/她教什么科目、有什么特点、为什么是你心中最好的老师。
sampleAnswer: My best teacher is Miss Wang. She teaches English. She is the most patient teacher I know. She always explains things carefully and never gets angry when we make mistakes. Her classes are the most interesting because she uses games and songs. She is also the kindest person. She cares about our lives, not just our grades. I think she is the best teacher because she makes us love learning and believe in ourselves.
explanation: 介绍最好的老师时使用最高级，如the most patient/the most interesting/the kindest。按科目、特点、原因组织，用because说明理由。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢的一本书或一部电影。内容包括：它是什么、讲的是什么、你为什么认为它是最好的。
sampleAnswer: My favourite movie is Zootopia. It is an animated film about a rabbit police officer and a fox. They work together to solve a case. The story is funny and exciting. I think it is the best movie because it teaches us an important lesson: we should not judge others by their appearance. Everyone can be anything they want. The characters are lovely and the music is wonderful. I have watched it three times and I still love it.
explanation: 介绍最喜欢的电影时说明内容、特点、理由。用the best movie because...说明原因，用teaches us an important lesson点明主题。

prompt: 你的朋友要来你的城市玩一天。请给他/她写一封邮件，推荐一条“最好的一日游路线”，包括上午、中午和下午的安排，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Amy,
Welcome to my city! Here is my plan for the best one-day trip. In the morning, you can visit the City Museum. It has the most interesting exhibitions. At noon, I suggest you have lunch at Happy Kitchen. It has the most delicious noodles. In the afternoon, you can go to Green Lake Park. It is the most beautiful place in our city. You can walk around the lake and take photos. I am sure you will have a great day.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 推荐一日游路线时用the most interesting/the most delicious/the most beautiful等最高级。按上午、中午、下午组织，用I suggest...because...说明理由。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“最好的东西不一定是最贵的”这一观点的看法。请举例说明。
sampleAnswer: I agree that the best things are not always the most expensive. For example, the best gift I ever received was a handmade card from my friend. It cost nothing, but it was full of love. The best meal is not in an expensive restaurant but at home with my family. The best place to relax is not a five-star hotel but a quiet park near my home. Money can buy things, but it cannot buy happiness, friendship or love. The best things in life are often free.
explanation: 观点类短文先表明态度，再用多个例子说明。用For example/The best...is not...but...形成对比，结尾用Money can buy...but it cannot buy...总结观点。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢的电视节目。内容包括：节目名称、类型、播出时间、内容以及你喜欢它的原因。
sampleAnswer: My favourite TV show is Animal World. It is a nature documentary. It is on CCTV every Sunday evening. The show tells us about animals in different countries. We can see lions, elephants, pandas and many other animals. I like it because it is interesting and educational. I can learn a lot about nature from it. It also teaches us to protect animals. I never miss it.
explanation: 按“名称—类型—时间—内容—原因”介绍电视节目。用because说明喜欢的原因，用educational/learn a lot about nature突出节目价值。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国学生喜欢看什么电视节目。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你和你的家人各自喜欢的电视节目，并说明原因。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I want to tell you about TV shows in my family. I like sports shows best because I love basketball. My father likes the news. He watches it every evening. My mother enjoys cooking shows. She learns new dishes from them. My sister likes cartoons. She watches them after school. We have different tastes, but we often watch a movie together on weekends. What about your family?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按家庭成员逐一介绍喜欢的节目和原因。用because说明原因，用have different tastes/but we often...体现家庭差异与共同活动。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较两种电视节目（如新闻和电视剧、体育节目和综艺节目），说明它们的不同以及你更喜欢哪一种及原因。
sampleAnswer: I often watch the news and sitcoms. The news is serious and educational. It tells us what is happening in the world. Sitcoms are funny and relaxing. They make me laugh after a busy day. I like both, but I prefer sitcoms. I watch the news for about fifteen minutes a day, but I can watch sitcoms for an hour. I prefer sitcoms because I need to relax after school. However, I think watching the news is also important.
explanation: 比较两种节目时用serious/educational和funny/relaxing对比。用prefer...because...表达偏好，用However承认另一种节目的价值。

prompt: 学校正在开展“我最喜欢的电影”征文活动。请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢的一部电影，包括类型、主要情节、你喜欢的原因以及你从中学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: My favourite movie is Zootopia. It is an animated comedy. The story is about a rabbit police officer and a fox. They work together to solve a case. The movie is funny and exciting. I like it because the characters are lovely and the story is full of surprises. From this movie, I learn that we should not judge others by their appearance. Everyone can be anything they want. It is a great movie for both children and adults.
explanation: 按类型、情节、原因、收获介绍电影。用I like it because...说明原因，用I learn that...写收获，使影评有深度。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学最喜欢的电视节目类型的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about favourite TV shows in our class. There are 40 students. Fifteen students like sports shows best. Ten students like cartoons. Eight students like sitcoms. The other students like the news or talk shows. I find that sports shows are the most popular. I think it is because sports are exciting and students need to relax. However, I suggest students watch educational shows sometimes. They can learn something new.
explanation: 调查报道要写清人数、结果和看法。用Fifteen/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I suggest...提出建议。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter每天花很多时间看电视，影响了学习和睡眠。请给他写一封邮件，建议他合理安排看电视的时间，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I am worried about you. You spend too much time watching TV every day. You often stay up late and feel tired in class. I think you should watch TV for no more than one hour a day. Please finish your homework first. Then you can watch a show to relax. You should go to bed before 10:00. Too much TV is bad for your eyes and your study. I hope you can try my advice.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议信先表达关心，再指出问题，用should/please提出具体建议，用is bad for...说明理由。语气友好，避免说教。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一档你推荐给同学们的电视节目。内容包括：节目名称、类型、内容、推荐理由以及适合什么人群观看。
sampleAnswer: I want to recommend a TV show called Chinese Poetry Competition. It is a cultural show. In the show, students compete by reciting poems and answering questions about poetry. The show is educational and interesting. I recommend it because it helps us learn Chinese culture and improve our language skills. It is suitable for students and people who love poetry. I think everyone can learn something from it. Don't miss it!
explanation: 推荐节目要写清名称、类型、内容和理由。用because说明推荐原因，用suitable for...说明适合人群，结尾用Don't miss it!增强推荐语气。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述你和家人一起看电视的一个晚上。内容包括：你们看了什么节目、每个人的反应以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last Saturday evening, my family watched a comedy show together. My father laughed loudly at the funny jokes. My mother smiled and said the actors were great. My sister and I couldn't stop laughing. After the show, we talked about our favourite parts. It was a happy evening. I felt warm because we were together. Sometimes watching TV with family is not just about the show. It is about spending time together.
explanation: 用一般过去时描述家庭看电视的晚上。写清节目和每个人的反应，用laughed/smiled/couldn't stop laughing增加画面感，结尾升华主题。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“中学生是否应该看电视”的看法。内容包括：你的观点、至少两个理由以及你的建议。
sampleAnswer: I think middle school students can watch TV, but they should not watch too much. First, good TV shows can help us learn. For example, the news and documentaries can open our eyes. Second, watching TV is a good way to relax after a busy day. However, too much TV is bad for our eyes and study. I suggest students watch TV for no more than one hour a day. They should finish their homework first. In this way, TV can be both useful and fun.
explanation: 观点类短文先表明态度，用First/Second给出理由，用For example举例，用However指出问题，用I suggest...提出建议。

prompt: 假设你是学校电影社团的负责人，请写一则英文招新广告。内容包括：社团活动内容、活动时间和地点、会员福利以及报名方式。
sampleAnswer:
Movie Club Wants You!
Do you like watching movies? Come and join our movie club! We watch a great movie every Friday afternoon from 4:00 to 5:30 in Room 302. After the movie, we talk about the story and share our ideas. Members can also vote for the next movie. It is a great chance to make friends and improve your English. Please email us at movieclub@school.com before next Wednesday. Join us and enjoy the magic of movies!
explanation: 招新广告要有标题、活动内容、时间地点、福利和报名方式。用every Friday afternoon/from...to...说明时间，用email...before...给出报名方式。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你的梦想职业。内容包括：你想做什么工作、为什么想做这份工作以及你打算如何实现这个梦想。
sampleAnswer: My dream job is to be a doctor. I want to be a doctor because I want to help sick people and save lives. Doctors are important to society. To make my dream come true, I am going to study hard, especially science and English. I will read more books about medicine. I am also going to exercise every day to keep healthy. I believe that if I work hard, my dream will come true one day.
explanation: 围绕梦想职业，按“是什么—为什么—怎么做”组织。使用be going to/will表达计划，用because说明原因，结尾表达信心。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解你未来的计划。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你明年打算做什么、为什么这样计划以及你希望取得什么成果。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I am glad to tell you about my plans for next year. I am going to study English harder because I want to communicate with people from other countries. I will join the English club and practise speaking every week. I am also going to read more English books. I hope to improve my English and make new friends. What are your plans for next year?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件介绍未来计划，用be going to/will表达打算。按计划、原因、期望组织，结尾提问以保持交流。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你的新年决心。内容包括：至少三个决心、你打算如何做到以及你为什么选择这些决心。
sampleAnswer: The new year is coming. I have made three resolutions. First, I am going to get up earlier and exercise every morning. Second, I will spend less time playing computer games and more time reading. Third, I am going to help my parents with housework twice a week. I choose these resolutions because I want to be healthier, learn more and become more responsible. I will try my best to keep them.
explanation: 按First/Second/Third列出决心，用be going to/will说明做法。用because说明选择原因，结尾表达坚持的决心。

prompt: 学校正在开展“我的未来”主题活动。请写一篇短文，介绍十年后你希望自己是什么样子。内容包括：你的职业、生活地点、爱好以及你为此做的准备。
sampleAnswer: In ten years, I hope to be a computer programmer. I want to live in a big city and work for a technology company. I will have a small apartment and a pet dog. In my free time, I will travel and take photos. To prepare for this future, I am going to study computer science and maths hard. I will also learn English well. I believe my future will be bright if I work hard now.
explanation: 描述十年后的自己，用will/I hope to表达未来。按职业、地点、生活、准备组织，结尾用if条件句表达努力与未来的关系。

prompt:
请根据下面的调查表，写一篇短文介绍你们班同学理想职业的调查结果。
调查人数：40
想当医生：10人
想当教师：8人
想当程序员：7人
想当运动员：5人
其他：10人
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about dream jobs in our class. There are 40 students. Ten students want to be doctors. Eight students want to be teachers. Seven students want to be computer programmers. Five students want to be athletes. The other ten students have different dream jobs, such as singers and writers. I find that doctors are the most popular choice. I think it is because doctors can help people and save lives. Everyone should work hard for their dreams.
explanation: 调查报道要写清人数、数据和发现。用Ten/Eight/Seven/Five students列出结果，用I find that...总结，用because说明原因。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter对未来感到迷茫，不知道自己想做什么。请给他写一封邮件，建议他如何发现自己的兴趣和梦想，并鼓励他。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I am sorry to hear that you feel lost about the future. Don't worry. Many people feel the same way. I think you can start by finding what you enjoy. Try different activities, such as sports, music and reading. You can also talk to your parents and teachers. They may give you useful advice. Remember, it is okay not to know everything now. Take your time and believe in yourself. You will find your way.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议信先表达理解，再提出发现兴趣的方法，如try different activities/talk to...。用Remember...和believe in yourself鼓励对方。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你为了实现梦想而制定的一个具体计划。内容包括：你的梦想、你打算在接下来一年里做什么以及你如何检查自己的进步。
sampleAnswer: My dream is to be a writer. To make it come true, I have made a plan for the next year. First, I am going to read at least one book every month. Second, I will write a short passage every week. Third, I will join the school writing club. To check my progress, I will keep a notebook and write down what I have learned. I will also ask my teacher for advice. I believe practice makes perfect.
explanation: 按梦想、计划、检查进步组织。用First/Second/Third列出具体行动，用keep a notebook/ask my teacher说明检查方式，结尾用谚语总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较你和你的朋友对未来职业的不同想法，并说明你更欣赏谁的想法及原因。
sampleAnswer: My friend Mike and I have different ideas about future jobs. Mike wants to be a professional basketball player. He loves sports and practises every day. I want to be a teacher because I like helping children learn. Mike's dream is exciting, but it is hard to become a professional player. My dream is more practical. However, I admire Mike because he is brave and works hard for his dream. I think both dreams are wonderful as long as we try our best.
explanation: 比较两人未来职业，用wants to be/because说明各自想法。用more practical/However/I admire...表达评价，结尾点明努力的重要性。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们学校上周举办的“职业体验日”活动。内容包括：活动时间、活动内容、学生感受以及活动的意义。
sampleAnswer: Last Friday, our school held a Career Day. Many guests came to our school. They were doctors, teachers, engineers and cooks. They talked about their jobs and showed us what they do every day. Students asked many questions. Some students even tried simple tasks, such as cooking and fixing a small machine. Many students said the activity was interesting and useful. The Career Day helped us learn about different jobs and think about our future. It was a meaningful activity.
explanation: 报道活动要写清时间、内容、感受和意义。用They talked/showed...说明活动，用said...引用感受，用helped us...总结意义。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你想象中的未来生活。内容包括：未来的交通、住房、学习和娱乐方式，以及你对未来生活的感受。
sampleAnswer: In the future, I think life will be very different. People will travel in flying cars, and the roads will be in the sky. Houses will be smarter. Robots will do most of the housework. Students will study at home on computers, and they will talk to teachers online. In their free time, people will play games in virtual reality. I think future life will be convenient and exciting. However, I hope people will still spend time with their families and enjoy nature.
explanation: 使用will表达对未来生活的预测。按交通、住房、学习、娱乐分方面描述，最后表达感受并适当加入自己的期望，使文章有层次。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解你对未来学校的设想。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你想象中的未来学校是什么样子，包括教室、课程和学习方式。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I want to tell you about my idea of the future school. In the future, classrooms will be bigger and more modern. Every student will have a computer. There will be no paper books because students will read on screens. The courses will be more interesting. Students can choose subjects they like. They will also learn online and talk to experts around the world. I think school will be more fun and personal. What do you think?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件介绍未来学校，用will描述变化，按教室、课程、学习方式组织。用because/also使句子衔接自然，结尾询问对方看法。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较现在的生活和50年前的生活。内容包括：交通、通信、娱乐方式的不同，以及你认为哪种生活更好及原因。
sampleAnswer: Life today is very different from life 50 years ago. In the past, people travelled by bike or bus. Now they can take high-speed trains and planes. In the past, people wrote letters to communicate. Now they use phones and the Internet. Entertainment has also changed. People used to listen to the radio, but now they watch videos online. I think life today is better because it is more convenient. However, people in the past had more time to talk face to face.
explanation: 比较过去和现在，用In the past/Now对比。使用used to结构。最后表达观点，同时承认过去生活的优点，使比较更客观。

prompt: 学校正在开展“科技改变生活”主题活动。请写一篇短文，介绍一项你最喜欢的科技发明，说明它如何改变人们的生活以及你对它的看法。
sampleAnswer: My favourite invention is the smartphone. It has changed our lives in many ways. First, we can communicate with others easily. We can make calls, send messages and make video calls. Second, we can use it to study. We can look up information and take online classes. Third, it makes our life more fun. We can listen to music and watch videos. However, some people use it too much. I think we should use it wisely and not let it control our lives.
explanation: 按“发明—改变—看法”组织。用First/Second/Third说明改变，用However指出问题，用I think...表达合理使用科技的观点。

prompt: 假设你是一名未来学家，请写一篇短文，预测2050年人们的生活。内容包括：人们如何工作、如何学习、如何旅行以及可能面临的问题。
sampleAnswer: In 2050, people will work in different ways. Many people will work from home and use computers to have meetings. Students will learn online and use virtual reality to visit places. People will travel in self-driving cars and even in space. However, there will also be problems. Some people may lose their jobs because robots will do many things. The environment may be worse if we don't protect it. I hope we can use technology to make life better, not worse.
explanation: 用will预测2050年的生活，按工作、学习、旅行分方面。用However引出问题，结尾用I hope...表达对科技发展的期望。

prompt: 你的朋友Linda对未来感到担心，害怕机器人会取代人类的工作。请给她写一封邮件，安慰她并表达你对未来科技的看法。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Linda,
I understand your worry about the future. It is true that robots will do many jobs. But I don't think they will replace all human workers. Robots can do dangerous or repetitive work, but they cannot think or feel like humans. People will still be needed for creative jobs and jobs that need care and communication. We should learn new skills and be ready for change. I believe the future will be full of chances if we keep learning.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 安慰信先理解对方担忧，再用but表达不同看法。用cannot think or feel/creative jobs等说明人类优势，结尾鼓励学习新技能。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你希望未来出现的一项新发明。内容包括：它是什么、它能做什么、它如何帮助人们以及你为什么希望它出现。
sampleAnswer: I hope a new invention called the “health helper” will appear in the future. It is a small robot that can check people's health every day. It can measure body temperature, heart rate and blood pressure. If there is a problem, it will remind people to see a doctor. It can also give advice on food and exercise. I hope it will appear because it can help old people and sick people live better. It will make health care easier and cheaper.
explanation: 按发明名称、功能、帮助、愿望组织。用can/if/will说明功能，用because说明希望它出现的原因，突出实用价值。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“未来是否会有机器人朋友”的看法。内容包括：你的观点、至少两个理由以及机器人朋友可能带来的问题。
sampleAnswer: I think people may have robot friends in the future. On the one hand, robots can talk with us and help us when we are lonely. They can also remind us to do things and keep us safe. On the other hand, robot friends cannot truly understand human feelings. If people spend too much time with robots, they may forget how to communicate with real people. I think robots can be helpers, but they cannot replace human friends. Real friendship needs love and understanding.
explanation: 观点类短文用On the one hand/On the other hand分析利弊。最后表明立场：机器人可以是助手但不能替代人类朋友。用needs love and understanding总结。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“未来生活”的想象调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要预测和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about future life in our class. There are 40 students. Twenty students think people will live in smart homes. Fifteen students believe robots will do most housework. Ten students think students will study online at home. The other students think people will travel in flying cars. I find that most students are optimistic about the future. I think technology will make life easier, but we should also protect the environment and care for each other.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、预测和看法。用Twenty/Fifteen/Ten students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用but提出平衡观点。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你想象中未来的家。内容包括：家的样子、有哪些智能设备、这些设备如何帮助你和家人以及你对这种家的感受。
sampleAnswer: I imagine my future home will be a smart house. It will have a robot helper that can clean and cook. The lights will turn on and off automatically. The windows will change colour to keep the house cool in summer and warm in winter. A smart screen on the wall will show the weather, news and family plans. My family will feel safe and comfortable there. I think a smart home will give us more free time to enjoy life together.
explanation: 按家的样子、智能设备、帮助、感受组织。用will描述未来，用can/that从句说明设备功能，结尾表达对智能家庭的期待。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢的一道菜。内容包括：菜名、所需食材、制作步骤以及你喜欢它的原因。
sampleAnswer: My favourite dish is tomato and egg noodles. To make it, I need two tomatoes, two eggs, some noodles and a little salt. First, cut the tomatoes into pieces. Next, beat the eggs and cook them in a pan. Then, put the tomatoes in the pan and cook for a few minutes. After that, add water and boil it. Finally, put the noodles in the soup and cook for five minutes. I like this dish because it is easy to make, healthy and delicious.
explanation: 按菜名、食材、步骤、原因组织。使用First/Next/Then/After that/Finally等顺序词，步骤清楚。注意祈使句和量词表达。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想学做一道中国菜。请给他写一封邮件，介绍一道简单的中国菜的做法，包括食材和步骤。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I am happy to teach you a simple Chinese dish: egg fried rice. You need two eggs, a bowl of rice, some green onions and a little salt. First, beat the eggs. Next, heat some oil in a pan and cook the eggs. Then, add the rice and mix it well. After that, put in the green onions and salt. Finally, cook for two more minutes. It is easy and delicious. I hope you can try it.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件介绍菜谱，按食材和步骤展开。用First/Next/Then/After that/Finally使步骤清晰。用You need...列出食材，语气友好。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次你为家人做饭的经历。内容包括：你做了什么菜、制作过程、家人的反应以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last Sunday, I cooked dinner for my family. I made tomato and egg soup. First, I washed the tomatoes and cut them into pieces. Then I beat two eggs and cooked them in a pot. After that, I added water and put in the tomatoes. I cooked the soup for ten minutes and added a little salt. My parents said the soup was delicious. I felt very happy and proud. Cooking for my family was a wonderful experience.
explanation: 用一般过去时描述做饭经历。按制作过程、家人反应、感受组织。用First/Then/After that衔接，注意动词过去式。

prompt: 学校正在开展“健康饮食”主题活动。请写一篇短文，介绍你的一日三餐，并说明你的饮食是否健康及原因。
sampleAnswer: I have three meals a day. For breakfast, I usually have an egg, some bread and a glass of milk. For lunch, I eat rice, vegetables and some meat. For dinner, I have noodles or soup with vegetables. I hardly ever eat junk food. I drink a lot of water every day. I think my diet is healthy because I eat enough vegetables and fruit, and I don't eat too much sugar or fat. A healthy diet helps me stay energetic.
explanation: 按一日三餐介绍饮食，用usually/hardly ever/a lot of说明习惯。评价饮食时用because说明原因，结尾点明健康饮食的好处。

prompt: 假设你是学校食堂的负责人，请写一篇短文，介绍食堂新推出的一款健康套餐。内容包括：套餐内容、价格、推荐理由以及供应时间。
sampleAnswer: Our school dining hall has a new healthy set meal. It includes rice, chicken, carrots, broccoli and an apple. It also comes with a bottle of water. The price is only 12 yuan. We recommend it because it has enough vegetables and protein, and it is not too oily. It is good for students' health. The set meal is available from Monday to Friday at lunchtime. Come and try it. You will like it.
explanation: 介绍套餐按内容、价格、理由、供应时间组织。用includes/comes with说明内容，用because说明推荐理由，用available说明时间。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter经常吃快餐，不喜欢吃蔬菜。请给他写一封邮件，建议他养成健康的饮食习惯，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I am worried about your eating habits. You often eat fast food and hardly ever eat vegetables. I think you should change your diet. First, try to eat more vegetables and fruit every day. They are good for your health. Second, don't eat too much fast food. It has a lot of fat and sugar. Third, drink water instead of sweet drinks. A healthy diet can help you study better and feel happier. I hope you can try my advice.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议信先表达关心，再指出问题，用First/Second/Third提出具体建议，用can help you...说明理由。语气友好，避免指责。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一种你家乡的传统食物。内容包括：食物名称、主要食材、制作方法以及它在节日或家庭中的意义。
sampleAnswer: My hometown is famous for zongzi. It is a traditional food for the Dragon Boat Festival. To make zongzi, we need glutinous rice, bamboo leaves and red dates. First, wash the bamboo leaves and the rice. Then, put the rice and dates on a leaf and wrap it into a triangle. Next, tie it with a string. Finally, boil the zongzi for about two hours. Zongzi is not just food. It brings families together and reminds us of our culture.
explanation: 按名称、食材、制作方法、意义组织。使用First/Then/Next/Finally顺序词。结尾用not just food/brings families together提升文化意义。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较健康食品和垃圾食品。内容包括：它们分别有哪些、对健康的影响以及你更常吃哪一种及原因。
sampleAnswer: Healthy food and junk food are very different. Healthy food includes vegetables, fruit, milk and whole grains. It gives us energy and keeps us strong. Junk food includes hamburgers, chips and sweet drinks. It has a lot of fat and sugar, and it is bad for our health. I eat healthy food most of the time because I want to stay fit. However, I sometimes eat junk food with friends. I think we can enjoy it once in a while, but we should not eat it every day.
explanation: 比较两类食品，用includes说明内容，用keeps us strong/is bad for our health说明影响。用most of the time/because表达习惯和原因，结尾提出平衡观点。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最喜欢的食物”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about favourite food in our class. There are 40 students. Fifteen students like noodles best. Ten students like dumplings. Eight students like fried chicken. The other students like rice or hamburgers. I find that Chinese food is more popular than fast food. I think it is a good thing because Chinese food is usually healthier. However, some students eat too much fried food. I suggest they eat more vegetables and fruit.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和看法。用Fifteen/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I suggest...提出建议。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你理想中的学校午餐。内容包括：你希望午餐有哪些食物、为什么这些食物重要以及你希望学校食堂做出哪些改变。
sampleAnswer: I hope our school lunch can be healthier and more delicious. I want to see more vegetables, fruit and fish on the menu. These foods are important because they give us vitamins and protein. They help us grow and study well. I also hope the dining hall can offer less fried food and fewer sweet drinks. Maybe students can choose their own dishes. If the food is healthy and tasty, we will enjoy lunch more and feel better in class.
explanation: 按希望的食物、重要性、改变组织。用I hope/I want to see...表达愿望，用because说明重要性，用If...will...说明改变带来的结果。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你为朋友准备的一次生日聚会。内容包括：聚会的时间、地点、邀请了谁、准备了什么以及聚会上将做什么。
sampleAnswer: Next Saturday is my friend Li Ming's birthday. I am going to have a birthday party for him at my home. I will invite five of his good friends. I have prepared a big cake, some fruit and drinks. We will play games, sing songs and watch a movie. I will also give him a book as a gift because he likes reading. I hope he will have a great time at the party.
explanation: 使用be going to/will表达聚会计划。按时间、地点、邀请对象、准备物品、活动组织。用because说明礼物选择的原因，结尾表达希望。

prompt: 你的朋友邀请你参加他/她本周日的聚会，但你因为有事不能去。请给他/她写一封邮件，礼貌地拒绝邀请，说明原因并表达歉意。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Amy,
Thank you for inviting me to your party this Sunday. I would love to come, but I am afraid I can't. On Sunday morning, I have to go to the hospital with my grandmother. She needs a check-up. In the afternoon, I have a piano lesson. I am really sorry that I can't join you. I hope you will have a wonderful party. Let's meet another day.
Yours,
Lily
explanation: 拒绝邀请要礼貌，先感谢邀请，用I would love to...but I can't表达遗憾，再说明具体原因，最后表达歉意和祝愿。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你如何为一次班级野餐做准备。内容包括：你需要准备什么、如何分工、以及你对这次野餐的期待。
sampleAnswer: Our class is going to have a picnic next Friday. We need to prepare many things. I am going to bring some fruit and drinks. Li Ming will bring a big blanket. Wang Fang will make some sandwiches. Tom is going to bring a football for us to play with. We will meet at the school gate at 9:00 and take the bus to the park. I am looking forward to the picnic. I am sure we will have a great time.
explanation: 使用be going to/will表达准备分工。按物品、分工、期待组织。用I am looking forward to...表达期待，用I am sure...表达信心。

prompt: 假设你是班长，请写一则英文通知，告诉同学们下周三下午将举行一次班级聚会，包括时间、地点、活动内容和需要带的东西。
sampleAnswer:
Notice
Dear classmates,
We will have a class party next Wednesday afternoon. It will be in our classroom from 3:00 to 5:00. We will play games, sing songs and share snacks. There will also be a small talent show. If you want to perform, please tell me before Monday. Please bring some snacks and drinks. Don't bring too many sweets. I hope everyone can come and enjoy the party.
The Class Monitor
explanation: 通知要有标题、称呼、发布者。写清时间、地点、活动和要求。用will表达安排，用If...please...提出条件，用Please bring...说明需要带的东西。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述你参加的一次聚会。内容包括：聚会的主题、你做了什么、你遇到了谁以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last Saturday, I went to a costume party at my friend Tony's home. The theme was "Movies and Books". I dressed up as Harry Potter. There were about fifteen people at the party. I met some new friends. We played games and took photos. I also won a small prize in a quiz. The party was fun and exciting. I felt happy because I made new friends and enjoyed a wonderful evening. I hope to go to another party soon.
explanation: 用一般过去时描述聚会经历。按主题、活动、遇见的人、感受组织。用dressed up as/played/took/won增加细节，结尾表达感受和期待。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国学生如何庆祝毕业。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你们班的毕业聚会计划，包括时间、地点、活动和你的感受。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
Our class is going to have a graduation party next month. It will be at a restaurant near our school. All the students and teachers will come. We will have dinner together and watch a video about our school life. Some students will sing and dance. We will also give thank-you cards to our teachers. I am excited about the party, but I also feel a little sad because we will leave school soon. I will never forget my classmates.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件介绍毕业聚会，用be going to/will表达计划。按时间、地点、活动、感受组织。用excited but a little sad体现复杂心情，使文章真实。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你收到过的一次难忘的邀请。内容包括：谁邀请你、邀请你去做什么、你当时的心情以及那次经历。
sampleAnswer: Last month, my friend Wang Fang invited me to her family dinner. She said her parents wanted to meet me. I was surprised and a little nervous. On that day, I brought some fruit. Her parents were very friendly. We had a delicious dinner and talked about school. Her mother also taught me how to make dumplings. I felt warm and happy. It was a special invitation because it made me feel like part of her family.
explanation: 用一般过去时描述难忘的邀请。按邀请人、内容、心情、经历组织。用surprised/nervous/warm/happy描写心情变化，结尾点明难忘原因。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语俱乐部的负责人，请写一封邀请信，邀请外教Mr. Smith参加俱乐部举办的英语角活动，包括时间、地点、活动内容和希望他做的事情。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Mr. Smith,
We would like to invite you to our English Corner. It will be held next Friday afternoon from 4:00 to 5:30 in the school library. Students will talk about their favourite books and share stories. We will also play some English games. We hope you can join us and share some stories about your country. The students will be very happy to talk with you. Please let us know if you can come.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
explanation: 邀请信要礼貌，先发出邀请，再写清时间、地点、内容和希望对方做的事。用We would like to invite.../We hope you can.../Please let us know...，语气正式友好。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较两种聚会方式：在家里聚会和在餐厅聚会。内容包括它们各自的优缺点以及你更喜欢哪一种及原因。
sampleAnswer: Having a party at home and having a party at a restaurant are different. A home party is cheaper and more relaxed. You can play music and games freely. But you have to clean the house before and after the party. A restaurant party is more convenient because you don't need to cook or clean. But it is more expensive and less private. I prefer a home party because it feels warmer and more personal. I can prepare food and games for my friends.
explanation: 比较两种聚会方式，用cheaper/more relaxed/more convenient/more expensive等比较级。用But连接优缺点，用prefer...because...表达偏好和原因。

prompt: 你的朋友邀请你参加他的聚会，但你需要征求父母的意见。请写一篇短文，描述你如何与父母沟通，以及最终的结果和你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last week, my friend Mike invited me to his birthday party. I wanted to go, but I needed to ask my parents first. I told them about the party. They asked me some questions: Where is the party? Who will be there? When will it end? I answered all their questions. They said I could go if I came home before 9:00. I promised to be back on time. I was happy that my parents trusted me. I learned that communication is important.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述与父母沟通的过程。按邀请、沟通、结果、感受组织。用asked/answered/said/promised等动词，用I learned that...总结收获。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“If you have a problem, who will you talk to?”这个问题的看法。内容包括：你会和谁谈、为什么选择这个人以及他/她会如何帮助你。
sampleAnswer: If I have a problem, I will talk to my mother. I choose her because she is patient and always listens to me carefully. She never judges me. If I tell her my problem, she will help me think of ways to solve it. Sometimes she shares her own experiences. If I feel sad, she will comfort me and make me feel better. I think talking to someone you trust is very important when you have a problem.
explanation: 使用第一条件句（If...will...）表达假设。按“和谁谈—为什么—如何帮助”组织，用because/If...will...说明原因和结果。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter想参加学校的英语演讲比赛，但他很害怕在众人面前讲话。请给他写一封邮件，鼓励他参加，并说明如果参加会有什么好处。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I heard that you want to join the English speech contest but you are afraid. I think you should try it. If you take part in the contest, you will improve your English and become more confident. If you practise every day, you will speak better and better. Even if you don't win, you will learn a lot from the experience. I will help you practise if you want. Please believe in yourself. You can do it!
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 鼓励信先理解对方的恐惧，再用If...will...说明参加的好处。用Even if...说明即使失败也有收获，结尾表达支持和鼓励。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈如果你有1000元零花钱，你会怎么使用。内容包括：你打算买什么、为什么这样花以及你认为这样花钱是否合理。
sampleAnswer: If I have 1,000 yuan, I will use it carefully. First, I will buy some books because I love reading. Second, I will buy a gift for my parents. They work hard for me, so I want to thank them. Third, I will save some money for the future. I think this plan is reasonable because I spend money on useful things and show love to my family. If I save some money, I will have enough for something I really need later.
explanation: 用If I have...I will...表达假设。按购物、家人、储蓄组织，用because说明理由。结尾用If...will...说明储蓄的好处，使计划更完整。

prompt: 假设你正在和你的朋友讨论周末计划。请写一篇对话或短文，描述你们讨论去公园野餐还是去电影院，以及你们最终的决定和理由。
sampleAnswer: Last Friday, my friend Mike and I talked about our weekend plan. Mike wanted to go to the movies. I wanted to have a picnic in the park. I said, "If we go to the park, we can enjoy the fresh air and play games." Mike said, "If we go to the movies, we can watch a new film." In the end, we decided to have a picnic because the weather will be sunny. If it rains, we will go to the movies instead. We are both happy with our plan.
explanation: 用If...can/will表达条件与结果。通过对话呈现不同意见，用In the end/If it rains说明决定和备选方案，使计划更灵活。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈如果你考试没考好，你会怎么做。内容包括：你的第一反应、你会采取的行动以及你从这件事中学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: If I don't do well in an exam, I will feel sad at first. But I won't give up. I will look at my mistakes carefully and find out why I made them. Then I will ask my teacher or classmates for help. I will also make a study plan and work harder. From this experience, I learn that failure is not the end. If I learn from my mistakes, I will do better next time. It is important to stay positive.
explanation: 用If...will表达假设和应对方式。按第一反应、行动、收获组织。用But/I won't give up体现积极态度，用If I learn...I will...总结道理。

prompt: 你的朋友Lisa想养一只宠物狗，但她的父母不同意。请给她写一封邮件，建议她如何与父母沟通，并说明如果她好好沟通，可能会有什么结果。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lisa,
I understand that you want a pet dog, but your parents don't agree. I think you should talk to them calmly. First, ask them why they don't agree. Maybe they worry about the time and money. Then, tell them you will take care of the dog. If you make a plan for feeding and walking the dog, they may feel better. If you show them you are responsible, they may say yes. Even if they still say no, you will learn how to communicate better.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议邮件先理解对方处境，用First/Then提出沟通步骤。用If...may...说明可能的结果，用Even if...说明沟通本身的价值。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你认为中学生是否应该做家务。内容包括：你的观点、至少两个理由以及如果你有孩子，你会怎样要求他们。
sampleAnswer: I think middle school students should do housework. First, doing housework helps us learn life skills. We need to cook, clean and wash clothes when we grow up. Second, it teaches us to be responsible and helps our parents. If we share the housework, our parents will feel happier and less tired. If I have children in the future, I will ask them to do simple chores from a young age. I will also do housework with them and make it fun.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second给出理由。用If we share.../If I have children...表达假设和做法，使论证从现实延伸到未来。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“遇到烦恼时你会怎么做”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的建议。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about what students do when they have problems. There are 40 students. Twenty students talk to their parents. Ten students talk to friends. Five students listen to music or do sports to relax. The other students keep their problems to themselves. I find that most students ask others for help, which is good. However, some students don't share their feelings. I suggest they talk to someone they trust. If they keep problems inside, they may feel worse. Sharing can make things better.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和建议。用Twenty/Ten/Five students列出数据，用I suggest...提出建议，用If...may...说明不分享的后果。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一个你曾经面对的选择，说明你当时有哪些选项、你最终的选择以及如果重来你会怎么做。
sampleAnswer: Last year, I had to choose between joining the basketball team and the art club. I liked both, but I could only choose one. If I joined the basketball team, I could exercise more. If I joined the art club, I could draw every day. In the end, I chose the art club because drawing makes me happy. Now I sometimes wonder what would happen if I had chosen basketball. But I don't regret my choice. If I could choose again, I would still choose art because it is my true interest.
explanation: 用If I joined...I could...描述选项和结果。用In the end/Now I wonder/what would happen if...表达思考，结尾用I don't regret/I would still...表明坚定。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你对“If you want to make a difference, what will you do?”这个问题的想法。内容包括：你想改变什么、你打算如何做以及你希望带来什么影响。
sampleAnswer: If I want to make a difference, I will start with small things. I want to make my community cleaner. First, I will not litter and I will pick up rubbish when I see it. Second, I will tell my friends and family to protect the environment. If we all do this, our community will be cleaner and more beautiful. I will also join a volunteer group. If more people join us, we can make a bigger difference. Small actions can lead to big changes.
explanation: 用If I want to...I will...表达打算。按目标、行动、影响组织。用First/Second/also使行动具体，用If...will...说明影响，结尾用Small actions can lead to big changes.总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述你或你的朋友曾经遇到的一次健康问题（如感冒、牙痛、肚子痛等）。内容包括：问题是什么、持续了多久、你如何处理以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last week, I had a bad cold. I had a headache and a sore throat. I felt very tired and didn't want to eat anything. The cold lasted for three days. My mother took me to the hospital. The doctor gave me some medicine and told me to drink more water and have a good rest. I stayed in bed and didn't go to school for two days. After that, I felt much better. I learned that health is very important. We should take good care of ourselves.
explanation: 按问题、持续时间、处理方式、感受组织。使用had/felt/took/gave/told/stayed等过去式动词。用learned that...总结健康的重要性。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom最近经常头痛，写信向你求助。请给他写一封邮件，分析可能的原因并给出至少三条建议。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I am sorry to hear that you often have headaches. I think there may be several reasons. You may study too hard and don't get enough rest. You may also spend too much time looking at your phone. Here is my advice. First, you should go to bed early and sleep for at least eight hours. Second, take a break every hour when you study. Third, drink more water and eat healthy food. If the headaches continue, you should see a doctor. I hope you feel better soon.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件先表达关心，再分析原因（may study too hard/spend too much time...），用First/Second/Third提出建议，用If...should...提醒就医。

prompt: 假设你是学校医务室的老师，请写一篇短文，向同学们介绍三种常见的意外伤害（如流鼻血、扭伤、割伤）以及处理方法。
sampleAnswer: Here is some advice on common accidents at school. If you have a nosebleed, sit down and lean your head forward. Press the sides of your nose for a few minutes. If you sprain your ankle, stop moving and put ice on it. Rest and don't walk too much. If you cut your finger, wash it with clean water and cover it with a bandage. If the cut is deep, go to the hospital at once. Please remember these tips. They can help you stay safe.
explanation: 使用第二条件句（If...do...）说明处理方法。按三种伤害分别写，用sit down/press/put ice/wash/cover等祈使句给出具体步骤。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你保持健康的方法。内容包括：饮食、运动、睡眠和心态四个方面。
sampleAnswer: I try to keep healthy in four ways. First, I eat healthy food. I eat fruit and vegetables every day and hardly ever eat junk food. Second, I exercise regularly. I run every morning and play basketball twice a week. Third, I get enough sleep. I go to bed before 10:00 and sleep for about nine hours. Fourth, I keep a good mood. When I feel stressed, I talk to my friends or listen to music. These habits make me healthy and happy.
explanation: 按饮食、运动、睡眠、心态四方面组织，用First/Second/Third/Fourth。用every day/hardly ever/twice a week等频率词，结尾总结好处。

prompt: 你的同学Mike在体育课上不小心受伤了。请写一篇短文，描述事情的经过、你如何帮助他以及你从中学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: Last Tuesday, my classmate Mike hurt his leg in PE class. He was running when he fell down. He couldn't stand up and his leg hurt badly. I ran to him and helped him sit down. I called our teacher and we took him to the hospital. The doctor said his leg was not broken, but he needed to rest for a week. I visited him after school and helped him with his homework. From this experience, I learned that we should be careful when we do sports and always help others in trouble.
explanation: 用过去进行时（was running）和一般过去时（fell/hurt/ran/helped/called/took）结合叙述。按事件经过、帮助、收获组织，结尾用I learned that...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“健康比财富更重要”这一观点的看法。
sampleAnswer: I agree that health is more important than wealth. If you are healthy, you can enjoy life, study well and do the things you love. You can spend time with your family and friends. But if you are sick, you may feel unhappy and cannot do many things, even if you have a lot of money. Money can buy medicine, but it cannot buy health. That is why we should take care of our health every day. We should eat well, exercise often and keep a positive attitude. Health is the best gift we can give ourselves.
explanation: 观点类短文先表明态度，用If you are healthy.../But if you are sick...对比说明。用Money can buy...but it cannot buy...强调观点，结尾提出保持健康的方法。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最常见的健康问题”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的建议。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about common health problems in our class. There are 40 students. Fifteen students often have colds. Ten students have headaches. Eight students have stomachaches. The other students have other problems like toothaches or back pain. I find that colds are the most common problem. I think it is because the weather changes often and some students don't wear enough clothes. I suggest students drink more water, eat healthy food and get enough sleep. If we take care of ourselves, we will have fewer health problems.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和建议。用Fifteen/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I suggest...提出建议，用If...will...说明结果。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你曾经照顾一位生病家人的经历。内容包括：谁生病了、你做了什么、你的感受以及你学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: Last month, my grandmother was sick. She had a bad cold and a fever. My parents were busy at work, so I helped take care of her. I made her some hot soup and reminded her to take her medicine. I also helped her measure her temperature. In the evening, I sat by her bed and talked with her. She said I was a good helper. I felt happy because I could do something for her. From this experience, I learned that taking care of family is important and love is shown through small actions.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述照顾家人的经历。按谁生病、做了什么、感受、收获组织。用made/reminded/helped/sat/talked等动词，结尾用I learned that...总结。

prompt: 你的朋友Lisa因为学习压力大，经常失眠。请给她写一封邮件，建议她如何放松身心、改善睡眠，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lisa,
I am sorry to hear that you often can't sleep well because of study pressure. Here is some advice for you. First, try to finish your homework earlier and don't study late at night. Second, do some exercise in the afternoon. It can help you relax. Third, listen to soft music or read a book before bed. Don't use your phone before sleeping because the light is bad for your sleep. If you follow these tips, you will sleep better and feel more energetic.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议邮件先表达理解，用First/Second/Third提出具体建议。用Don't...提醒避免不良习惯，用If...will...说明建议带来的效果。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次你参加急救知识培训的经历。内容包括：培训的时间地点、你学到了什么、你有什么感受以及你认为学习急救知识的重要性。
sampleAnswer: Last Friday, I took part in a first aid training at our school. A doctor from the hospital came to teach us. We learned how to deal with nosebleeds, cuts and sprains. We also learned how to call for help and what to do if someone faints. I practiced putting a bandage on my friend's arm. I felt nervous at first, but I learned a lot. I think first aid knowledge is very important. If we know what to do, we can help others in time and even save lives.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述培训经历。按时间地点、学习内容、感受、重要性组织。用learned how to...说明收获，用If...can...强调急救知识的重要性。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你在空闲时间最喜欢做的一件事情。内容包括：是什么、你通常什么时候做、和谁一起做以及你为什么喜欢它。
sampleAnswer: In my free time, I like reading books best. I usually read after dinner and before bed. I often read alone in my room, but sometimes I go to the library with my best friend. I like reading because it helps me relax after a busy day. I can also learn many new things from books. Reading opens a window to the world for me. It makes my free time colourful and meaningful.
explanation: 按“是什么—什么时候—和谁—为什么”组织。用usually/often/sometimes表达频率，用because说明原因，结尾点明爱好对空闲时间的意义。

prompt: 你的英国笔友John来信询问你空闲时喜欢做什么。请给他写一封回信，介绍你最喜欢的一项爱好，包括你如何开始这项爱好、你多久做一次以及它对你的影响。
sampleAnswer:
Dear John,
Thanks for your email. In my free time, I like playing the guitar best. I started learning it two years ago because I loved a song on the radio. I practise for about half an hour every day and take a lesson once a week. Playing the guitar makes me relaxed and happy. It also teaches me patience. When I play for my family, I feel proud. What is your favourite hobby?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按“爱好—如何开始—频率—影响”组织。用started...because/practise every day/once a week说明过程，用makes me relaxed/teaches me patience说明影响。

prompt: 学校英语社团正在举办“My Free Time”征文活动。请写一篇短文，介绍你的课余活动安排，并说明这些活动给你带来的好处。
sampleAnswer: My free time is colourful. After school, I usually play basketball with my classmates twice a week. On weekends, I often read books and listen to music. Sometimes I help my parents do housework. Sports keep me strong and healthy. Reading helps me learn more and understand the world better. Music helps me relax and feel calm. These activities make my life balanced and happy. I think everyone needs time to relax and enjoy hobbies.
explanation: 按活动列举和好处组织。用twice a week/often/sometimes说明频率，用keep me strong/help me learn/make me relaxed分别说明不同活动的好处，结尾总结。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学空闲时间活动的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要活动及比例以及你的发现。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about free time activities in our class. There are 40 students. Fifteen students like playing sports best. Ten students choose reading. Eight students like listening to music. The other students enjoy drawing or playing computer games. I find that sports are the most popular activity. I think it is because sports are fun and good for health. However, I also hope students can spend more time reading and less time on screens. A good balance is important.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、数据和发现。用Fifteen/Ten/Eight students列出结果，用I find that...总结，用However提出平衡建议。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较你和你朋友的空闲时间安排。内容包括：你们各自喜欢做什么、花多少时间以及你更欣赏谁的方式及原因。
sampleAnswer: My friend Mike and I spend our free time differently. I like reading and playing the piano. I usually spend about an hour reading every day and practise the piano three times a week. Mike likes playing computer games and watching videos. He spends about two hours on screens every day. I prefer my way because reading and music help me relax and learn. Mike's way is fun, but too much screen time is bad for his eyes. I hope he can try more outdoor activities.
explanation: 比较两人安排时用I like.../Mike likes...和具体时间。用prefer my way because...表达偏好和原因，用However/too much...提出关心。

prompt: 你的朋友Lisa学习压力很大，几乎没有时间放松。请给她写一封邮件，建议她合理安排空闲时间、培养一项爱好，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lisa,
I am sorry to hear that you feel stressed and have little time to relax. I think you should make some time for yourself. First, try to finish your homework earlier and plan your time carefully. Second, take up a simple hobby, such as reading, drawing or walking. Even 20 minutes a day can help you relax. Hobbies can reduce stress and make you happier. If you feel better, you will study better too. I hope you can find something you enjoy.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议信先表达理解，用First/Second提出时间管理和培养爱好的建议，用can help you relax/reduce stress说明理由，语气友好。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次你尝试新爱好的经历。内容包括：你尝试了什么、为什么尝试、过程中遇到了什么困难以及结果和感受。
sampleAnswer: Last year, I tried rock climbing for the first time. My friend invited me, and I wanted to try something exciting. At first, I was afraid of heights. My hands hurt and I wanted to give up. But my friend encouraged me and taught me how to move. I kept trying and finally reached the top. I felt proud and excited. I learned that trying new things can be scary but rewarding. Now rock climbing is one of my favourite hobbies.
