explanation: 用一般过去时叙述尝试新爱好的经历。按尝试内容、原因、困难、结果和感受组织。用At first/But/finally体现过程，用I learned that...总结收获。

prompt: 学校正在开展“健康休闲，快乐成长”主题活动。请写一篇短文，谈谈你认为中学生应该如何选择健康的空闲活动。
sampleAnswer: I think middle school students should choose healthy free time activities. First, we should choose activities that are good for our bodies, such as running, swimming and playing ball games. Second, we can choose activities that help us learn, such as reading and learning a musical instrument. Third, we should avoid spending too much time on phones and computer games. Healthy activities can make us strong, relaxed and happy. They can also help us make friends. A good hobby is a good friend for life.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second/Third提出选择标准。用such as举例，用should avoid指出应避免的活动，结尾总结健康活动的好处。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你的家庭在周末如何一起度过空闲时间。内容包括：你们通常做什么、每个人喜欢做什么以及你对家庭时光的感受。
sampleAnswer: On weekends, my family like to spend free time together. My father usually cooks a big dinner on Saturday evening. My mother likes watching movies with us. My sister and I often play board games or go cycling. Sometimes we go to the park and have a picnic. Everyone has different hobbies, but we enjoy being together. I feel warm and happy during these family times. I think family time is the best way to relax and stay close.
explanation: 按家庭活动、个人喜好、感受组织。用usually/likes/often/sometimes表达频率，用Everyone has different hobbies, but...体现差异与共同，结尾表达感受。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语俱乐部的负责人，请写一则英文招新广告，介绍俱乐部的空闲活动安排，号召同学们参加。
sampleAnswer:
English Club Is Waiting for You!
Do you want to make good use of your free time? Come and join our English club! We meet every Wednesday and Friday afternoon from 4:00 to 5:00 in Room 201. We watch English movies, sing English songs and play English games. We also have reading afternoons and short speech activities. You can improve your English and make new friends here. It is fun and useful. Please email us at englishclub@school.com to join. Don't miss the chance!
explanation: 招新广告要有标题、活动内容、时间地点和报名方式。用every Wednesday and Friday afternoon说明频率，用watch/sing/play/have列举活动，用Don't miss the chance!增强号召。

prompt: 你的朋友因为和父母意见不同而经常争吵，心情很低落。请给他写一封邮件，建议他如何管理情绪、与父母沟通，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I am sorry to hear that you often argue with your parents and feel upset. Here is some advice. First, when you feel angry, take a deep breath or take a short break. This can help you calm down. Second, try to talk to your parents when everyone is calm. Tell them how you feel and listen to their reasons. Third, remember that your parents care about you, even when they disagree with you. If you communicate with respect, you may understand each other better.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议信先表达理解，用First/Second/Third提出情绪管理和沟通建议。用take a deep breath/talk when calm/listen to reasons等具体做法，用If...may...说明结果。

prompt: 假设你是Li Ming，你的朋友Lisa因为考试失利而觉得自己很失败。请给她写一封邮件，鼓励她正确面对失败，并给出三点建议。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lisa,
I am sorry to hear that you feel bad about your exam. Please don't think you are a failure. One exam cannot decide who you are. Here are three suggestions. First, look at your mistakes and find out what you can improve. Second, ask your teacher or classmates for help. Third, make a new study plan and work step by step. Failure is a chance to learn and grow. I believe you can do better next time. Please stay positive.
Yours,
Li Ming
explanation: 鼓励信先安慰对方，再给出三点建议。用don't think you are a failure/one exam cannot decide...帮助对方调整认知，用Failure is a chance to learn and grow升华主题。

prompt: 请写一封信感谢一位对你成长帮助很大的人（老师、父母或朋友）。内容包括：他/她为你做了什么、你的变化以及你的感谢。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Mr. Wang,
I am writing to thank you for your help. Last year, I was shy and afraid to speak in class. You encouraged me to join the English speech activity. You helped me practise after school and gave me useful advice. Although I was nervous, I finally finished my speech and won a prize. Now I am more confident and I enjoy speaking English. Thank you for believing in me and supporting me. I will always remember your kindness.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 感谢信要写清感谢对象、具体帮助、自己的变化和感谢之情。用Last year/You encouraged/You helped/Now...形成变化线索，结尾表达铭记。

prompt: 你的同学经常因为小事生气，和同学关系紧张。请写一篇短文，建议他如何控制愤怒情绪，并说明这些方法的好处。
sampleAnswer: If you often get angry easily, here are some ways to control your anger. First, stop and count to ten before you say anything. This gives you time to calm down. Second, take a deep breath or drink some water. Third, talk to someone you trust about your feelings. You can also do sports to let out your energy. Controlling anger can help you avoid fights and keep good friendships. When you stay calm, you can think clearly and solve problems better. Try these methods and you will feel better.
explanation: 用First/Second/Third提出控制愤怒的方法。用This gives you time to calm down/can help you avoid fights说明好处，用When...you can...说明冷静的作用。

prompt: 假设你是学校心理社团的成员，请写一篇短文，向同学们介绍几种应对成长烦恼的方法。
sampleAnswer: Growing up brings not only joy but also worries. Here are some ways to deal with them. First, talk to your parents, teachers or friends when you feel upset. Sharing can make you feel lighter. Second, take part in sports or hobbies. They can help you relax and forget your problems for a while. Third, write down your feelings in a diary. It helps you understand yourself better. Fourth, remember that everyone has problems and it is okay to ask for help. You are not alone.
explanation: 按方法逐条组织，用First/Second/Third/Fourth。用Sharing can make you feel lighter/help you relax/understand yourself better说明作用，结尾用You are not alone给予安慰。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，讲述一次你克服消极情绪的经历。内容包括：发生了什么事、你当时的感受、你如何调整自己以及你学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: Last term, I did badly in a maths test. I felt very sad and thought I was not good at maths. For a few days, I didn't want to talk to anyone. Then I decided to change. I talked to my teacher, and she helped me find my weak points. I started to do extra practice every day and asked my classmates for help. Slowly, my grades improved. I learned that bad feelings are normal, but we can choose to take action. Asking for help is not a sign of weakness but a step towards growth.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述克服消极情绪的经历。按事件、感受、调整、收获组织。用For a few days/Then I decided/I started...体现转变，结尾用I learned that...升华。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom和父母之间有些矛盾。请给他写一封邮件，介绍中国家庭中孩子与父母沟通的常见方式，并给他一些建议。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I am sorry to hear about your problems with your parents. In China, many teenagers talk to their parents over dinner or during a walk. Some write letters or messages when talking face to face is difficult. I think you can try these ways. First, choose a good time when your parents are relaxed. Second, tell them your feelings instead of blaming them. Third, listen to their opinions patiently. Your parents may not agree with you, but they love you. With more communication, you can understand each other better.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件先介绍中国家庭的沟通方式，再给出建议。用First/Second/Third组织建议，用instead of blaming/listen patiently等表达沟通技巧，结尾强调理解。

prompt: 学校正在开展“成长感恩”主题活动。请写一篇短文，感谢父母在你的成长过程中给予的支持，并说明你将如何回报他们。
sampleAnswer: I want to thank my parents for their support in my growth. They work hard to give me a good life. When I feel sad, they listen to me and encourage me. When I make mistakes, they help me learn from them. They always believe in me. To repay them, I will study hard and try my best. I will also help with housework and spend more time with them. I will tell them I love them more often. Small actions can show my gratitude.
explanation: 感谢父母要写清具体支持和回报方式。用When...they...列举父母的帮助，用To repay them, I will...说明回报行动，结尾用Small actions can show gratitude总结。

prompt: 请写一封信感谢你的朋友在你遇到困难时给予的帮助。内容包括：你遇到了什么困难、朋友如何帮助你、你的感受以及你对友谊的理解。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Amy,
I am writing to thank you for your help when I was ill last month. I had to stay at home for a week and I was worried about my schoolwork. You came to my home after school and shared your notes with me. You also helped me with the maths problems I didn't understand. With your help, I caught up with the class. I felt very warm and grateful. I learned that a true friend is someone who stays with you when you need help. Thank you for being such a good friend.
Yours,
Lily
explanation: 感谢信按困难、帮助、感受、友谊理解组织。用came/shared/helped/caught up说明具体帮助，用With your help...说明结果，结尾点明真正的朋友。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“成长”的理解。内容包括：成长意味着什么、你在成长中最大的变化以及你想对未来的自己说什么。
sampleAnswer: For me, growing up means learning to face problems and becoming more responsible. In the past, I depended on my parents for everything. Now I can plan my study and take care of myself. I have also learned to control my feelings and communicate with others. My biggest change is that I am braver than before. I am not afraid to ask for help or try new things. To my future self, I want to say: keep learning, stay kind, and don't be afraid of failure. Every step makes you stronger.
explanation: 按成长含义、最大变化、对未来的话组织。用In the past/Now对比体现变化，用My biggest change is...突出核心，结尾用keep learning/stay kind升华。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“成长中最大的烦恼”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的建议。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about the biggest worries in our class. There are 40 students. Fifteen students say study pressure is their biggest worry. Ten students worry about relationships with friends. Eight students worry about communication with parents. The other students worry about appearance or health. I find that study pressure is the most common worry. I suggest students talk to teachers and parents, make reasonable plans and take time to relax. If we face worries together, they will become smaller.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和建议。用Fifteen/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I suggest...提出建议，用If...will...说明积极结果。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一处你亲眼看过的自然奇观。内容包括：它是什么、在哪里、它是什么样子的以及你看到它时的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last summer, I visited Huangshan Mountain in Anhui. It is one of the most famous natural wonders in China. The mountains are high and the rocks have strange shapes. I saw the famous “Guest-Greeting Pine” and clouds moving around the peaks. The scenery was like a beautiful Chinese painting. When I stood on the top, I felt amazed and proud. I realized how wonderful nature is. I hope more people can enjoy its beauty and help protect it.
explanation: 按奇观、位置、样子、感受组织。用high/strange shapes/famous pine/clouds描写景观，用When I stood...I felt amazed and proud说明感受，结尾呼吁保护。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国的自然奇观。请给他写一封邮件，介绍一处你推荐的自然景观，包括它的位置、特点以及最佳游览时间。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I want to recommend Zhangjiajie National Forest Park. It is in Hunan Province, China. It is famous for its tall stone pillars and green forests. Some pillars are over 200 metres high. The best time to visit is autumn, because the weather is cool and the colours are beautiful. You can take a cable car and walk along the glass bridge. I am sure you will be amazed by the views. I hope you can visit it one day.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按位置、特点、最佳时间、活动组织。用is famous for/tall stone pillars/over 200 metres说明特点，用The best time is...because...说明时间，结尾表达希望。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一处你家乡的自然景观。内容包括：它是什么、它的特点、它给人们带来的好处以及我们应该如何保护它。
sampleAnswer: My hometown has a beautiful river called Qinghe River. It runs through the city from north to south. The water is clear and there are many trees along the river. People like to walk, run and fish there. The river makes our city more beautiful and gives people a place to relax. However, some people throw rubbish into it. We should protect the river. We must not litter, and we should tell others to keep it clean. A clean river is a treasure for everyone.
explanation: 按景观、特点、好处、保护组织。用runs through/is clear/trees along描写特点，用makes our city beautiful/gives people a place to relax说明好处，用should/must not提出保护措施。

prompt: 假设你是导游，请写一段英文解说词，向游客介绍一处自然奇观。内容包括：景点名称、位置、主要特点、游览建议和注意事项。
sampleAnswer: Welcome to Jiuzhaigou Valley. It is in Sichuan Province, southwest China. It is famous for its colourful lakes, waterfalls and forests. The water is so clear that you can see the bottom of the lakes. I suggest you walk along the wooden paths and take your time. Please do not throw rubbish or feed the animals. The best season to visit is autumn. I hope you enjoy the wonderful views and have a safe trip.
explanation: 导游解说词要有欢迎语和结束语。按位置、特点、建议、注意事项组织。用is famous for/so clear that...描写特点，用I suggest/Please do not提出建议和要求。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较你见过的两处自然景观。内容包括：它们分别是什么、各有什么特点以及你更喜欢哪一处及原因。
sampleAnswer: I have visited a mountain and a beach. The mountain is high and quiet, with green trees and fresh air. The beach is open and sunny, with soft sand and blue water. The mountain makes me feel peaceful, while the beach makes me feel relaxed and happy. I prefer the beach because I love the sea and I enjoy swimming. However, the mountain is also wonderful. I think both places show the beauty of nature in different ways.
explanation: 比较两处景观时用high and quiet/open and sunny对比。用while连接不同感受，用prefer...because...表达偏好和原因，结尾承认两者的美。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一次你在大自然中遇到的难忘景象（如日出、彩虹、瀑布等）。内容包括：你看到了什么、当时的情况以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last summer, I saw a beautiful rainbow after a heavy rain. I was walking in the park with my mother. Suddenly, the rain stopped and the sun came out. A colourful rainbow appeared in the sky. It had seven colours and looked like a bridge. Many people stopped to take photos. I felt excited and amazed. It only lasted a few minutes, but I will never forget it. Nature can give us surprising gifts.
explanation: 用一般过去时描述难忘景象。按景象、情况、感受组织。用Suddenly/appeared/lasted增加叙事感，用Nature can give us surprising gifts总结感受。

prompt: 学校正在开展“保护自然奇观”主题活动。请写一篇短文，说明自然奇观的重要性以及我们应该如何保护它们。
sampleAnswer: Natural wonders are important to us. They make our world beautiful and give us places to relax and learn. They are also homes for animals and plants. However, many natural wonders are in danger because of pollution and human activities. We should protect them. First, we must not litter or damage them. Second, we should follow the rules when we visit. Third, we can tell others about their value. If we all take action, these wonders can be enjoyed by future generations.
explanation: 按重要性、问题、保护措施组织。用make our world beautiful/are in danger说明重要性，用First/Second/Third提出措施，用If...can...说明保护的意义。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你梦想中去探索的一处自然奇观。内容包括：它是什么、你为什么想去、你希望在那里看到什么以及你会如何保护它。
sampleAnswer: I dream of exploring the Amazon rainforest. It is the largest rainforest in the world. I want to go there because it is full of amazing plants and animals. I hope to see colourful birds, monkeys and giant trees. I also want to learn how the rainforest helps our planet. If I go there, I will follow the guide and never hurt animals or pick plants. I will also tell others to protect the rainforest. It is a treasure for all of us.
explanation: 按奇观、原因、希望看到、保护组织。用I want to/because/I hope to see...表达愿望，用If I go...I will...说明保护行动，结尾点明雨林的价值。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最想参观的自然奇观”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about natural wonders in our class. There are 40 students. Twelve students want to visit Zhangjiajie. Ten students choose Jiuzhaigou. Eight students want to see the Great Barrier Reef. The other students choose other places. I find that Chinese natural wonders are very popular. I think it is because they are beautiful and close to us. However, I also hope students can learn about wonders in other countries. Nature has no borders, and we should protect it together.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和看法。用Twelve/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用However提出拓展视野的观点。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，讲述一次你在暴风雨中的经历。内容包括：暴风雨来临时你在哪里、你正在做什么、你看到了什么以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last summer, I was caught in a sudden storm. I was walking home from school when the sky turned dark. The wind blew strongly and the rain began to pour down. I was running to a bus stop when I saw a tree fall down across the road. I felt scared and my clothes were all wet. I waited at the bus stop until the rain stopped. When I finally got home, I felt safe and warm. I learned that we should check the weather before going out.
explanation: 用过去进行时（was walking/was running）和一般过去时（turned/blew/began/saw/fell/felt）结合描述。按地点、正在做的事、所见、感受组织，结尾总结教训。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国常见的自然灾害。请给他写一封邮件，介绍一种自然灾害，包括它通常发生在哪里、什么时候以及人们如何应对。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
In China, floods are a common natural disaster. They often happen in summer when there is heavy rain. Rivers rise and water covers roads and fields. People should be careful. The government warns people before floods come. People should move to safe places and stay away from rivers. After the flood, we should help clean the streets and support those who lost their homes. Natural disasters are scary, but being prepared can save lives. What natural disasters happen in your country?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按灾害类型、发生地点和时间、应对措施组织。用often happen in summer/when there is heavy rain说明规律，用should move/stay away/help clean提出应对。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一次你经历或听说过的自然灾害（如地震、台风、洪水等）。内容包括：灾害发生的时间地点、当时的情况以及人们如何应对。
sampleAnswer: Last year, a strong typhoon hit my city. It happened in August. The wind was very strong and the rain was heavy. Trees fell down and some streets were flooded. My family stayed at home and closed all the windows. We prepared water, food and flashlights. The government warned people to stay indoors. After the typhoon, many people helped clean the streets. Although it was scary, I learned that being prepared and helping each other are very important.
explanation: 按灾害、情况、应对组织。用was very strong/fell down/were flooded描写情况，用stayed at home/prepared/warned说明应对，结尾总结准备和互助的重要性。

prompt: 学校正在开展“防灾减灾”主题活动。请写一篇短文，介绍在地震发生时你应该怎么做。
sampleAnswer: Earthquakes can happen suddenly, so it is important to know what to do. If you are indoors, stay calm and hide under a strong desk or table. Cover your head and neck with your hands. Stay away from windows and heavy furniture. Do not use the lift. If you are outdoors, move to an open area away from buildings and trees. After the earthquake, listen to the news and follow the instructions. Do not go back into damaged buildings. Being prepared can help us stay safe.
explanation: 用If...do...条件句说明不同场景下的做法。按室内、室外、震后组织，用stay calm/hide under/cover your head/stay away from等祈使句给出具体指导。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较两种应对恶劣天气的方式：提前准备和临时应对。说明它们各自的好处以及你更倾向于哪一种。
sampleAnswer: There are two ways to deal with bad weather: preparing early and reacting at the moment. Preparing early means checking the weather, storing food and water, and making a plan. It can keep us safe and reduce panic. Reacting at the moment means dealing with problems as they happen. It requires quick thinking and courage. I prefer preparing early because it is safer and helps us stay calm. However, we also need to learn how to react quickly in unexpected situations. Both ways are useful.
explanation: 比较两种方式时用preparing early/reacting at the moment对比。用can keep us safe/reduce panic说明好处，用prefer...because...表达偏好，结尾承认两者都有用。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，讲述一次恶劣天气给你或你家人的生活带来的影响。内容包括：天气怎么样、影响了什么以及你们如何解决。
sampleAnswer: Last winter, a heavy snowstorm hit our city. The snow was very deep and the roads were closed. My father couldn't drive to work, and my school was closed for two days. We lost power for a few hours. At first, we felt worried. Then we made a plan. We used candles and flashlights. We cooked simple meals and stayed warm together. We also helped our elderly neighbour by bringing her some food. The storm was difficult, but it brought our family and neighbours closer.
explanation: 用一般过去时描述影响和解决过程。按天气、影响、解决组织。用couldn't/were closed/lost power说明影响，用used/cooked/helped说明解决，结尾用brought...closer升华。

prompt: 假设你是学校安全宣传员，请写一篇短文，提醒同学们在暴雨天气中注意安全，并给出至少三条建议。
sampleAnswer: Rainstorms can be dangerous, so please pay attention to safety. First, check the weather report before you go out. If there is a heavy rain warning, stay indoors. Second, do not walk or play near rivers, lakes or low roads because the water can rise quickly. Third, if you are outside when it rains heavily, move to a safe building and wait. Do not use your phone under a tree. Finally, tell your parents where you are. Safety comes first. Please take these tips seriously and stay safe.
explanation: 安全提醒要有称呼或明确对象。用First/Second/Third/Finally提出建议，用because the water can rise quickly说明原因，用Safety comes first/Please take...seriously强调重要性。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述灾害发生后人们互相帮助的场景。内容包括：发生了什么灾害、人们如何帮助彼此以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: After a flood hit a village last summer, many people lost their homes. Volunteers came from different places to help. Some people gave food and clothes. Some helped clean the mud and repair houses. Doctors took care of sick people. I joined a group with my parents and helped carry water and boxes. Although we were tired, we felt happy. I saw the best of people in a difficult time. Helping others makes our world warmer and stronger.
explanation: 按灾害、互助、感受组织。用gave/helped/repair/took care of/carried说明具体帮助，用Although...we felt happy形成对比，结尾用Helping others makes...升华。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“人类能否战胜自然灾害”的看法。内容包括：你的观点、至少两个理由以及人类应该怎么做。
sampleAnswer: I think humans cannot fully stop natural disasters, but we can reduce their harm. First, science and technology help us predict disasters earlier. For example, weather forecasts can warn people before a storm. Second, people can prepare and work together to save lives. However, we should also respect nature. We must not cut down too many trees or pollute rivers. If we protect the environment, some disasters may become less serious. In short, we cannot control nature, but we can learn to live with it safely.
explanation: 观点类短文先表明态度：不能完全阻止，但可以减少危害。用First/Second给出理由，用However/we should respect nature提出做法，结尾用we cannot control nature, but...总结。

prompt: 假设你是Li Hua，你的新西兰笔友Nancy即将来中国游学。请给她写一封邮件，介绍中国的做客礼仪，包括见面、礼物和用餐方面的注意事项。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Nancy,
I am happy to hear that you will come to China. Let me tell you about some Chinese customs. When you visit a Chinese family, it is polite to arrive on time. You can bring a small gift, such as fruit or tea. When you receive a gift, use both hands. At the table, wait for the host to start eating first. You can try every dish, and it is okay to say you are full. Chinese people are friendly and warm. I am sure you will have a great time here.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按见面、礼物、用餐组织礼仪建议。用it is polite to arrive on time/use both hands/wait for the host说明具体礼仪，语气友好，结尾表达欢迎。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次你经历或了解到的跨文化交流中的误会。内容包括：误会是什么、为什么会发生以及最后如何解决。
sampleAnswer: Last year, an American exchange student in our class invited me to his birthday party. I arrived on time, but I found that other guests came much later. I thought I was late. Later, I learned that in his culture, it is common to arrive a little later for a party. At first, I felt a little uncomfortable, but we talked about it and laughed. I learned that different cultures have different ideas about time. Communication and understanding can help us avoid misunderstandings.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述跨文化误会。按误会、原因、解决组织。用I thought.../Later, I learned that...体现认知转变，结尾用Communication and understanding...总结启示。

prompt: 学校正在开展“文化差异与尊重”主题活动。请写一篇短文，谈谈为什么我们应该尊重不同的文化习俗，并举例说明。
sampleAnswer: We live in a world with many different cultures, so it is important to respect cultural differences. First, respecting others shows kindness and helps us make friends. Second, different customs are part of people's identity. For example, in some countries people eat with chopsticks, while in others they use forks and knives. In some cultures, people greet with a handshake, and in others they bow. There is no “best” way. If we learn about and respect these differences, we can build a more peaceful world.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second说明尊重的重要性，用For example/in some countries...while in others...举例文化差异，结尾用If...can...总结尊重差异的意义。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢的一个中国传统节日以及相关的文化习俗。内容包括：节日名称、时间、人们做什么以及你喜欢它的原因。
sampleAnswer: My favourite Chinese festival is the Spring Festival. It usually comes in January or February. Before the festival, people clean their homes and buy new clothes. On New Year's Eve, families have a big dinner together. People eat dumplings and watch the Spring Festival Gala. Children get red packets from their parents. People also visit relatives and friends. I like it because it is a time for family reunion and it brings people joy and hope for the new year.
explanation: 按节日名称、时间、习俗、原因组织。用Before the festival/On New Year's Eve/Children get...说明习俗，用because it is a time for family reunion说明原因。

prompt: 你的英国朋友Tom想了解中国的餐桌礼仪。请给他写一封邮件，介绍至少四条中国餐桌礼仪。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
Here are some Chinese table manners. First, wait for the host to start eating before you begin. Second, use your chopsticks properly and do not point them at others. Third, it is polite to try every dish, but do not take too much at once. Fourth, when you finish, you can say “I'm full” and put your chopsticks on the bowl. Also, older people usually start first. These manners show respect. I hope they help you when you visit China.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件用First/Second/Third/Fourth列出餐桌礼仪。用wait for the host/use chopsticks properly/do not point them说明具体规则，用show respect总结意义。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较中国和西方国家在问候方式上的不同，并说明你认为应该如何面对这些差异。
sampleAnswer: Greeting customs are different in China and Western countries. In China, people often shake hands or nod when they meet. Good friends may ask “Have you eaten?” to show care. In Western countries, people often shake hands too, but good friends may hug. They usually say “How are you?” and talk about the weather. These differences can sometimes cause confusion. I think we should learn about other cultures and respect their ways. When we are not sure, we can watch and ask politely. Understanding makes communication easier.
explanation: 比较问候方式时用In China/Western countries对比。用often/may说明常见做法，用I think we should...表达面对差异的态度，结尾用Understanding makes...总结。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“跨文化沟通中最重要的是什么”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about cross-cultural communication in our class. There are 40 students. Eighteen students think respect is the most important. Twelve students choose language skills. Six students think patience matters most. The other students choose open-mindedness. I find that respect is the most popular answer. I agree because respect helps us accept differences. However, language skills and patience are also important. If we respect others and try to understand them, communication will be much easier.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和看法。用Eighteen/Twelve/Six students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I agree because...表达看法，用If...will...说明结果。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次你向外国朋友介绍中国文化的经历。内容包括：你介绍了什么、对方有什么反应以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last month, an Australian exchange student named Jack came to our class. I introduced Chinese paper cutting to him. I showed him some beautiful paper cuttings and told him about their meanings. Then I taught him how to cut a simple flower. At first, he found it difficult, but he kept trying. When he finished, he was very excited and said it was amazing. I felt proud to share Chinese culture. I also learned that culture can bring people together.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述介绍中国文化的经历。按介绍内容、对方反应、感受组织。用showed/told/taught说明过程，用he was excited/I felt proud说明反应和感受。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你认为中学生应该如何成为一名合格的文化交流使者。
sampleAnswer: As middle school students, we can be good cultural ambassadors in simple ways. First, we should learn about our own culture, such as festivals, food and art. If we understand our culture well, we can explain it to others. Second, we should learn English well so we can communicate with people from other countries. Third, we should respect different cultures and be open-minded. We can also share Chinese stories with foreign friends online. Small actions can help the world understand China better.
explanation: 按了解本国文化、学好英语、尊重差异、分享故事组织。用First/Second/Third/also，用If we understand...we can...说明条件与结果，结尾用Small actions can...升华。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢的一本书。内容包括：书名、作者、主要内容、你喜欢的理由以及你从中学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: My favourite book is Charlotte's Web by E. B. White. It tells the story of a pig named Wilbur and a clever spider named Charlotte. Charlotte writes words in her web to save Wilbur's life. The story is about friendship, kindness and sacrifice. I like it because it is moving and teaches us to care for others. From this book, I learned that true friendship means helping each other without expecting anything in return. It is a wonderful book for readers of all ages.
explanation: 按书名、作者、内容、理由、收获组织。用tells the story of/is about说明内容，用I like it because...说明理由，用I learned that...写出收获。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解你最近的阅读情况。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你最近读的一本书，并推荐他读一读。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
How are you? Recently I read a book called The Little Prince. It is a famous book by a French writer. It tells the story of a little prince from another planet and his travels. The story is simple but deep. It talks about love, friendship and what is truly important in life. I recommend it to you because it is short, beautiful and full of wisdom. You can learn a lot from it. I hope you will enjoy it. What books have you read recently?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按书籍、内容、推荐理由组织。用It tells the story of/is about说明内容，用I recommend it because...说明理由，结尾提问以保持交流。

prompt: 请写一篇读书报告，介绍你读过的一本书。内容包括：书名和作者、故事简介、主要人物以及你的评价。
sampleAnswer:
My Reading Report
I have read a book called Holes by Louis Sachar. The story is about a boy named Stanley who is sent to a camp for a crime he did not commit. At the camp, the boys have to dig holes every day. Stanley makes a friend named Zero, and they discover a secret about the camp. The story is exciting and full of surprises. Stanley is brave and kind. Zero is loyal and smart. I think it is a great book because it shows the power of friendship and justice. I highly recommend it.
explanation: 读书报告要有标题，按书籍信息、简介、人物、评价组织。用The story is about.../Stanley is brave and kind说明内容与人物，用I think it is great because...给出评价。

prompt: 学校正在开展“好书推荐”活动。请写一篇短文，向同学们推荐一本你读过的好书，并说明推荐理由。
sampleAnswer: I want to recommend a book called Wonder by R. J. Palacio. It is about a boy named August who has a facial difference. He goes to a normal school for the first time and faces many challenges. At first, some students are unkind to him, but slowly they learn to see his inner beauty. The book is moving and inspiring. I recommend it because it teaches us to be kind and accept people who are different. It also reminds us that everyone deserves respect and friendship. You will not forget this story.
explanation: 按书名、内容、推荐理由组织。用is about/faces challenges/learn to see说明内容，用I recommend it because...说明理由，用reminds us that...深化主题。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你的阅读习惯。内容包括：你通常什么时候读书、喜欢读什么类型的书、你如何选择书籍以及阅读对你的影响。
sampleAnswer: I have good reading habits. I usually read for about 30 minutes before bed. On weekends, I read for an hour in the afternoon. I like storybooks, science books and books about real people. I choose books by reading the introduction and asking friends for advice. Sometimes I go to the library and look around. Reading helps me relax and learn new things. It also improves my language skills and imagination. I think reading is one of the best habits a person can have.
explanation: 按时间、类型、选书方式、影响组织。用before bed/for an hour说明时间，用I choose books by...说明选书方式，用helps me relax/improves...说明影响。

prompt: 你的同学Lisa觉得读书很无聊，只喜欢看短视频。请给她写一封邮件，建议她尝试阅读，并说明阅读的好处。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lisa,
I heard that you think reading is boring. I want to encourage you to give it a try. Reading is not just about long and difficult books. You can start with short stories or books about topics you like, such as sports, music or travel. Reading can help you relax and open your mind. It can also improve your vocabulary and writing. You can read for just 15 minutes a day. If you find the right book, I am sure you will enjoy it. I can lend you a book if you want.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议邮件先理解对方感受，用start with short stories/books about topics you like降低门槛，用can help you relax/improve your vocabulary说明好处，用If...will...鼓励尝试。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较阅读纸质书和阅读电子书的优缺点，并说明你更喜欢哪一种及原因。
sampleAnswer: Paper books and e-books both have advantages and disadvantages. Paper books are good for the eyes and give a real reading feeling. You can also write notes on them. But they are heavy and take up space. E-books are light and easy to carry. You can store thousands of books on one device. However, looking at a screen for a long time is bad for the eyes. I prefer paper books because I enjoy turning pages and the smell of paper. They help me focus better. But I also use e-books when I travel.
explanation: 比较纸质书和电子书的优缺点，用good for the eyes/heavy/light/easy to carry等对比。用prefer...because...表达偏好和原因，结尾用but also...体现灵活态度。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈阅读如何帮助你成长。内容包括：你从阅读中学到了什么、阅读如何改变了你以及你将来打算如何继续阅读。
sampleAnswer: Reading has helped me grow in many ways. From books, I have learned about courage, kindness and friendship. When I read about characters who face difficulties, I learn how to deal with my own problems. Reading has made me more patient and open-minded. It has also improved my writing. In the future, I plan to read at least one book every month. I will try different types of books and share good books with my friends. I believe reading will continue to make me a better person.
explanation: 按学到什么、如何改变、未来计划组织。用learned about/has made me...说明成长，用In the future, I plan to...说明继续阅读的计划，结尾用I believe...总结。

prompt: 假设你是学校图书馆的志愿者，请写一篇短文，向同学们介绍图书馆的阅读资源，并鼓励大家多读书。
sampleAnswer: Our school library has many wonderful reading resources. We have storybooks, science books, history books and magazines. There are also books in English for students who want to improve their language skills. You can borrow two books at a time and keep them for two weeks. The library is open from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on weekdays. Reading can open your mind and make your life richer. Come and find a book you like. You will be surprised by what you discover.
explanation: 按资源、借阅规则、开放时间、鼓励阅读组织。用have storybooks/science books/magazines说明资源，用can borrow/keep说明规则，用Reading can open your mind...鼓励阅读。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你参加的一次志愿活动。内容包括：活动内容、你做了什么、你的感受以及你对志愿服务的理解。
sampleAnswer: Last month, I took part in a volunteer activity at a nursing home. We visited old people and spent the afternoon with them. I talked with an old man and listened to his stories. I also helped clean the rooms and sang songs with other volunteers. The old people were very happy, and I felt warm and proud. I learned that volunteering is not just about giving. It is also about learning and growing. Small acts of kindness can bring big changes to others and to ourselves.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述志愿活动。按活动、行动、感受、理解组织。用talked/listened/helped clean/sang说明行动，用not just about giving/it is also about...深化理解。

prompt: 学校志愿者协会正在招募新成员。请写一封申请信，介绍你想加入的原因、你的特长以及你能为志愿服务做什么。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Sir/Madam,
I am Li Hua, a Grade 8 student. I want to join the volunteer association. I like helping others and I care about our community. I am good at organizing activities and communicating with people. I can help clean parks, visit old people and teach younger children to read. I am also patient and responsible. I hope to make a difference through my actions. Please give me a chance to serve. Thank you.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 申请信按原因、特长、能做什么组织。用I am good at.../I can help...展示能力，用I hope to make a difference...表达愿望，结尾礼貌请求。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一位你身边“做出了改变”的人。内容包括：他/她做了什么、为什么这样做以及他/她带来的影响。
sampleAnswer: My neighbour Uncle Wang is a person who makes a difference. Every weekend, he collects rubbish in the park near our community. He started doing this three years ago because he wanted to keep the park clean for children and old people. At first, some people thought it was strange. But slowly, more people joined him. Now the park is much cleaner, and many neighbours help him. Uncle Wang shows us that one person's small action can inspire others and make our community better.
explanation: 介绍人物按行动、原因、影响组织。用collects rubbish/started because...说明行动和原因，用At first/But slowly/Now体现变化和影响，结尾用one person's small action can inspire...升华。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈中学生可以通过哪些小事来“做出改变”，并说明这些小事的意义。
sampleAnswer: Middle school students can make a difference through small actions. First, we can help classmates with their studies. A few minutes of explanation can help a friend understand a difficult problem. Second, we can keep our school clean by picking up rubbish and saving water. Third, we can visit old people or help at an animal shelter. These actions may seem small, but they can bring warmth and hope to others. If everyone does a little, the world will become a better place.
explanation: 按具体小事和意义组织。用First/Second/Third列举行动，用A few minutes.../can bring warmth and hope说明意义，结尾用If everyone does a little...升华。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter认为个人的力量太小，做不了什么改变。请给他写一封邮件，鼓励他从身边小事做起，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I understand that you feel one person cannot make a difference. But I don't agree. Small actions can add up. If you pick up rubbish in the park every day, the park will become cleaner. If you help a classmate with maths, he may do better and feel happier. If you save water at home, you help protect the environment. One person may not change the whole world, but one person can change something for someone. And when others see you, they may join you. Please start with one small thing today.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 鼓励邮件先理解对方观点，用I don't agree转折。用If you...will...列举小行动带来的变化，用One person may not change...but...强调个人行动的价值，结尾鼓励行动。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班上周组织的一次社区志愿活动。内容包括：活动时间地点、活动内容和同学们的收获。
sampleAnswer: Last Saturday, our class organized a volunteer activity in the community park. We met at the park gate at 8:30 a.m. We divided into three groups. One group picked up rubbish, another group cleaned the benches and paths, and the third group helped old people carry things. We worked for about two hours. Many students said they felt tired but happy. They learned that keeping the environment clean needs everyone's effort. The activity made our community more beautiful and brought us closer together.
explanation: 报道活动写清时间地点、内容和收获。用divided into three groups/One group...another...the third...说明分工，用said they felt tired but happy引用感受，结尾总结意义。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你梦想中想创办的一个公益项目。内容包括：项目是什么、帮助谁、如何运作以及你为什么想做这件事。
sampleAnswer: I dream of starting a project called “Books for Every Child”. It would collect old books from students and give them to children in poor villages. Volunteers would sort the books and send them to schools. We would also organize reading activities and ask older students to read with younger children. I want to start this project because I love reading, and I believe every child should have books to read. A book can open a door to a bigger world. Small donations can make a big difference.
explanation: 按项目、帮助对象、运作、原因组织。用would collect/send/organize说明运作方式，用because I love reading/I believe...说明原因，结尾用A book can open a door...升华。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈志愿服务对青少年成长的意义。内容包括：志愿服务能带来什么、你自己参与志愿服务的经历以及你的建议。
sampleAnswer: Volunteering is meaningful for teenagers. It helps us learn responsibility, teamwork and empathy. It also makes us feel good when we help others. Last year, I helped at a book donation activity. I sorted books and wrote cards for children in need. Although it was simple work, I felt proud. I think every teenager should try volunteering. You can start with small things, such as helping at school events or visiting old people. If you give your time and care, you will receive happiness and growth in return.
explanation: 按意义、经历、建议组织。用helps us learn.../makes us feel good说明意义，用Last year, I helped...说明经历，用I think...should/If you give...will receive...提出建议并说明回报。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次你通过帮助他人而感受到“小行动带来大改变”的经历。
sampleAnswer: Last winter, I noticed that a new student in our class often ate lunch alone. He looked lonely and sad. I decided to sit with him and talk to him. At first, he was quiet, but slowly he opened up. We started having lunch together every day, and I introduced him to my friends. A few weeks later, he was laughing and playing with us. He told me that my small action meant a lot to him. I realized that a simple act of kindness can truly change someone's life.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述经历。按发现、行动、变化、感悟组织。用noticed/decided/sat/talked/introduced说明行动，用He told me.../I realized that...写出感悟，突出“小行动大改变”。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你保持健康的方法。内容包括：你的饮食习惯、运动习惯、睡眠习惯以及你对健康生活的看法。
sampleAnswer: I try to stay healthy in my daily life. First, I eat healthy food. I have fruit and vegetables every day, and I hardly ever eat junk food. Second, I exercise regularly. I run for twenty minutes every morning and play basketball twice a week. Third, I get enough sleep. I go to bed before 10:00 and sleep for about nine hours. I think health is very important. A healthy body helps me study better and feel happier.
explanation: 按饮食、运动、睡眠组织内容，使用First/Second/Third使条理清晰。用every day/hardly ever/twice a week等频率表达。结尾表达对健康生活的看法。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom经常感到疲倦，写信向你询问如何保持健康。请给他写一封邮件，提出至少三条建议并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I am sorry to hear that you often feel tired. Here is some advice for you. First, make sure you get enough sleep. You should go to bed before 10:30 and sleep for at least eight hours. Second, eat healthy food. Try to eat more fruit and vegetables and less junk food. Third, exercise every day. You can run, swim or play ball games. Exercise can make you strong and help you relax. I hope you will feel better soon.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议邮件先表达关心，用First/Second/Third提出睡眠、饮食、运动建议，用should/try to/can等表达建议，用can make you strong说明理由。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述你或你的朋友曾经生病的一次经历。内容包括：得了什么病、有什么症状、如何治疗以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last month, my friend Wang Fang had a bad cold. She had a headache, a sore throat and a fever. She felt very tired and didn't want to eat anything. Her mother took her to the hospital. The doctor gave her some medicine and told her to drink more water and rest at home. She stayed in bed for two days. After that, she felt much better. I visited her and helped her with her homework. I learned that we should take good care of our health.
explanation: 用一般过去时描述生病经历。按疾病、症状、治疗、感受组织。用had/felt/took/gave/told/stayed/visited/helped等过去式动词，结尾总结健康的重要性。

prompt: 假设你是学校医务室的老师，请写一篇短文，向同学们介绍三种常见意外伤害的处理方法：流鼻血、扭伤和割伤。
sampleAnswer: Here is some advice on common accidents at school. If you have a nosebleed, sit down and lean your head forward. Press the sides of your nose for a few minutes. If you sprain your ankle, stop moving and put ice on it. Rest and don't walk too much. If you cut your finger, wash it with clean water and cover it with a bandage. If the cut is deep, go to the hospital at once. Please remember these tips and stay safe.
explanation: 使用If...do...条件句说明处理方法。按流鼻血、扭伤、割伤分别写，用sit down/press/put ice/wash/cover等祈使句给出具体步骤。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter经常熬夜玩手机，白天上课没有精神。请给他写一封邮件，建议他改变不健康的生活习惯，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I am worried about you. You often stay up late playing with your phone, so you feel tired in class. I think you should change your habits. First, put your phone away before 9:30. Second, go to bed before 10:00 and sleep for eight hours. Third, do some exercise after school. Exercise can help you relax and sleep better. Enough sleep will help you study better and feel happier. I hope you can try my advice.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议信先表达关心，再指出问题，用First/Second/Third提出具体建议，用can help you relax/sleep better说明理由。语气友好，避免指责。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你参加急救知识培训的一次经历。内容包括：培训时间地点、你学到了什么、你的感受以及学习急救知识的重要性。
sampleAnswer: Last Friday, I took part in a first aid training at our school. A doctor from the hospital came to teach us. We learned how to deal with nosebleeds, cuts and sprains. We also learned how to call for help and what to do if someone faints. I practiced putting a bandage on my friend's arm. I felt nervous at first, but I learned a lot. I think first aid knowledge is very important. If we know what to do, we can help others in time and even save lives.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述培训经历。按时间地点、学习内容、感受、重要性组织。用learned how to...说明收获，用If...can...强调急救知识的重要性。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“健康比财富更重要”这一观点的看法。内容包括：你的观点、至少两个理由以及你打算如何保持健康。
sampleAnswer: I agree that health is more important than wealth. First, if you are healthy, you can enjoy life, study well and do the things you love. You can spend time with your family and friends. Second, money can buy medicine, but it cannot buy health. If you are sick, you may feel unhappy even if you have a lot of money. To stay healthy, I will eat well, exercise often and get enough sleep. I will also keep a positive attitude. Health is the best gift we can give ourselves.
explanation: 观点类短文先表明态度，用First/Second给出理由。用If you are healthy.../If you are sick...对比说明，结尾提出保持健康的具体做法。

prompt: 你的同学李华在英语学习上遇到了困难，尤其害怕开口说英语。请给他写一封邮件，分析他可能存在的问题，并给出至少三条具体的学习建议。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Li Hua,
I heard that you have trouble learning English, especially speaking. Don't worry. Here is some advice. First, practise speaking every day, even just for five minutes. You can talk to yourself or read aloud. Second, don't be afraid of making mistakes. Everyone makes mistakes when learning. Third, try to find a language partner. You can practise with a classmate after school. If you keep trying, you will become more confident and do better in English.
Yours,
Wang Ming
explanation: 建议信先表达理解，再分析问题（害怕开口），用First/Second/Third提出可操作的建议。用even just for five minutes/read aloud等细节使建议具体，用If...will...鼓励对方。

prompt: 学校英语社团正在举办“How to Be a Good Learner”征文活动。请写一篇短文，介绍你认为优秀学习者应具备的两个习惯，并举例说明。
sampleAnswer: I think a good learner should have at least two important habits. First, a good learner plans his or her study carefully. For example, I make a weekly plan and set small goals for each day. This helps me use my time well. Second, a good learner is not afraid to ask questions. When I don't understand something, I ask my teacher or classmates at once. Asking questions helps me learn faster. These two habits have made a big difference in my study.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second提出两个习惯，用For example/When I...举例说明。用This helps me/helps me learn faster说明习惯的作用，结尾总结效果。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学在学习方法上的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、最受欢迎的学习方法和你的建议。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about learning methods in our class. There are 40 students. Twenty students like taking notes in class best. Twelve students prefer studying in groups. Eight students choose making mind maps. The other students like watching online lessons. I find that taking notes is the most popular method. I think it is useful because it helps us remember key points. However, students should also try different methods and find what works best for them.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和建议。用Twenty/Twelve/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用because说明原因，用However提出拓展建议。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你曾经在学习上遇到的一次困难以及你是如何克服它的。
sampleAnswer: Last term, I had a lot of trouble with physics. I couldn't understand the formulas and did badly in the first test. I felt very upset. Then I decided to change my way of learning. I asked my teacher for help and started to do extra practice every day. I also watched some physics videos online. Slowly, I began to understand the lessons. In the next test, I got a much better grade. I learned that the right method and hard work can solve almost any learning problem.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述困难与克服过程。按困难、感受、行动、结果、收获组织。用couldn't understand/felt upset/asked for help/did extra practice说明过程，结尾用I learned that...总结。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国学生如何准备考试。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你和同学们常用的复习方法，并说明你认为最有效的一种。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
Before exams, my classmates and I use different ways to review. Some students read the textbook again and again. Some do a lot of exercises. Others study in groups and explain things to each other. I think the most effective way is making a review plan. I divide the lessons into small parts and review one part each day. This way, I don't feel stressed and I remember more. What do you do before exams?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按复习方法列举和推荐组织。用Some/Others说明不同做法，用I think the most effective way is...突出推荐，用This way/remember more说明效果，结尾提问。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈“兴趣是最好的老师”这一观点。内容包括：你是否同意、一个具体的例子以及兴趣如何帮助你学习。
sampleAnswer: I agree that interest is the best teacher. When I was in Grade 7, I didn't like English at all. But then I started watching English cartoons. I loved the stories and wanted to understand them. So I began to learn new words and practise listening. Slowly, English became my favourite subject. Interest made me want to learn, and learning became fun. If you are interested in something, you will spend more time on it and learn it better without feeling tired.
explanation: 先表明态度，用个人经历举例（started watching cartoons/wanted to understand）。用Interest made me want to learn说明兴趣的作用，结尾用If...will...总结观点。

prompt: 假设你是学习委员，请写一则英文通知，告诉同学们下周将举办一次“学习方法分享会”，包括时间、地点、分享内容和报名方式。
sampleAnswer:
Notice
Dear classmates,
We will hold a “Learning Methods Sharing Meeting” next Wednesday afternoon. It will be in our classroom from 3:30 to 5:00. Three students will share their study habits: Li Ming will talk about time management, Wang Fang will share how to take good notes, and I will talk about preparing for exams. If you want to share your ideas too, please tell me before Monday. Everyone is welcome. I hope we can learn from each other.
The Study Committee
explanation: 通知要有标题、称呼、发布者。写清时间、地点、内容和报名方式。用will share/will talk about说明安排，用If you want to...please...说明报名条件。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较“独自学习”和“小组学习”两种方式，说明它们各自的优点以及你更喜欢哪一种及原因。
sampleAnswer: Studying alone and studying in groups are both useful. When I study alone, I can focus on my own problems and work at my own speed. It is quiet and I can think deeply. When I study in a group, I can discuss difficult questions with others and learn different ideas. Group study is also more fun. I prefer studying alone for most subjects because I need quiet time to think. But for maths, I like group study because we can solve problems together. The best way is to use both.
explanation: 比较两种方式时用can focus/work at my own speed/discuss/learn different ideas说明优点。用prefer...because...表达偏好，结尾用The best way is to use both体现辩证思考。

prompt: 你的朋友Lisa想提高英语听力，但不知道从哪里开始。请给她写一封邮件，建议她每天坚持做一些简单的听力练习，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lisa,
I am glad to help you with your English listening. Here is my advice. First, listen to English for 15 minutes every day. You can listen to short stories or songs. Second, don't try to understand every word. Just catch the main idea. Third, repeat what you hear. This helps you remember pronunciation and phrases. If you keep doing this every day, your listening will improve slowly but surely. Don't give up. You can do it!
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议邮件用First/Second/Third提出具体的每日听力练习方法。用don't try to understand every word/just catch the main idea给出策略，用If you keep doing...will improve说明坚持的效果。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你从一次“失败的学习经历”中学到了什么。内容包括：发生了什么、你当时的反应以及这次经历如何改变了你。
sampleAnswer: In Grade 8, I failed an important English exam. I had studied for many hours, but I still did badly. At first, I felt angry and wanted to give up. Then I talked to my teacher. She helped me see that I was only memorizing words without using them. I changed my method. I started reading English stories and writing short passages. Slowly, my English improved. This experience taught me that working hard is not enough. We also need the right method and the courage to ask for help.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述失败经历。按事件、反应、改变、收获组织。用At first/Then体现转变，用She helped me see that...说明认知变化，结尾用taught me that...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢的一个中国传统节日。内容包括：节日名称、时间、主要习俗以及你喜欢它的原因。
sampleAnswer: My favourite Chinese festival is the Mid-Autumn Festival. It usually comes in September or October. On that day, families get together and have a big dinner. People eat mooncakes and admire the full moon. Children listen to stories about Chang'e. I like this festival because it is a time for family reunion. The mooncakes are delicious, and the full moon makes me feel peaceful. It reminds me that no matter where we are, family is always in our hearts.
explanation: 按节日名称、时间、习俗、原因组织。用usually comes in/get together/eat mooncakes/admire the full moon说明习俗，用because说明原因，结尾用reminds me that...升华。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国的传统节日。请给他写一封邮件，介绍端午节的时间、习俗以及它背后的文化意义。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
The Dragon Boat Festival is an important traditional Chinese festival. It usually falls in June. People celebrate it by making and eating zongzi, watching dragon boat races and telling the story of Qu Yuan. Qu Yuan was a great poet who loved his country. People remember him because of his loyalty and love for his country. I like this festival because it connects us with history and culture. I hope you can experience it one day.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按时间、习俗、文化意义组织。用by making/eating/watching/telling说明庆祝方式，用because of his loyalty...说明文化意义，结尾表达希望对方体验。

prompt: 学校正在开展“传统节日与传统文化”主题活动。请写一篇短文，谈谈为什么我们应该重视传统节日，并举例说明传统节日如何帮助我们了解文化。
sampleAnswer: Traditional festivals are important parts of our culture. First, they connect us with our history. For example, during the Dragon Boat Festival, we remember Qu Yuan and learn about his love for his country. Second, festivals bring families and communities together. During the Spring Festival, people travel long distances to be with their families. Third, festivals teach us values like respect, gratitude and unity. If we forget our festivals, we may lose touch with our culture. We should celebrate them and pass them on to future generations.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second/Third说明重视节日的原因，用For example/During...举例。用If we forget...may lose touch...说明不重视的后果，结尾用pass them on...提出行动。

prompt: 假设你是Li Ming，你的美国朋友Nancy对春节很感兴趣。请给她写一封邮件，介绍春节期间人们通常做什么，以及你认为春节最重要的精神是什么。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Nancy,
I am happy to tell you about the Spring Festival. Before the festival, people clean their homes and buy new clothes. On New Year's Eve, families have a big dinner together and watch the Spring Festival Gala. Children get red packets. People visit relatives and friends during the holiday. I think the most important spirit of the Spring Festival is family reunion. No matter how far we are, we try to come home. It is a time for love, gratitude and new hope.
Yours,
Li Ming
explanation: 邮件按节前、除夕、节日期间介绍习俗，用Before/On New Year's Eve/during the holiday衔接。用The most important spirit is...点明精神核心，用No matter how far...强调家庭团聚。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一个你不太熟悉但很感兴趣的外国节日。内容包括：节日名称、国家、主要活动以及你为什么想了解它。
sampleAnswer: I am very interested in Thanksgiving Day, an important festival in the United States. It falls on the fourth Thursday of November. On this day, families get together and have a big meal with turkey, potatoes and pumpkin pie. People also express thanks for the good things in their lives. I want to learn about it because I think gratitude is important for everyone. Chinese culture also values thankfulness. Learning about Thanksgiving can help me understand both cultures better and remind me to be grateful every day.
explanation: 按节日名称、国家、活动、原因组织。用falls on/have a big meal/express thanks说明活动，用because I think gratitude is important说明原因，结尾用Learning about...can help me...深化。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，讲述你参加过一次传统节日庆祝活动的经历。内容包括：什么节日、你做了什么、你的感受以及你对传统文化的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last Spring Festival, I helped my grandmother make dumplings. At first, I didn't know how to fold the dumpling skin. My grandmother showed me again and again. After many tries, I finally made a dumpling that looked nice. I felt very proud. On New Year's Eve, our whole family ate the dumplings together. I realized that making dumplings is not just about food. It is about passing down skills and spending time with family. I think we should learn traditional skills and keep our culture alive.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述节日经历。按节日、行动、感受、看法组织。用At first/After many tries/finally体现过程，用not just about food/it is about...深化意义，结尾提出传承文化的看法。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较春节和圣诞节。内容包括：它们的时间和主要习俗、它们的共同点以及你更喜欢哪一个及原因。
sampleAnswer: The Spring Festival and Christmas are both important festivals, but they are different. The Spring Festival usually comes in January or February. People have family dinners, eat dumplings and give red packets. Christmas is on December 25th. People decorate trees, give gifts and have big meals. Both festivals are about family, love and giving. I like the Spring Festival better because it is part of my culture. The red packets, dumplings and family reunion make me feel warm and connected to my roots.
explanation: 比较两个节日时用usually comes in/on December 25th说明时间，用have family dinners/decorate trees说明习俗，用Both...are about...说明共同点，用prefer...because...表达偏好。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最喜欢的传统节日”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的发现。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about favourite traditional festivals in our class. There are 40 students. Eighteen students like the Spring Festival best. Ten students choose the Mid-Autumn Festival. Seven students like the Dragon Boat Festival. The other students prefer other festivals. I find that the Spring Festival is the most popular. I think it is because it is the longest holiday and families can be together. However, I also hope students can learn about festivals from other cultures and respect them.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和发现。用Eighteen/Ten/Seven students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用because说明原因，用However提出尊重其他文化的观点。

prompt: 你的外国朋友想了解中秋节。请给他写一封邮件，介绍中秋节的时间、习俗以及“月亮”在中国文化中的象征意义。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Jack,
The Mid-Autumn Festival is a traditional Chinese festival. It falls on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month. Families get together, eat mooncakes and admire the full moon. In Chinese culture, the full moon stands for family reunion and completeness. When people are far from home, they look at the moon and think of their families. Many famous poems are about the moon and homesickness. I think this festival is beautiful because it connects nature, family and poetry. I hope you can enjoy it with us one day.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按时间、习俗、文化象征组织。用falls on/get together/eat mooncakes/admire说明习俗，用stands for/think of their families解释月亮象征，用connects nature, family and poetry总结。

prompt: 学校正在征集“如何让传统节日更有活力”的建议。请写一篇短文，提出至少两条建议，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer: Traditional festivals are important, but some young people find them boring. Here are two suggestions to make them more lively. First, schools can hold festival activities. For example, students can make traditional food or learn folk dances. This helps young people experience the festival, not just read about it. Second, families can create new traditions. They can take photos, make short videos or visit interesting places together. If festivals connect with young people's interests, they will be passed down with joy. Traditions can stay alive when they feel meaningful to each new generation.
explanation: 建议类短文用First/Second提出建议，用For example说明具体做法。用If festivals connect with...will be passed down with joy说明建议的效果，结尾用Traditions can stay alive when...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一个你家乡特有的节日或民俗活动。内容包括：它是什么、什么时候举行、有什么活动以及你对它的感受。
sampleAnswer: In my hometown, we have a special festival called the “River Lantern Festival”. It is held in July every year. On that evening, people write wishes on paper lanterns and put them on the river. There are also folk music performances and a food market. The whole town comes out to watch the lanterns float away. I love this festival because it is beautiful and peaceful. It brings our community together and gives everyone hope for the future. It is a tradition that I will always treasure.
explanation: 按活动名称、时间、内容、感受组织。用is held in July/write wishes/put them on the river/folk music performances说明内容，用because说明感受，结尾用I will always treasure表达珍惜。

prompt: 你的外国朋友Lucy想了解在中国如何礼貌地向陌生人求助。请给她写一封邮件，介绍至少三种礼貌的问路或求助方式。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lucy,
In China, it is important to ask for help politely. First, start with “Excuse me” and a smile. Second, use polite question forms, such as “Could you please tell me how to get to...?” or “Would you mind showing me the way?” Third, thank the person whether they can help or not. People are usually friendly and willing to help. If you speak politely, they will be happy to assist you. I hope these tips are useful for your trip.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件用First/Second/Third介绍礼貌求助的方式。用Excuse me/Could you please/Would you mind说明具体表达，用whether they can help or not强调感谢，结尾表达祝愿。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一次你在陌生城市问路的经历。内容包括：你当时的情况、你如何礼貌地询问、对方如何回应以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last summer, I got lost in a big city. I needed to find the science museum. I saw an old man and said, “Excuse me, could you please tell me how to get to the science museum?” He smiled and said, “Go straight and turn left at the second crossing.” He also told me which bus to take. I thanked him and followed his directions. I found the museum easily. I felt grateful and relieved. I learned that asking politely makes a big difference, and most people are willing to help.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述问路经历。按情况、询问、回应、感受组织。用Excuse me/could you please说明礼貌表达，用He smiled/told me/thanked him说明互动，结尾用I learned that...总结。

prompt: 学校正在开展“文明礼貌月”活动。请写一篇短文，谈谈为什么礼貌在人际交往中很重要，并举例说明。
sampleAnswer: Politeness is very important in communication. First, polite words show respect for others. When we say “please” and “thank you”, people feel valued. Second, politeness helps avoid conflict. If we ask for something politely, others are more likely to help us. For example, saying “Could you please lower your voice?” is better than “Be quiet!” Third, politeness builds good relationships. People like to be around those who are kind and respectful. In short, politeness costs nothing but brings a lot. We should use polite language every day.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second/Third说明礼貌的重要性，用For example对比礼貌与不礼貌的表达。用Politeness costs nothing but brings a lot总结，语言简洁有力。

prompt: 假设你是Li Ming，你的外国朋友Tom要去你的城市旅游，请你给他写一封邮件，推荐一个值得参观的地方，并告诉他如何礼貌地向当地人询问路线。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I want to recommend the City Museum. It is in the city centre, near People's Square. To get there, you can take the No. 5 bus and get off at City Hall. If you need help, ask politely. Start with “Excuse me” and say, “Could you please tell me the way to the City Museum?” Most people are friendly and will help you. You can also use a map app. I hope you enjoy your visit.
Yours,
Li Ming
explanation: 邮件按推荐地点、路线、问路方式组织。用take the No. 5 bus/get off at说明路线，用Excuse me/Could you please tell me...示范礼貌问路，结尾表达祝愿。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较直接问路和礼貌问路两种方式，说明它们的不同效果以及你认为哪种更好及原因。
sampleAnswer: Direct and polite ways of asking for directions are very different. A direct question like “Where is the bank?” is short, but it may sound rude. A polite question like “Excuse me, could you please tell me where the bank is?” is longer, but it sounds respectful. In my experience, people respond better to polite questions. They are more willing to stop and help. I think polite asking is better because it shows respect and makes communication warmer. Even if the answer is the same, the feeling is different. Good manners make every conversation better.
explanation: 比较两种方式，用may sound rude/sounds respectful对比效果。用In my experience/respond better/more willing to help说明差异，用prefer...because...表达观点，结尾用Good manners make...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍在公共场所（如图书馆、医院、电影院）应该遵守哪些礼貌规则，并说明为什么这些规则重要。
sampleAnswer: In public places, we should follow some polite rules. In a library, we should keep quiet and not eat or drink. In a hospital, we should speak softly and wait in line. In a cinema, we should turn off our phones and not talk loudly. These rules are important because they show respect for others. If everyone follows them, public places will be comfortable for everyone. Politeness is not just about words. It is also about what we do and how we treat the people around us.
explanation: 按不同场所介绍规则，用keep quiet/speak softly/turn off phones说明具体行为。用because they show respect for others说明重要性，结尾用Politeness is not just about words...深化。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“在公共场合最不礼貌的行为”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about impolite behaviour in public places in our class. There are 40 students. Fifteen students think talking loudly on the phone is the most impolite. Twelve students choose pushing in lines. Eight students say dropping litter. The other students choose other behaviours, such as smoking or spitting. I find that noise and bad behaviour in lines are the biggest problems. I think schools should teach students polite behaviour and set clear rules. If everyone behaves politely, our city will be a better place.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和看法。用Fifteen/Twelve/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I think...should...提出建议，用If...will...说明结果。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter说话很直接，有时会让别人不舒服。请给他写一封邮件，建议他如何用更礼貌的方式表达自己的想法，并举例说明。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I know you are an honest person, and that is a good quality. But sometimes your words can make others uncomfortable. Here is some advice. Try to use softer words. For example, instead of saying “You are wrong”, you can say “I think there may be another way to look at this.” Instead of “Be quiet”, say “Could you please speak a little more softly?” These small changes show respect and make people more willing to listen to you. I hope this helps.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议邮件先肯定对方优点（honest），再提出改进建议。用instead of...you can say...对比直接与礼貌表达，用show respect/more willing to listen说明效果，语气友好。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一次你或他人因为不礼貌行为而引起误会或不愉快的经历。内容包括：发生了什么、造成了什么影响以及你从中学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: Last month, I saw a boy push in front of an old woman at the bus stop. He didn't say sorry or excuse me. The old woman looked upset, and people around started to complain. The boy looked embarrassed. Later, he said sorry to the woman. This small incident made everyone uncomfortable. I learned that one rude action can affect many people. Politeness is not just a personal choice. It affects the mood and comfort of everyone around us. We should always think before we act.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述不礼貌行为的影响。按事件、影响、收获组织。用push/didn't say sorry/looked upset/started to complain说明后果，用I learned that...总结礼貌对他人的影响。

prompt: 学校正在征集“校园礼貌用语”标语。请写一篇短文，推荐三条你最喜欢的礼貌用语，并说明它们的使用场景和效果。
sampleAnswer: I want to recommend three polite expressions for our school. The first is “Excuse me.” We can use it when we need to pass by someone or ask a question. It shows respect and gets attention politely. The second is “Could you please...?” We can use it when we ask for help. It makes the request softer and easier to accept. The third is “Thank you.” We should say it whenever someone helps us, even for small things. These simple words can make our school warmer and friendlier. Let's use them every day.
explanation: 按三条用语组织，每条写清使用场景和效果。用when we need to/ask for help说明场景，用shows respect/makes the request softer说明效果，结尾用Let's use them every day.号召。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你或你的朋友从过去到现在发生的一次明显变化。内容包括：过去是什么样子、现在有什么不同以及变化的原因。
sampleAnswer: My best friend Wang Fang has changed a lot. In the past, she was very shy and afraid to speak in class. She used to sit alone and seldom talked to others. Now she is outgoing and confident. She often answers questions and takes part in class activities. The change happened after she joined the school English club. She practised speaking every week and made new friends. Her teacher also encouraged her a lot. I am happy to see her change. She has become a better and happier person.
explanation: 比较过去和现在，用In the past she was/used to/Now she is形成对比。用The change happened after...说明原因，用practised/made friends/encouraged说明具体因素，结尾表达感受。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解你从小学到现在最大的变化。请给他写一封邮件，描述你过去的样子、现在的样子以及你对这种变化的感受。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I have changed a lot since primary school. I used to be short and thin. Now I am much taller and stronger. I also used to be afraid of speaking in front of people. But now I am more confident and I enjoy giving presentations. The biggest change is my attitude towards study. I used to study only for tests, but now I study because I am curious about the world. I feel happy about these changes. They show that I am growing up.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按过去、现在、感受组织。用used to be/Now I am形成对比，用The biggest change is...突出核心变化，用I feel happy about...表达感受，结尾用They show that...总结。

prompt: 学校正在开展“我的成长故事”征文活动。请写一篇短文，讲述一次让你发生积极变化的经历。内容包括：变化前的情况、发生了什么以及变化后的你。
sampleAnswer: In Grade 7, I was very lazy and seldom did my homework on time. My parents and teachers were worried about me. One day, my teacher asked me to take charge of a group project. I had to plan, organize and finish the work with my group members. At first, I felt stressed, but I didn't want to let my group down. I worked harder than before. Our project was a success. From that experience, I became more responsible and organized. I learned that responsibility can change a person.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述变化经历。按变化前、事件、变化后组织。用was lazy/seldom did说明过去，用asked me to take charge/had to plan/worked harder说明转折，用became more responsible总结变化。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较你和你的父母在青少年时期的经历。内容包括：他们过去的生活和你的生活有什么不同、你更愿意生活在哪个时代以及原因。
sampleAnswer: My parents and I had very different teenage experiences. When my parents were young, they had no smartphones or the Internet. They played outside with friends and read paper books. They walked or cycled to school. Now I can study online, watch videos and communicate with friends anytime. Life is more convenient for me. However, my parents had more free time and spent more time outdoors. I prefer my life because I have more chances to learn and explore. But I also think we should spend less time on screens and enjoy real-life activities.
explanation: 比较两代人青少年时期，用had no smartphones/played outside/cycled对比study online/watch videos。用prefer my life because...表达偏好，用But/also提出屏幕时间的反思。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“进入九年级后最大的变化”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要变化和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about the biggest changes in Grade 9 in our class. There are 40 students. Eighteen students say they study harder than before. Ten students say they have less free time. Seven students say they feel more stressed. The other students say they have become more independent. I find that study pressure is the most common change. I think it is normal, but we should also learn to relax. We can exercise, talk to friends or develop a hobby. A balanced life helps us do better.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和看法。用Eighteen/Ten/Seven students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I think...but...提出平衡观点，用can exercise...提出建议。

prompt: 你的朋友Lisa觉得自己不如别人，总是很不自信。请给她写一封邮件，帮助她看到自己的变化和优点，并鼓励她。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lisa,
I am sorry to hear that you feel unconfident. But I want to tell you that you have changed a lot in a good way. You used to be afraid to speak in class, but now you share your ideas more often. You are kind and patient, and your classmates like you. You may not notice it, but you are growing every day. Please don't compare yourself with others. Everyone has his or her own pace. Believe in yourself. You are better than you think.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 鼓励邮件先表达理解，用You used to...but now...帮助对方看到积极变化。用You are kind and patient/You are growing every day具体肯定，用Don't compare.../Believe in yourself鼓励。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈“真正的成长”意味着什么。内容包括：你的理解、一个支持你观点的例子以及成长中最重要的品质。
sampleAnswer: For me, true growth is not just about getting taller or older. It is about becoming more responsible, understanding others and learning from mistakes. For example, I used to blame others when things went wrong. But after a group project failed, I realized that I also needed to reflect on my own actions. I learned to say sorry and to work with others better. I think the most important quality in growth is honesty—being honest with yourself and with others. Honesty helps us see our weaknesses and become better people.
explanation: 先解释“真正的成长”，用used to blame.../But after.../I learned to...举例说明。用The most important quality is...点明品质，用being honest...helps us...说明原因。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一个你熟悉的人（家人、朋友或老师）多年来发生的变化。内容包括：他/她过去的样子、现在的样子以及你对这些变化的感受。
sampleAnswer: My father has changed a lot over the years. When I was little, he was very busy with work and often came home late. He seldom had time to play with me. Now he has a new job with better hours. He cooks dinner for us and takes me to school in the morning. He also exercises every day and looks healthier. I am happy about these changes because we spend more time together. He seems more relaxed and happier. It shows that people can change their lives for the better.
explanation: 用一般过去时和一般现在时对比父亲的变化。用When I was little, he was.../Now he has...形成对比，用cooks/takes/exercises说明现在的情况，用I am happy because...表达感受。

prompt: 学校正在开展“旧物改造”活动。请写一篇短文，介绍一件你改造过的旧物。内容包括：它原来是什么、你如何改造、现在它是什么以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last month, I turned an old T-shirt into a shopping bag. First, I cut off the sleeves and the neck. Then I sewed the bottom of the shirt closed. I used the sleeves to make two handles. Finally, I decorated the bag with some colourful buttons. Now it is a strong and beautiful bag. I use it when I go shopping. I feel proud because I gave old clothes a new life. It is a small way to protect the environment and save money.
explanation: 按原来是什么、改造过程、现在是什么、感受组织。用First/Then/Finally说明步骤，用cut off/sewed/decorated说明动作，用I feel proud because...表达感受，结尾点明环保意义。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国制造的产品。请给他写一封邮件，介绍一件你身边的“中国制造”产品，包括它的材料、产地以及你对它的看法。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I want to tell you about a “Made in China” product I use every day—my schoolbag. It is made of strong cloth and metal zippers. It was made in a factory in Zhejiang Province. It is light, comfortable and very useful. I have used it for two years and it still looks new. I think Chinese products are getting better and better. They are not only cheap but also good quality. Many things around us are made in China, and I am proud of that.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按产品、材料、产地、看法组织。用is made of/was made in说明材料和产地，用light, comfortable and useful描述特点，用not only cheap but also good quality说明看法。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一种你家乡的传统手工艺品。内容包括：它是什么、用什么材料制作、制作过程以及它为什么重要。
sampleAnswer: My hometown is famous for paper cutting. It is a traditional Chinese art. People use red paper and scissors to make beautiful pictures. First, they fold the paper. Then they cut different shapes with scissors. Finally, they open the paper and a beautiful pattern appears. Paper cutting is often used to decorate windows during the Spring Festival. It is important because it carries wishes for good luck and happiness. It also shows the wisdom and creativity of ordinary people. We should keep this art alive.
explanation: 按手工艺品、材料、制作过程、重要性组织。用First/Then/Finally说明步骤，用used to decorate/carries wishes说明重要性，结尾用We should keep this art alive.提出传承。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“国货”的看法。内容包括：你是否喜欢使用国货、至少两个理由以及你对国货未来发展的建议。
sampleAnswer: I like using Chinese products very much. First, many Chinese products are good quality and not expensive. For example, Chinese phones and home appliances are popular around the world. Second, buying Chinese products supports our own economy and creates jobs. However, I think Chinese brands should pay more attention to design and after-sales service. If they improve these areas, more people will choose Chinese products. I believe “Made in China” will become a symbol of quality and innovation in the future.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second说明喜欢国货的理由，用For example举例。用However提出改进建议（design/after-sales service），用If...will...说明改进的效果，结尾表达信心。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最常使用的中国制造产品”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的发现。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about “Made in China” products in our class. There are 40 students. Twenty students say they use Chinese phones most often. Ten students choose Chinese shoes. Six students use Chinese study apps. The other students choose other products. I find that Chinese phones are the most common. I think it is because Chinese phone brands have improved a lot in quality and design. They are also cheaper than many foreign brands. I am proud to see Chinese products becoming more popular.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和发现。用Twenty/Ten/Six students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用because说明原因，用I am proud to see...表达感受。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次你参观工厂或手工作坊的经历。内容包括：你参观了什么工厂、你看到了什么、你学到了什么以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last month, our class visited a glass factory. We saw how glass was made. First, workers melted sand and other materials at a very high temperature. Then the liquid glass was shaped into bottles and cups. Finally, the products were cooled and packed. I was amazed by the process. I learned that every product goes through many steps before it reaches our hands. I also realized that we should not waste things because making them takes a lot of work and energy. It was a meaningful visit.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述参观经历。按参观对象、所见、所学、感受组织。用First/Then/Finally说明制作过程，用I was amazed/I learned that...说明感受和收获。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较手工制作的产品和工厂生产的产品。内容包括：它们各自的特点、优缺点以及你更喜欢哪一种及原因。
sampleAnswer: Handmade products and factory-made products are quite different. Handmade products are often unique and carry the maker's personal touch. They are usually more expensive and take longer to make. Factory-made products are cheaper, faster to produce and more uniform in quality. However, they may lack personal character. I prefer handmade products for gifts because they feel more special and sincere. But for everyday things like clothes and tools, I choose factory-made products because they are practical and affordable. Both have their place in our lives.
explanation: 比较手工和工厂产品，用unique/personal touch/expensive/faster/cheaper/uniform对比。用prefer...for gifts because.../for everyday things...表达不同场景的偏好，结尾用Both have their place...总结。

prompt: 你的外国朋友想了解中国的茶文化。请给他写一封邮件，介绍茶叶的产地、制作过程以及中国人喝茶的习惯。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Jack,
Tea is an important part of Chinese culture. It is mainly grown in the south of China, such as Fujian and Yunnan. Tea leaves are picked by hand, then dried and processed. There are many kinds of tea, such as green tea, black tea and oolong tea. Chinese people drink tea every day. We often serve tea to guests to show welcome and respect. Drinking tea is not just about taste. It is also a way to relax and enjoy life. I hope you can try Chinese tea one day.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按产地、制作、种类、习惯组织。用grown in/picked by hand/dried and processed说明生产和制作，用serve tea to guests to show welcome说明文化习惯，用not just about taste...深化。

prompt: 学校正在开展“支持国货，理性消费”主题活动。请写一篇短文，谈谈中学生应该如何理性看待品牌和产品。
sampleAnswer: As middle school students, we should learn to be rational about brands and products. First, we should not judge a product only by its brand or price. A good product should be judged by its quality, usefulness and safety. Second, we should support good Chinese products, but we don't need to reject all foreign products. The best choice is the one that fits our needs. Third, we should avoid wasting money on things we don't really need. Rational consumption means buying what is useful and suitable, not what is fashionable or expensive.
explanation: 按理性看待品牌、支持国货、避免浪费组织。用First/Second/Third提出建议，用should not judge...only by.../the best choice is...说明原则，结尾解释理性消费的含义。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一项你认为最重要的发明。内容包括：它是什么、谁发明的（如果知道）、它如何改变了人们的生活以及你为什么认为它最重要。
sampleAnswer: I think the most important invention is the Internet. It was not invented by one person, but by many scientists over many years. The Internet has changed our lives completely. We can communicate with people around the world, learn new things and shop online. It has made information easy to get and work more efficient. I think it is the most important invention because it connects the world and gives everyone more chances. However, we should also use it wisely and not let it control our time.
explanation: 按发明、发明者、改变、重要性组织。用has changed our lives/communicate/learn/shop说明改变，用because it connects the world...说明重要性，用However提醒合理使用。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国的古代发明。请给他写一封邮件，介绍一项中国古代发明，包括它的历史、用途以及它对世界的影响。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I want to tell you about papermaking, one of the Four Great Inventions of ancient China. It was invented in the Han Dynasty. Before paper, people wrote on bamboo or silk, which was heavy or expensive. Paper made writing cheaper and easier. It helped spread knowledge and culture. Later, papermaking spread to other countries and changed the world. I think it is a great invention because it made books and education possible for more people. We should be proud of our ancient wisdom.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按发明、历史、用途、影响组织。用invented in the Han Dynasty/before paper.../made writing cheaper说明历史和用途，用helped spread/spread to other countries说明影响，结尾表达自豪。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一项改变了你日常生活的现代发明。内容包括：它是什么、你什么时候开始使用它、它如何改变你的生活以及你对它的看法。
sampleAnswer: The invention that has changed my daily life most is the smartphone. I started using one when I was in Grade 6.
