Now I use it for many things: checking the weather, looking up words, taking photos and keeping in touch with friends. It saves me a lot of time. However, I also spend too much time on it sometimes. I think the smartphone is a wonderful invention, but we need to control our screen time. It should be a tool, not a master.
explanation: 按发明、开始使用、改变、看法组织。用checking/looking up/taking photos/keeping in touch说明用途，用saves me a lot of time说明改变，用should be a tool, not a master表达看法。

prompt: 学校正在举办“小小发明家”活动。请写一篇短文，介绍你设想的一项小发明。内容包括：它是什么、它解决什么问题、它如何工作以及你为什么想发明它。
sampleAnswer: I want to invent a “homework reminder pen”. Many students forget to do their homework or bring the right books. This pen can connect to a student's homework list. When you pick it up, a small screen shows today's homework. If you forget something, it will remind you with a soft sound. It can also help you plan your time. I want to invent it because I often forget homework myself. I think it would be a simple but useful invention for students.
explanation: 按发明、解决问题、工作原理、原因组织。用connect to/show homework/remind you/help you plan说明功能，用because I often forget homework myself说明个人动机，结尾评价。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较互联网和传统图书馆在学习中的作用。内容包括：它们各自的优点和局限以及你如何在学习中结合使用它们。
sampleAnswer: The Internet and traditional libraries both help us learn, but in different ways. The Internet is fast and convenient. We can search for information anytime and find many resources. But the information online is not always correct. Libraries are quiet and reliable. Books are carefully checked and organized. However, libraries have limited opening hours and fewer new resources. In my study, I use the Internet to find quick answers and the library to read deeply. I think using both is the best way to learn well.
explanation: 比较互联网和图书馆，用fast and convenient/not always correct/quiet and reliable/limited opening hours说明优缺点。用I use...to find quick answers/read deeply说明结合方式，结尾总结。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最重要的发明”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about the most important invention in our class. There are 40 students. Fifteen students choose the Internet. Ten students choose the smartphone. Eight students choose electricity. The other students choose inventions like planes or computers. I find that the Internet is the most popular answer. I think it is because the Internet connects everything and makes life much easier. However, every invention has its value. The most important one is the one that improves people's lives the most.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和看法。用Fifteen/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用because说明原因，结尾用the one that improves...表达观点。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一位你敬佩的发明家或科学家。内容包括：他/她是谁、发明了什么、遇到了什么困难以及你从他/她身上学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: I admire Thomas Edison very much. He invented the light bulb and many other useful things. When he was trying to invent the light bulb, he failed many times. But he didn't give up. He tried thousands of materials before he found the right one. He said, “Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.” From him, I learned that failure is not the end. Hard work and patience are the keys to success. I want to be a person who never gives up.
explanation: 按人物、发明、困难、收获组织。用failed many times/didn't give up/tried thousands of materials说明困难，引用名言增加说服力，用I learned that...总结收获。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈发明创造对人类社会的影响。内容包括：发明如何改变生活、发明可能带来的问题以及我们应该如何正确看待发明。
sampleAnswer: Inventions have changed human society greatly. They make life easier, faster and more comfortable. For example, cars, planes and the Internet have connected the world. But inventions also bring problems. Cars cause pollution, and the Internet can spread false information. We should see both sides. Inventions are tools, and how we use them matters. We should use inventions responsibly and think about their effects on society and the environment. If we use them wisely, they can make the world better for everyone.
explanation: 按积极影响、问题、正确态度组织。用make life easier/connected the world说明积极影响，用cause pollution/spread false information说明问题，用Inventions are tools...matters表达观点。

prompt: 你的朋友想了解中国古代的“四大发明”。请给他写一封邮件，简要介绍四大发明及其对世界的影响。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
The Four Great Inventions of ancient China are papermaking, printing, the compass and gunpowder. Papermaking and printing made books cheaper and helped spread knowledge. The compass made sea travel safer and helped explorers find new routes. Gunpowder changed the way wars were fought and was later used in mining and construction. These inventions not only changed China but also influenced the whole world. They show the wisdom and creativity of the Chinese people. I am proud of them.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件逐一介绍四大发明及其影响，用made books cheaper/helped spread knowledge/made sea travel safer/changed the way wars were fought说明影响，结尾用They show.../I am proud of them总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你使用一项科技产品（如学习软件、智能手表等）辅助学习的经历。内容包括：你使用了什么、如何使用、效果如何以及你的建议。
sampleAnswer: I use a vocabulary app to help me learn English. Every day, I spend ten minutes on it. The app shows me new words and asks me to review them through short games. It also records my progress. After using it for three months, my vocabulary has grown a lot, and I feel more confident in reading. I think it is a useful tool. My advice is to set a daily goal and stick to it. Technology can help us learn, but only if we use it consistently.
explanation: 按产品、使用方式、效果、建议组织。用shows me new words/asks me to review/records my progress说明使用方式，用my vocabulary has grown/I feel more confident说明效果，用My advice is...提出建议。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你们学校的一条校规，并谈谈你对这条校规的看法。内容包括：校规内容、制定原因以及你认为它是否合理及理由。
sampleAnswer: One of our school rules is that students must not use mobile phones during school hours. The school made this rule because phones can distract students and affect their study. I think this rule is reasonable. First, without phones, students can focus better in class. Second, it encourages us to talk to classmates face to face. However, I also think there should be some exceptions. For example, students may need phones to contact their parents after school. If the rule is used flexibly, it will be good for everyone.
explanation: 按规则内容、原因、看法组织。用must not use phones说明规则，用because phones can distract students说明原因，用I think this rule is reasonable/First/Second说明看法，用However/If...提出灵活执行的建议。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国学校的校规。请给他写一封邮件，介绍三条校规，并说明你对这些校规的感受。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
In our school, there are some rules we must follow. First, we must wear school uniforms from Monday to Friday. Second, we must arrive at school before 7:50. Third, we must not run in the hallways. At first, I thought some rules were too strict. But now I understand they keep us safe and help us focus on study. Uniforms make us feel like a team, and the time rule helps us form good habits. I think school rules are necessary if they are fair and reasonable.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件介绍三条校规，用must wear/must arrive/must not run说明规则。用At first/But now体现态度变化，用I think...if...表达对校规的看法。

prompt: 学校正在开展“规则与自由”主题讨论。请写一篇短文，谈谈规则和自由的关系。内容包括：你的理解、一个例子以及规则如何保护自由。
sampleAnswer: Some people think rules limit freedom, but I think rules protect freedom. For example, traffic rules tell us when to stop and when to go. They may seem inconvenient, but they keep everyone safe. If there were no traffic rules, the roads would be dangerous and no one could move freely. In the same way, school rules help create a safe and fair environment for learning. Without rules, freedom would become chaos. Rules and freedom are not opposites. Good rules make true freedom possible.
explanation: 先提出观点：规则保护自由，用traffic rules举例说明。用If there were no...would be...虚拟语气说明没有规则的后果，用Rules and freedom are not opposites...总结。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最不合理的校规”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果以及你对学校管理的建议。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about unreasonable school rules in our class. There are 40 students. Fifteen students think the rule against wearing long hair is unreasonable. Ten students say the rule about not bringing drinks into the classroom is too strict. Eight students think the homework time limit is not realistic. I find that appearance rules cause the most disagreement. I suggest the school listen to students' opinions before making rules. If students and teachers discuss together, the rules will be more reasonable and easier to follow.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和建议。用Fifteen/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I suggest...提出建议，用If...will...说明共同讨论的效果。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter认为学校不应该规定穿校服。请给他写一封邮件，谈谈你对校服的看法，并说明你的理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I know you don't like wearing school uniforms. But I think uniforms have some advantages. First, they make everyone equal. Students don't need to compare clothes or brands. Second, uniforms help us feel like part of a team. When we wear the same clothes, we feel proud of our school. Third, uniforms save time in the morning because we don't need to choose what to wear. I agree that uniforms should be comfortable and nice-looking. If schools choose better designs, students may like them more.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件先承认对方观点，用But I think...引出自己的看法。用First/Second/Third说明校服的优点，用I agree that.../If...may...提出改进建议，使观点更平衡。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你家里的一条家规，并说明它对你的影响。
sampleAnswer: One of my family rules is that I must finish my homework before dinner. My parents made this rule to help me manage my time. At first, I found it difficult because I wanted to play first. But after a few weeks, I got used to it. Now I finish my homework faster and have more free time in the evening. This rule has taught me to be disciplined and responsible. I think good family rules are not just limits. They help us form habits that will benefit us for a lifetime.
explanation: 按家规、原因、影响组织。用must finish...before dinner说明规则，用At first/But after a few weeks/Now体现适应过程，用has taught me.../help us form habits说明影响。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较“严格管理”和“自由发展”两种教育方式。内容包括：它们各自的特点以及你认为哪种方式更适合中学生及原因。
sampleAnswer: Strict management and free development are two different educational styles. Strict management sets clear rules and limits. It helps students form good habits and stay safe. Free development gives students more choices. It encourages creativity and independence. I think a balance is best for middle school students. We need rules to guide us, but we also need freedom to explore and make decisions. If parents and teachers set reasonable rules and give us some freedom, we can grow into responsible and creative people. Neither extreme is good.
explanation: 比较两种教育方式，用sets clear rules/encourages creativity说明特点。用I think a balance is best...表达观点，用If...can...说明平衡的效果，结尾用Neither extreme is good.强化辩证思考。

prompt: 学校正在修订校规，现向同学们征集意见。请写一封邮件给校长，提出一条你希望修改或新增的校规，并说明理由和建议。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Principal,
I am writing to suggest a change to our school rules. I think students should be allowed to borrow books from the library during lunch break. Now the library is closed at lunchtime, but many students want to read or study there. If the library stays open, students can use their time better and develop a reading habit. I suggest opening it from 12:30 to 1:00 with a teacher on duty. I hope you can consider my suggestion. Thank you.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议邮件先说明建议内容，用I think students should be allowed to...提出请求。用Now...but...说明问题，用If...can...说明建议的效果，用I suggest...提出具体方案。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈为什么有些人会违反规则，以及违反规则可能带来什么后果。
sampleAnswer: People sometimes break rules for different reasons. Some people are in a hurry and think rules are inconvenient. Others follow friends and don't want to be left out. Some simply don't understand why the rule exists. However, breaking rules can have serious consequences. A student who cheats may lose trust. A driver who runs a red light may cause an accident. Rules are made to protect everyone. If we break them, we put ourselves and others in danger. Before breaking a rule, we should ask ourselves: is it worth the risk?
explanation: 按原因、后果、反思组织。用in a hurry/follow friends/don't understand说明原因，用may lose trust/may cause an accident说明后果，用Before breaking a rule, we should ask...引导反思。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一次你或他人因为遵守规则而避免危险或获得好结果的经历。
sampleAnswer: Last summer, I was hiking with my friends. We saw a beautiful lake and my friends wanted to swim in it. But there was a sign that said “No Swimming”. My friends said the rule was unnecessary, but I reminded them that the lake might be dangerous. We decided to follow the rule and not swim. Later, a local told us that the lake had strong currents and was not safe for swimming. We were glad we followed the rule. This experience taught me that rules are often written for our safety, even when we don't understand them at first.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述遵守规则的经历。按事件、决定、结果、收获组织。用But there was a sign/We decided to follow/ Later, a local told us说明过程，用We were glad.../taught me that...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一种你观察到的“规则意识”现象（如在公共场所排队、遵守交通信号等），并谈谈你对这种现象的看法。
sampleAnswer: I have noticed that more and more people in my city wait in line at bus stops and subway stations. In the past, people often pushed to get on. Now most people stand in a line and wait for their turn. I think this is a positive change. It shows that people are becoming more polite and aware of rules. Waiting in line is fair to everyone and makes public places more orderly. It also sets a good example for children. If everyone follows the rules, our society will be more harmonious and comfortable.
explanation: 按现象、变化、看法组织。用In the past/Now对比说明变化，用It shows that.../makes public places more orderly说明看法，用If...will...说明规则意识的社会意义。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一次你通过观察细节做出正确推断的经历。内容包括：你看到了什么、你如何推断、结果如何以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last week, I noticed that my classmate Li Ming looked worried. He kept looking at his phone and sighing. I guessed something was wrong. I asked him, and he told me he lost his wallet. I thought for a moment. He said he had been to the library and the playground. I suggested we check the lost-and-found office first. We went there, and his wallet was there. He was so happy. I felt proud that I could help by noticing small details. Careful observation can sometimes solve big problems.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述推断过程。按观察、推断、结果、感受组织。用looked worried/kept looking/sighing说明观察，用I guessed/I suggested说明推断，用I felt proud...总结。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解如何根据线索进行逻辑推断。请给他写一封邮件，介绍一种你在生活中常用的推断方法，并举一个例子。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I often use observation to make inferences. When I want to know what someone is thinking or feeling, I look at their face, body language and actions. For example, if my friend is quiet and doesn't look at me, I guess he may be upset. Then I ask him gently. This method is not always 100% correct, but it helps me understand people better. I think careful observation and kind communication are the keys to good inferences. What do you think?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件介绍观察推断法，用look at their face/body language/actions说明方法。用For example/if my friend is quiet...举例，用not always 100% correct/helps me understand说明看法，结尾提问。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一个你曾经解开的“小谜团”。内容包括：谜团是什么、你发现了哪些线索、你如何推断以及最终结果。
sampleAnswer: Last month, my sister's favourite pen disappeared. She was very upset. I decided to help her find it. I looked around her room. I noticed some ink marks on the floor near the window. Then I saw that the window was open. I guessed the pen might have fallen out. I went outside and looked under the window. There it was, on the grass. My sister was so happy. I felt like a detective. This small mystery taught me that careful observation can lead to the answer.
explanation: 按谜团、线索、推断、结果组织。用noticed ink marks/saw the window was open/guessed说明线索和推断，用There it was说明结果，用I felt like a detective/taught me that...总结感受和收获。

prompt: 学校正在开展“逻辑思维训练”活动。请写一篇短文，说明为什么逻辑推断能力对中学生很重要，并举例说明。
sampleAnswer: Logical thinking is very important for middle school students. First, it helps us solve problems more efficiently. For example, in maths, we need to find patterns and make inferences to solve difficult questions. Second, it helps us make good decisions in daily life. If we can judge situations logically, we can avoid being tricked or making wrong choices. Third, logical thinking improves our communication. When we express ideas clearly and reasonably, others can understand us better. In short, logical thinking is a life skill that we should develop.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second/Third说明逻辑推断能力的重要性，用For example/in maths.../If we can judge...举例。结尾用In short...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一个你曾经误会别人的经历。内容包括：误会是什么、你当时为什么会产生误会以及后来如何发现真相。
sampleAnswer: Last week, I thought my friend Wang Fang was ignoring me. I said hello to her in the hallway, but she walked past without looking at me. I felt hurt and a little angry. Later, I learned that she had lost her glasses that morning and couldn't see clearly. She didn't ignore me on purpose. I felt sorry for judging her too quickly. I apologized to her, and we laughed about it. This experience taught me not to make inferences based on limited information. I should ask before I judge.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述误会和真相。按误会、原因、真相、收获组织。用thought/ignoring/felt hurt/learned that...说明过程，用taught me not to.../should ask before I judge总结教训。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最容易被误解的行为”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的建议。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about misunderstood behaviour in our class. There are 40 students. Fourteen students think being quiet is the most misunderstood. People may think a quiet person is unfriendly, but he or she may just be shy. Ten students say looking at the phone while talking is often misunderstood as impolite. Eight students choose not replying to messages quickly. I find that silence and phone use cause many misunderstandings. I suggest we communicate more clearly and ask questions instead of guessing. A little explanation can prevent a big misunderstanding.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和建议。用Fourteen/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I suggest...提出建议，用A little explanation can prevent...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢的一种音乐类型，并说明它为什么能打动你。
sampleAnswer: My favourite music is pop music. I like it because it has catchy melodies and meaningful lyrics. Pop songs often talk about love, friendship, dreams and everyday life. They make me feel happy when I am down, and they give me energy when I am tired. One of my favourite songs is “Hall of Fame”. It encourages me to work hard and believe in myself. Whenever I listen to it, I feel ready to face any challenge. Music is like a friend that is always there for me.
explanation: 按音乐类型、原因、例子、感受组织。用catchy melodies/meaningful lyrics说明原因，用One of my favourite songs is...举例，用Whenever I listen...feel ready说明感受。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国青少年喜欢什么音乐。请给他写一封邮件，介绍你和你的朋友们喜欢的音乐类型，并说明原因。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
My friends and I like different kinds of music. I like pop music because it is relaxing and the songs are easy to sing. My friend Li Ming likes rock music. He says it gives him energy. Wang Fang likes folk music. She thinks it is beautiful and close to nature. We all like Chinese traditional music too, especially songs played on the guzheng. Music helps us relax and express our feelings. What kind of music do you like?
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按不同人的喜好和原因组织。用likes pop/rock/folk music分别说明，用because it is relaxing/gives him energy/is close to nature说明原因，用Music helps us relax...总结，结尾提问。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一首对你影响很大的歌或一段音乐。内容包括：它的名称、你什么时候第一次听到它、它如何影响你以及你为什么推荐它。
sampleAnswer: The song that has influenced me most is “Heal the World” by Michael Jackson. I first heard it when I was in primary school. My teacher played it in class and explained its meaning. The song is about love, peace and helping others. Whenever I feel sad or stressed, I listen to it. It reminds me to care about others and stay positive. I recommend it because it has a beautiful melody and a powerful message. Music can change the world, and this song shows how.
explanation: 按歌曲、初次接触、影响、推荐组织。用first heard it when.../teacher played it说明初次接触，用Whenever I feel.../reminds me to...说明影响，用I recommend it because...说明推荐理由。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较两种不同的音乐类型（如流行音乐和古典音乐），说明它们各自的特点以及你更喜欢哪一种及原因。
sampleAnswer: Pop music and classical music are very different. Pop music is lively and easy to understand. It has strong rhythms and simple lyrics. Classical music is more complex and peaceful. It often tells a story through instruments without words. I enjoy both, but I prefer classical music when I study because it helps me focus. I like pop music when I exercise or feel happy. I think different types of music suit different moods. The best music is the one that matches how you feel at the moment.
explanation: 比较流行和古典音乐，用lively and easy to understand/complex and peaceful说明特点。用prefer...when...说明不同场景的偏好，用different types suit different moods总结。

prompt: 学校正在举办“音乐与生活”主题活动。请写一篇短文，谈谈音乐在你生活中的作用。
sampleAnswer: Music plays an important role in my life. First, it helps me relax. After a busy day, I put on my headphones and listen to soft music. It makes me feel calm. Second, music gives me energy. When I exercise, I listen to fast songs, and I feel stronger. Third, music helps me express my feelings. When I am happy, I sing along. When I am sad, I listen to songs that understand me. Music is more than entertainment. It is a friend, a comfort and a source of power.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second/Third说明音乐的作用，用After a busy day/When I exercise/When I am happy说明场景。用Music is more than entertainment...总结升华。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最喜欢的音乐类型”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的发现。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about favourite music in our class. There are 40 students. Eighteen students like pop music best. Ten students choose rock music. Seven students like folk music. The other students prefer classical music or hip-hop. I find that pop music is the most popular. I think it is because pop songs are easy to listen to and often appear on social media. However, I hope students can also explore other types of music. Different music can open our minds and enrich our lives.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和发现。用Eighteen/Ten/Seven students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用because说明原因，用However提出探索其他音乐的建议。

prompt: 你的朋友Lisa最近压力很大，情绪低落。请给她写一封邮件，推荐一些音乐来帮助她放松，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lisa,
I am sorry to hear that you feel stressed. I want to recommend some music to help you relax. First, try listening to soft piano music before bed. It can slow down your thoughts and help you sleep. Second, listen to happy pop songs when you feel down. They can lift your mood. Third, try some traditional Chinese music, like guzheng pieces. They are peaceful and beautiful. I hope music can bring you some comfort. Remember, you are not alone.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 推荐邮件用First/Second/Third推荐不同类型的音乐，用before bed/when you feel down说明场景，用It can slow down your thoughts/lift your mood说明理由，结尾表达关心。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次你参加音乐活动的经历（如音乐会、唱歌比赛、音乐节等）。内容包括：活动内容、你的参与、你的感受以及你从中学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: Last month, I took part in a singing competition at our school. I sang a song called “Dream It Possible”. I practised for two weeks. On the day of the competition, I felt very nervous. But when I started singing, I forgot my fear. The audience clapped and cheered. I didn't win first prize, but I won third prize. I felt proud of myself. I learned that the most important thing is not winning but having the courage to try. Music gave me confidence.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述音乐活动经历。按活动、参与、感受、收获组织。用practised/felt nervous/started singing/clapped说明过程，用I learned that...总结收获。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈音乐如何促进人与人之间的理解和交流。
sampleAnswer: Music is a universal language that connects people. First, music can cross language barriers. Even if we don't understand the lyrics, we can feel the emotion in the melody. Second, music brings people together. At concerts or festivals, people from different backgrounds sing and dance together. Third, music can express feelings that are hard to put into words. When we share a song with a friend, we share a part of ourselves. In a world with many differences, music reminds us that we have similar feelings and dreams. It makes the world warmer and closer.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second/Third说明音乐如何促进交流，用Even if we don't understand the lyrics/At concerts/When we share a song说明具体场景，结尾用It makes the world warmer...总结。

prompt: 假设你是学校音乐社团的负责人，请写一则英文招新广告，介绍社团活动、活动时间和报名方式，并号召同学们参加。
sampleAnswer:
Music Club Wants You!
Do you love music? Can you sing or play an instrument? Join our music club! We meet every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon from 4:00 to 5:30 in the music room. We sing songs, play instruments, listen to different types of music and prepare for school performances. You don't need to be a professional. You just need to love music. Please email us at musicclub@school.com before next Friday. Come and share the joy of music with us!
explanation: 招新广告要有标题、活动内容、时间地点和报名方式。用every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon说明时间，用sing/play/listen/prepare列举活动，用You just need to love music降低门槛，结尾号召。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom要来中国做客。请给他写一封邮件，介绍中国家庭做客的基本礼仪，包括见面、礼物和用餐方面的注意事项。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
I am happy that you will visit a Chinese family. Here are some tips. When you meet the family, a smile and a handshake are polite. You can bring a small gift, such as fruit or tea. Do not give a clock as a gift because it has a bad meaning in Chinese. At the table, wait for the host to start eating. Try every dish, and it is okay to say you are full. Chinese families are warm and friendly. I am sure you will have a great time.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按见面、礼物、用餐组织礼仪建议。用a smile and a handshake/bring a small gift/do not give a clock说明注意事项，用wait for the host/try every dish说明用餐礼仪，结尾表达祝愿。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你国家的一种社交礼仪（如见面问候、餐桌礼仪、送礼习俗等）。内容包括：它是什么、人们通常怎么做以及它背后的文化意义。
sampleAnswer: In China, one important social custom is using both hands when giving or receiving a gift. People do this to show respect and sincerity. When someone gives you a gift, you should receive it with both hands and say thank you. If you give a gift, using both hands shows that you value the person. This custom reflects the Chinese value of respect and humility. It is a small action, but it carries deep meaning. Learning such customs helps us understand Chinese culture better.
explanation: 按礼仪、做法、文化意义组织。用using both hands/giving or receiving说明做法，用show respect and sincerity/reflects the Chinese value说明意义，结尾用Learning such customs helps...总结。

prompt: 学校正在开展“礼仪与成长”主题活动。请写一篇短文，谈谈为什么青少年应该学习社交礼仪，并举例说明。
sampleAnswer: Teenagers should learn social etiquette because it helps us in many ways. First, good manners show respect and make others feel comfortable. For example, saying “thank you” and “excuse me” can make a big difference in daily communication. Second, etiquette helps us build good relationships. People like to be around those who are polite and considerate. Third, learning etiquette prepares us for the future. When we grow up, we will meet people from different backgrounds, and good manners will help us communicate well. Etiquette is not old-fashioned. It is a life skill.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second/Third说明学习礼仪的重要性，用For example/saying thank you说明具体表现，用prepares us for the future说明长远意义，结尾用It is a life skill总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较中国和西方在餐桌礼仪上的不同。内容包括：至少两个不同点以及你认为应该如何面对这些差异。
sampleAnswer: Chinese and Western table manners are quite different. In China, people share dishes and use chopsticks. It is polite to try every dish. In Western countries, people usually have their own plates and use forks and knives. They often eat quietly and do not share food. Another difference is that in China, older people usually start eating first, while in the West, everyone may start together. I think we should respect these differences. When we are in a different culture, we should observe and follow local customs. Understanding makes communication easier.
explanation: 比较中西餐桌礼仪，用share dishes/use chopsticks/own plates/use forks and knives说明不同点。用I think we should respect.../observe and follow local customs说明态度，结尾用Understanding makes...总结。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最重要的社交礼仪”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about social etiquette in our class. There are 40 students. Eighteen students think saying “thank you” is the most important. Twelve students choose listening patiently. Six students think being on time matters most. The other students choose other manners, such as using polite language. I find that gratitude is the most valued manner. I agree because saying thank you shows appreciation and makes people feel valued. However, all good manners are important. If we practise them daily, they will become natural habits.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和看法。用Eighteen/Twelve/Six students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I agree because...表达看法，用If we practise...will become...说明习惯养成。

prompt: 你的外国朋友Lucy即将来中国学习。请给她写一封邮件，介绍在中国学校需要注意的三条社交礼仪。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lucy,
I am glad you will study in China. Here are three tips for school life. First, greet your teachers politely. You can say “Good morning, Mr. Li” or “Hello, Ms. Wang”. Second, when you receive something from others, use both hands. It shows respect. Third, don't be afraid to ask questions, but wait for your turn and speak politely. Chinese students are friendly and helpful. If you follow these manners, you will make friends easily. I am looking forward to seeing you.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件用First/Second/Third介绍三条学校礼仪。用greet politely/use both hands/wait for your turn说明具体做法，用It shows respect说明原因，结尾表达欢迎。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一次你或他人因为不懂礼仪而造成尴尬的经历。内容包括：发生了什么、为什么会尴尬以及你从中学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: Last year, I visited a Japanese friend's home. When his mother gave me a cup of tea, I took it with one hand. I didn't know that in Japan, using both hands is polite. My friend's mother looked a little surprised. My friend quietly told me the custom. I felt embarrassed and quickly used both hands to receive the cup. I apologized, and she smiled kindly. From this experience, I learned that learning about other cultures' manners is important. A small action can mean a lot in a different culture.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述礼仪尴尬经历。按事件、尴尬原因、学习收获组织。用took it with one hand/didn't know/looked surprised/felt embarrassed说明过程，用I learned that...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你参加过一次正式活动（如婚礼、典礼、晚宴等）时遵守礼仪的经历。内容包括：活动内容、你需要注意的礼仪以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last summer, I attended my cousin's wedding. It was a formal event, so I had to pay attention to my manners. I wore a clean and proper outfit. I arrived on time and greeted the elders politely. During the dinner, I waited for the elders to start eating first. I also used both hands when receiving a gift from the couple. I felt a little nervous at first, but I soon relaxed. I was happy that I behaved properly. Good manners made me feel more confident and respectful.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述正式活动经历。按活动、礼仪、感受组织。用wore a proper outfit/arrived on time/greeted politely/waited for elders说明礼仪，用felt nervous/relaxed/confident说明感受。

prompt: 学校正在征集“校园礼仪标兵”评选标准。请写一篇短文，提出你认为一个礼仪标兵应具备的三条品质，并说明理由。
sampleAnswer: I think a “Campus Etiquette Star” should have three qualities. First, he or she should be polite to everyone, including teachers, classmates and school workers. Politeness shows respect and creates a friendly atmosphere. Second, he or she should be helpful. A polite person not only speaks well but also acts kindly, such as helping others carry things or cleaning up. Third, he or she should set a good example. If a student always behaves politely, others will follow. These three qualities make a true etiquette star.
explanation: 按三条品质组织，用First/Second/Third。用polite to everyone/helpful/set a good example说明品质，用shows respect/creates a friendly atmosphere说明理由，结尾总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈“微笑”在社交中的作用。
sampleAnswer: A smile is a simple but powerful social tool. First, a smile makes others feel welcome and comfortable. When you meet someone with a smile, they are more likely to smile back and talk to you. Second, a smile can reduce tension. If you make a mistake, a smile can show that you are friendly and not a threat. Third, a smile crosses cultures. People everywhere understand a smile, even if they don't share a language. A smile costs nothing but gives a lot. It is the shortest bridge between two people.
explanation: 观点类短文用First/Second/Third说明微笑的作用，用makes others feel welcome/reduce tension/crosses cultures说明具体作用，用A smile costs nothing but gives a lot...总结升华。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一部让你产生强烈情感反应（如感动、振奋、悲伤等）的电影。内容包括：电影名称、故事简介、它带给你的情感以及你的评价。
sampleAnswer: The movie that moved me most is Hi, Mom. It tells the story of a daughter who travels back in time and tries to make her mother happy. The movie is full of love, humour and sadness. I laughed and cried while watching it. It made me think about my own mother and how much she does for me. After watching it, I hugged my mother and told her I love her. I think it is a wonderful movie because it reminds us to appreciate our parents before it is too late. Everyone should watch it.
explanation: 按电影、简介、情感、评价组织。用tells the story of/is full of love, humour and sadness说明内容和情感，用It made me think about.../After watching it, I...说明影响，结尾用I think it is a wonderful movie because...给出评价。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解哪部电影对你影响最大。请给他写一封邮件，介绍这部电影并说明它为什么让你感动。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
The movie that has influenced me most is The Pursuit of Happyness. It is based on a true story about a father who faces many difficulties but never gives up. He and his son are homeless for a time, but he keeps working hard to build a better life. The movie made me cry because the father's love for his son is so strong. It also inspired me to face my own problems bravely. Whenever I feel like giving up, I think of this movie and keep going. I highly recommend it.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按电影、故事、情感、影响组织。用is based on/faced difficulties/never gives up说明故事，用made me cry/inspired me to...说明情感和影响，用Whenever I feel like giving up...说明持续作用。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较一部电影和它改编自的原著小说。内容包括：主要情节的异同、你更喜欢哪一个以及原因。
sampleAnswer: I have read the book Charlotte's Web and watched the movie. Both tell the story of a pig named Wilbur and a spider named Charlotte who saves his life. The main plot is similar, but the movie adds more visual details and changes some small events. The book gives more space for imagination, while the movie makes the characters come alive with pictures and voices. I prefer the book because I can imagine the characters and scenes in my own way. However, the movie is also wonderful. It is a good way to enjoy the story in a different form.
explanation: 比较电影和原著，用Both tell.../main plot is similar/but the movie adds...说明异同。用prefer the book because I can imagine...说明偏好和原因，用However承认电影的优点。

prompt: 学校正在开展“电影与成长”主题活动。请写一篇短文，谈谈一部电影如何影响了你对某件事的看法或改变了你的行为。
sampleAnswer: The movie Zootopia changed the way I think about judging others. Before watching it, I sometimes judged people by their appearance or background. In the movie, a small rabbit becomes a police officer, and a fox who seems untrustworthy turns out to be kind and helpful. The movie showed me that we should not judge others by their looks or labels. After watching it, I became more open-minded and tried to know people before making judgments. It taught me an important lesson: everyone can be anything, and we should give people a chance.
explanation: 按电影、看法变化、行为改变组织。用Before watching it/I sometimes judged...说明过去，用The movie showed me that.../After watching it, I became...说明变化，用taught me an important lesson总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你最喜欢的一部喜剧电影，并说明它为什么能让你开心。
sampleAnswer: My favourite comedy movie is Home Alone. It is about a boy who is accidentally left at home alone during Christmas. Two thieves try to break into his house, but the boy uses clever tricks to stop them. The movie is full of funny scenes and jokes. I laugh every time I watch it. I like it because it is not just funny. It also shows the boy's bravery and love for his family. Whenever I feel stressed or sad, I watch this movie, and it always makes me feel better. Laughter is the best medicine.
explanation: 按电影、情节、开心原因、感受组织。用two thieves/the boy uses clever tricks说明情节，用full of funny scenes/I laugh every time说明开心原因，用Whenever I feel...makes me feel better说明作用。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最让人感动的电影类型”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about touching movie types in our class. There are 40 students. Sixteen students choose family movies. Twelve students choose movies about friendship. Eight students choose movies about real heroes. The other students choose other types. I find that family movies are the most touching. I think it is because family love is universal and everyone can relate to it. However, different movies touch different people. The most touching movie is the one that speaks to your own heart.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和看法。用Sixteen/Twelve/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用because family love is universal说明原因，用the one that speaks to your own heart表达观点。

prompt: 你的朋友Lisa最近心情低落，你想推荐一部电影给她。请给她写一封邮件，介绍这部电影并说明它为什么适合她现在看。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lisa,
I am sorry to hear that you feel down. I want to recommend a movie called The Blind Side. It is a true story about a kind woman who helps a homeless boy become a successful football player. The movie is warm and inspiring. It shows that kindness and love can change a person's life. I think it is perfect for you now because it will remind you that there are always people who care and that difficult times can lead to good things. I hope it brings you some light.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 推荐邮件先表达关心，用is a true story about/shows that...介绍电影和主题，用I think it is perfect for you because...说明适合对方的原因，用I hope it brings you some light结尾。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次你和家人或朋友一起看电影的经历。内容包括：看了什么电影、你们在电影院或家里的反应以及这次经历对你的意义。
sampleAnswer: Last weekend, I watched the movie Coco with my family at home. It is an animated film about family, memory and music. During the movie, my mother cried, my father laughed, and my little sister danced to the music. After the movie, we talked about our own family memories. It was a warm and meaningful evening. I realized that watching a movie together is not just about entertainment. It is about sharing feelings and creating memories. That night brought my family closer.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述看电影经历。按电影、反应、意义组织。用my mother cried/my father laughed/my sister danced说明反应，用It is about sharing feelings and creating memories说明意义。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈电影对青少年的影响。内容包括：积极影响、可能的问题以及你的建议。
sampleAnswer: Movies can have a big influence on teenagers. On the positive side, good movies can inspire us, teach us important values and open our minds to different cultures. For example, movies about heroes can encourage us to be brave and kind. However, some movies contain violence or unhealthy content. Teenagers may imitate bad behaviour or develop wrong values. I think parents and teachers should help teenagers choose suitable movies. We should also learn to think critically about what we watch. Movies are powerful, so we should use them wisely.
explanation: 按积极影响、问题、建议组织。用inspire us/teach values/open our minds说明积极影响，用violence/unhealthy content/imitate bad behaviour说明问题，用should help choose/think critically提出建议。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一次你经历过的意想不到的事情。内容包括：事情是什么、你当时在哪里、你的反应以及这件事对你的影响。
sampleAnswer: Last year, something unexpected happened to me. I was walking home from school when I saw a small dog running in the middle of the road. Cars were coming, and it was in danger. Without thinking, I ran into the road and picked it up. A car stopped just in time. I was shaking, but the dog was safe. I took it home and found its owner later. This experience taught me that unexpected moments can test our courage. It also reminded me that small acts of kindness can save a life.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述意外事件。按事件、地点、反应、影响组织。用was walking/saw/ran/picked up说明过程，用was shaking/taught me that.../reminded me that...说明反应和影响。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解你经历过的一次“计划外的旅行”或“意外的经历”。请给他写一封邮件，描述事情的经过和你的感受。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
Last summer, my family planned to visit a beach, but our car broke down on the way. We had to stop in a small town we had never heard of. While we waited for repairs, we walked around the town. We found a local market, tried delicious food and met friendly people. It turned out to be a wonderful day. We didn't reach the beach, but we discovered a hidden treasure. This unexpected stop taught me that sometimes the best experiences are not planned. We should learn to enjoy the unexpected.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按计划、意外、经过、感受组织。用planned to visit/broke down/had to stop说明意外，用walked around/found/tried/met说明经过，用taught me that...总结感受。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，讲述一次你因为意外而改变了计划，但最终结果比原计划更好的经历。
sampleAnswer: Last year, I planned to spend my weekend studying for an exam. But on Saturday morning, my friend called and invited me to a volunteer activity at an animal shelter. I hesitated at first, but I decided to go. At the shelter, I helped feed the dogs and clean their cages. I also met other volunteers who loved animals. I felt happy and relaxed. On Sunday, I studied with a clear mind and did well in the exam. This experience taught me that a change of plan is not always bad. Sometimes it gives us energy and new experiences.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述计划改变。按原计划、意外、经历、结果组织。用planned to/But on Saturday morning/hesitated/decided to go说明过程，用taught me that...总结收获。

prompt: 学校正在开展“面对意外”主题活动。请写一篇短文，谈谈当意外发生时，我们应该如何应对。
sampleAnswer: Unexpected things happen in life, and how we respond matters. First, stay calm. Panic makes it harder to think clearly. Take a deep breath and assess the situation. Second, ask for help if needed. Don't try to handle everything alone. Third, focus on what you can control. You may not be able to change what happened, but you can choose your attitude and next step. Finally, learn from the experience. Every unexpected event is a chance to grow. If we face surprises with calmness and courage, we can turn challenges into opportunities.
explanation: 按应对策略组织，用First/Second/Third/Finally。用stay calm/ask for help/focus on what you can control/learn from the experience提出建议，用If we face...can turn...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，描述一个你曾经遇到的“幸运的意外”或“巧合”。内容包括：发生了什么、为什么是巧合以及你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last month, I lost my favourite book on a bus. I was very sad because it was a gift from my grandmother. A week later, I went to a small bookstore near my home. While I was looking at the shelves, I saw a book that looked exactly like mine. I opened it, and my name was inside. Someone had found it and sold it to the bookstore. I was amazed. What a lucky coincidence! I bought it back and promised to take better care of it. Sometimes life gives us surprising gifts.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述巧合事件。按事件、巧合原因、感受组织。用lost/was sad/saw/opened/found说明过程，用What a lucky coincidence!表达感受，用Sometimes life gives us surprising gifts总结。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最难忘的意外经历”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的看法。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about unexpected experiences in our class. There are 40 students. Twelve students say they once got lost in a new place. Ten students say they met a famous person by chance. Eight students say they found something valuable on the street. The other students describe other unexpected moments. I find that getting lost is the most common unexpected experience. I think these experiences are not always bad. They can teach us to solve problems and make our lives more interesting. We should face the unexpected with an open mind.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和看法。用Twelve/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用I think these experiences are not always bad...表达看法，结尾用We should face...提出态度。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter遇到了一次意外挫折，心情很低落。请给他写一封邮件，帮助他换个角度看问题，并鼓励他从意外中学习。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I am sorry to hear about your unexpected setback. I know it feels terrible right now. But I want to remind you that unexpected things happen to everyone. They are not the end of the world. Sometimes, a door closes so that a window can open. Try to see this experience as a lesson. Ask yourself what you can learn from it and what you can do differently next time. You are strong and capable. I believe you can turn this setback into a step forward. I am here for you.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 鼓励邮件先表达理解，用They are not the end of the world/a door closes so that a window can open帮助对方换角度。用Ask yourself what you can learn/You are strong...鼓励，结尾表达支持。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一次你因为意外而认识了新朋友或发现了新兴趣的经历。
sampleAnswer: Last year, I missed my bus and had to wait at the stop for the next one. A girl my age was also waiting. We started talking and found that we went to the same school. Her name is Lily, and she loves drawing. She showed me some of her pictures on her phone. I was amazed. I told her I had always wanted to learn to draw but didn't know how to start. She invited me to join the school art club. Because of that missed bus, I made a good friend and discovered a new hobby. Sometimes a small accident leads to something wonderful.
explanation: 用一般过去时叙述意外结识经历。按意外、经过、发现、感受组织。用missed my bus/started talking/found/showed/invited说明过程，用Because of that missed bus, I.../Sometimes a small accident leads to...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈你对“生活充满意外”这句话的理解。内容包括：你的理解、一个例子以及你如何面对生活中的不确定性。
sampleAnswer: I think “Life is full of the unexpected” means that we cannot control everything. Good and bad things can happen at any time. For example, I once planned a picnic, but it rained heavily. We moved the picnic indoors and had a fun time anyway. This experience showed me that unexpected events are not always disasters. We can adapt and find joy. To face uncertainty, I try to stay calm, be flexible and focus on what I can control. I also remind myself that every unexpected moment is a chance to learn and grow. Life is more interesting because of its surprises.
explanation: 先解释对句子的理解，用I once planned...but it rained...举例说明。用To face uncertainty, I try to...说明应对方式，用every unexpected moment is a chance.../Life is more interesting...总结。

prompt: 学校正在开展“绿色校园”行动。请写一篇短文，指出校园中存在的两个环境问题，并提出相应的解决建议。
sampleAnswer: Our school is beautiful, but there are still some environmental problems. First, some students waste water. They leave the tap running after washing their hands. We should remind each other to turn off the tap. Second, too much paper is wasted. Students often throw away notebooks that are only half used. We can use both sides of the paper and collect waste paper for recycling. If we all take small actions, our school will become greener and cleaner. Protecting the environment starts with us.
explanation: 按问题、建议组织。用leave the tap running/throw away notebooks说明问题，用remind each other/turn off the tap/use both sides/recycle提出建议，用If we all take small actions...总结。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国在环境保护方面所做的努力。请给他写一封邮件，介绍两项措施并说明它们的效果。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
China is making great efforts to protect the environment. First, the government has built many solar and wind power stations. This reduces the use of coal and helps clean the air. Second, many cities have started garbage sorting programs. People separate their waste into different bins, which makes recycling easier. I have noticed that the sky is bluer and the streets are cleaner than before. These measures show that environmental protection is possible when everyone works together. I hope more countries can learn from these efforts.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按两项措施及效果组织。用solar and wind power stations/reduces the use of coal/helps clean the air说明第一项，用garbage sorting/separate waste/makes recycling easier说明第二项，用I have noticed that...说明效果。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你在日常生活中为保护环境所做的三件小事，并说明这些小事的意义。
sampleAnswer: I try to protect the environment in my daily life. First, I always bring a reusable water bottle and shopping bag. This reduces plastic waste. Second, I turn off the lights and unplug electronics when I don't use them. This saves energy. Third, I sort my garbage and recycle paper and bottles. These actions may seem small, but they add up. If every student does these things, our school and city will be cleaner. Protecting the environment is not someone else's job. It is everyone's responsibility, and it starts with small daily habits.
explanation: 用First/Second/Third介绍三件小事，用This reduces plastic waste/saves energy说明意义。用These actions may seem small, but they add up/If every student does...说明累积效果，结尾用It is everyone's responsibility总结。

prompt: 学校正在举办“环保演讲比赛”。请写一篇演讲稿，谈谈为什么保护环境刻不容缓，并号召同学们采取行动。
sampleAnswer:
Dear teachers and students,
The environment is in danger. The air is polluted, the water is dirty, and many animals are losing their homes. If we don't act now, the problem will become worse. But we can make a difference. We can save water, recycle waste, and use less plastic. We can walk or cycle instead of taking cars. We can also tell others to protect the environment. The Earth is our only home. Let's take action today, not tomorrow. Together, we can make the world a greener and better place. Thank you.
explanation: 演讲稿要有称呼和结束语。先指出环境问题的紧迫性，用we can...列举行动，用If we don't act now...说明后果，用Let's take action today...发出号召，语言有感染力。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，比较过去和现在的环境状况，说明变化的原因以及你对未来的期望。
sampleAnswer: The environment has changed a lot over the years. In the past, the sky was bluer and the rivers were cleaner. People could swim in the river and see fish. But with the development of industry, pollution became serious. Factories poured waste into rivers, and cars filled the air with smoke. Now people have realized the problem. Governments are taking action, and more people are choosing green lifestyles. I hope that in the future, we can bring back the clear rivers and blue skies. If we protect the environment today, future generations can enjoy a beautiful world.
explanation: 比较过去和现在的环境，用In the past.../But with the development.../Now...体现变化。用Governments are taking action/more people are choosing green lifestyles说明改变，用If...can...表达期望。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“最严重的环境问题”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的建议。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about environmental problems in our class. There are 40 students. Sixteen students think air pollution is the most serious. Ten students choose water pollution. Eight students say plastic waste is the biggest problem. The other students choose problems like noise pollution. I find that air pollution is the top concern. I think it is because many students live near busy roads. I suggest we use public transport more and plant more trees. If we work together, we can reduce pollution and make our city cleaner.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和建议。用Sixteen/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用because说明原因，用I suggest...提出建议，用If...can...说明结果。

prompt: 你的朋友Lisa认为个人行动对环境保护没有意义。请给她写一封邮件，说服她相信小行动可以带来大改变。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Lisa,
I understand why you feel that one person's actions don't matter. But I don't agree. Imagine if every student in our school picked up one piece of rubbish a day. That would be thousands of pieces of rubbish removed every week. If everyone saved one glass of water, the savings would be huge. Small actions add up. Also, when others see you doing something good, they may follow your example. You don't have to change the whole world alone. Just start with one small action. Together, our actions can make a real difference.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 说服邮件先理解对方观点，用But I don't agree转折。用Imagine if...would.../If everyone saved...说明小行动的累积效应，用when others see you...may follow...说明示范作用，结尾鼓励行动。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍一种你认为值得推广的环保生活方式（如零浪费生活、低碳出行等）。内容包括：它是什么、如何实践以及它的好处。
sampleAnswer: I think the “zero waste” lifestyle is worth promoting. It means trying to produce as little rubbish as possible. To practise it, we can bring our own bags and bottles, refuse plastic straws, and buy products with less packaging. We can also repair things instead of throwing them away. The benefits are great. It reduces pollution, saves resources and protects animals. Although zero waste is not easy to achieve completely, every small step helps. If more people adopt this lifestyle, our planet will be much healthier.
explanation: 按生活方式、实践方式、好处组织。用bring our own bags/refuse plastic straws/repair things说明实践，用reduces pollution/saves resources/protects animals说明好处，用If more people adopt...will be...总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，谈谈科技发展对环境的影响。内容包括：科技带来的环境问题以及科技如何帮助解决环境问题。
sampleAnswer: Technology has both negative and positive effects on the environment. On the negative side, factories and cars produce pollution, and electronic waste is growing. Technology has made it easier to produce and consume more, which puts pressure on nature. However, technology can also help solve environmental problems. Solar panels and wind turbines provide clean energy. New machines can recycle waste more efficiently. Apps can help people use resources wisely. I think we should use technology responsibly and develop more green technologies. Technology should serve the planet, not harm it.
explanation: 按负面影响、积极帮助、看法组织。用produce pollution/electronic waste说明问题，用solar panels/wind turbines/recycle waste说明科技帮助，用should use responsibly/develop green technologies表达观点。

prompt: 学校正在征集“保护地球”的英文宣传标语和短文。请写一篇短文，说明地球面临的一个主要威胁，并呼吁大家采取行动。
sampleAnswer: One of the biggest threats to our planet is plastic pollution. Every year, millions of tons of plastic end up in the ocean. Sea animals mistake plastic for food and many die. Plastic takes hundreds of years to break down. We must take action now. We can refuse single-use plastic bags and bottles. We can bring our own reusable items. We can also join beach clean-ups and spread the message. The Earth is our only home. If we don't protect it, who will? Let's act today for a better tomorrow.
explanation: 先指出威胁（plastic pollution），用millions of tons/sea animals mistake plastic for food说明严重性。用We can...列举行动，用If we don't protect it, who will?/Let's act today...发出呼吁。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，回顾你初中三年中最难忘的一段经历。内容包括：发生了什么、为什么难忘以及它对你的意义。
sampleAnswer: The most unforgettable experience in my junior high school is the school sports meeting in Grade 8. I took part in the 800-metre race. I was not good at running, and I almost gave up halfway. But my classmates ran beside me and cheered loudly. I kept going and finally finished the race. I didn't win, but I felt proud. That experience taught me that support from friends can give us strength. It also showed me that finishing is more important than winning. I will always remember that day.
explanation: 用一般过去时回顾经历。按事件、难忘原因、意义组织。用took part/almost gave up/ran beside me/cheered/finished说明过程，用taught me that.../showed me that...说明意义。

prompt: 你的英国笔友Tom即将初中毕业。请给他写一封邮件，分享你初中生活中最珍惜的三样东西（如友谊、老师的帮助、一次成长经历等），并说明原因。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Tom,
As junior high school comes to an end, I want to share the three things I treasure most. First, I treasure my friendships. My classmates and I have studied, laughed and grown together. Second, I treasure the help from my teachers. They not only taught me knowledge but also encouraged me when I felt down. Third, I treasure the chance to become more independent. I learned to plan my time and solve problems on my own. These three things have made my junior high years meaningful. I will carry them with me as I move forward.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 邮件按三样珍惜的东西及原因组织。用friendships/help from teachers/chance to become independent说明内容，用have studied, laughed and grown/encouraged me/learned to plan说明原因，结尾表达珍惜。

prompt: 学校正在举办毕业典礼，请写一篇英文演讲稿，回顾初中三年的成长，感谢老师和同学，并展望未来。
sampleAnswer:
Dear teachers and classmates,
Today is a special day. Looking back, I remember the first day of Grade 7, when everything was new and I was nervous. Now I am confident and ready for the future. I want to thank my teachers. You taught me knowledge and showed me how to be a better person. I want to thank my classmates. You made my school days full of laughter and warmth. As we move on, I hope we all keep learning, stay kind and chase our dreams. No matter where we go, we will always be part of this school. Thank you.
explanation: 演讲稿要有称呼和结束语。按回顾、感谢、展望组织。用Looking back/Now I am...体现成长，用I want to thank...感谢老师和同学，用keep learning, stay kind and chase our dreams展望未来。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你初中三年中最大的一次变化，并说明是什么促成了这次变化。
sampleAnswer: The biggest change in my junior high school years is that I became more confident. In Grade 7, I was afraid to speak in front of others. I seldom raised my hand in class. Then my English teacher encouraged me to join a speech competition. I practised for weeks. Although I didn't win, I finished my speech in front of the whole school. After that, I started to believe in myself. I began to answer questions and share my ideas. The change came from that one brave step. I learned that confidence grows when we face our fears.
explanation: 按变化、过去、转折、结果组织。用In Grade 7, I was afraid.../Then my teacher encouraged me/Although I didn't win/After that说明过程，用The change came from.../confidence grows when...总结。

prompt: 假设你是学校英语报的记者，请写一篇短文，报道你们班同学对“初中最难忘的回忆”的调查结果。内容包括：调查人数、主要结果和你的感受。
sampleAnswer: Last week, we did a survey about the most unforgettable memories in junior high school in our class. There are 40 students. Fifteen students say the school trip was the most memorable. Ten students choose the sports meeting. Eight students say making friends was the best part. The other students mention teachers' help or class parties. I find that school activities are the most unforgettable. I think it is because they brought us together and created shared happiness. As we graduate, these memories will stay in our hearts forever.
explanation: 调查报道写清人数、结果和感受。用Fifteen/Ten/Eight students列出数据，用I find that...总结，用because they brought us together...说明原因，结尾用will stay in our hearts forever表达感受。

prompt: 你的朋友Peter即将转学，他有些舍不得现在的同学和老师。请给他写一封邮件，帮助他正确面对离别，并鼓励他迎接新的开始。
sampleAnswer:
Dear Peter,
I know leaving is hard. You have spent three years with your classmates and teachers, and they mean a lot to you. It is okay to feel sad. But remember, goodbye is not the end. You can keep in touch with them through messages and calls. And a new school means new friends, new teachers and new chances to grow. You are good at making friends, so I am sure you will do well. Keep the old memories in your heart and open your arms to the new. Every ending is also a beginning.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 鼓励邮件先理解对方的感受，用It is okay to feel sad承认情绪。用keep in touch/new chances/You are good at...帮助对方看到积极面，用Every ending is also a beginning.总结。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，介绍你对高中生活的期待和计划。内容包括：你想在高中做什么、为什么以及你打算如何实现这些计划。
sampleAnswer: I am excited about high school. I hope to join more clubs, such as the debate club and the basketball team. I want to improve my public speaking and make new friends. I also plan to study harder, especially in maths and English, because these subjects are important for my future. To achieve these goals, I will make a weekly plan and stick to it. I will also ask teachers for help when I need it. I believe high school will be a new and exciting chapter in my life.
explanation: 按期待、原因、计划组织。用hope to join/improve/make friends/plan to study harder说明期待，用because these subjects are important说明原因，用make a weekly plan/ask for help说明实现方式。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，给七年级刚入学的学弟学妹们一些建议。内容包括：如何适应初中生活、如何平衡学习和爱好以及如何与同学相处。
sampleAnswer: Welcome to junior high school! Here is some advice from a Grade 9 student. First, don't be afraid of new challenges. Join a club, make new friends and ask for help when you need it. Second, learn to balance study and hobbies. Make a plan and set priorities. Study comes first, but hobbies make life colourful. Third, be kind to your classmates. A smile and a helping hand can build good friendships. Junior high goes by quickly. Enjoy every moment and work hard. You will create wonderful memories.
explanation: 建议短文要有对象感（学弟学妹）。用First/Second/Third分别提出适应、平衡、相处的建议，用Make a plan/set priorities说明平衡方法，用Enjoy every moment and work hard结尾鼓励。

prompt: 请写一篇短文，回顾你在初中阶段最想感谢的一位老师，说明他/她为你做了什么以及你从他/她身上学到了什么。
sampleAnswer: The teacher I want to thank most is my English teacher, Ms. Li. In Grade 8, I did badly in English and lost confidence. Ms. Li didn't criticize me. Instead, she talked to me and helped me find my weak points. She gave me extra practice and encouraged me every week. Slowly, my English improved. From her, I learned not only language skills but also the importance of patience and belief in others. She showed me that a good teacher can change a student's life. I will always be grateful to her.
explanation: 按老师、帮助、收获组织。用did badly/lost confidence/didn't criticize/helped me find/gave extra practice说明帮助，用I learned not only...but also.../She showed me that...说明收获，结尾表达感谢。

prompt: 学校正在征集“毕业寄语”。请写一篇短文，写给三年后的自己，回顾现在的努力并表达对未来的期望。
sampleAnswer:
Dear future me,
I hope you are doing well. Right now, I am a Grade 9 student preparing for the high school entrance exam. I am studying hard and sometimes feel tired, but I know these efforts are for a better future. I hope you have entered a good high school and met wonderful people. I hope you still love reading and playing basketball. I hope you have become braver and kinder. No matter what happens, please remember the person you are today—someone who tries hard and never gives up. I believe in you.
Yours,
Present me
explanation: 以写给未来自己的信的形式，按现在、期望、鼓励组织。用I am studying hard/feel tired/efforts are for a better future说明现在，用I hope you have.../I hope you still...表达期望，用I believe in you结尾。
